3.12.m: Svāhā should be seated on his left lap, like Śacī of Śakra, / the goddess holding a jewel vessel in her hand. In the right hands of Agni

3.12.m: His having the wind as his charioteer is directly perceived, and his smoky realm / is likewise proclaimed as directly perceived, as is his having garments of the smoky hue of sacrifice.

3.12.m: The supreme abode has the form of a flame; through it he accepts the oblation. / Having received it, O slayer of foes, he then carries it to all the gods.

3.12.m: His beard is stated to be darbha grass, supremely purifying. / Those parrots harnessed to the chariot of the great-souled one are the Vedas.

आग्नेयमेतत्तव रूपमुक्तं पापापहं सिद्धिकरं नराणाम् ॥
ध्येयं तवैतन्नृप होमकाले सर्वाग्निकर्मण्यपराजितेन ॥ 3.56.10 ॥
3.57
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
विरूपाक्षो विवृत्ताक्षः प्रांशुदण्डोज्ज्वलाननः ॥
ऊर्ध्वकेशो हरिश्छमश्रुर्द्विबाहुर्भीषणाननः ॥1॥
वर्णेन रक्तकृष्णाङ्गः कृष्णाम्बरधरस्तथा ॥
सर्वाभरणधारी च दण्डरश्मिकरस्तथा ॥ 2 ॥
भार्या च तस्य कर्तव्या देवी निनृतितस्तथा ॥
कृष्णाङ्गी कृष्णवदना पाशहस्ता तु वामतः ॥ 3 ।
कालः प्रोक्तो विरूपाक्षो मृत्युर्हि निनृतिस्तथा ॥
बिभर्ति तामसं रूपं वासांसि च ततो नृप ॥ 4 ॥
मारणं तत्करे दण्डं बन्धनं चोष्ट्ररश्मयः ॥
महामोहस्तथैवोष्ट्रः कथितस्तस्य वामतः ॥9॥
वपुर्विरूपाक्षमिदं प्रदिष्टं रक्षोधिपस्याप्रतिमस्य तस्य ।
अतः परं वच्मि तवाद्य राजन्वायोस्तुरूपं परमस्य धाम्नः ॥ 9 ॥
3.12.m:
This form of Agni has been declared to you, removing sin and granting accomplishment to men. / This is to be meditated upon by you at the time of oblation, O king, undefeated in every rite of fire.
3.57 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Virūpākṣa has twisted eyes, a tall staff, a radiant face, / upward-standing hair, a tawny beard, two arms, and a terrifying countenance.
In complexion his limbs are reddish-black, and he wears black garments. / He wears all ornaments and holds a staff and reins in his hands.
And his wife should be made, the goddess Nirṛti, / with black limbs, a black face, and a noose in hand, on his left.
Virūpākṣa is declared to be Time, and Nirṛti is Death. / Therefore, O king, he bears a dark form and dark garments.
The staff in his hand is killing, and the camel's reins are binding; / and the camel on his left is spoken of as great delusion.
This form of Virūpākṣa, that peerless lord of rākṣasas, has been indicated. / Henceforth, O king, I tell you today the form of Vāyu, the supreme abode.

3.12.d:
3.58
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
वायुरम्बरवर्णस्तु तदाकारोम्बरो भवेत् ॥
वाय्वापूरितवस्त्रश्च द्विभुजो रूपसंयुतः ॥ 1 ॥
गमनेच्छा शिवा भार्या तस्य कार्या च वामतः ॥
कार्यो गृहीत वस्त्रान्तः कराभ्यां पवनो द्विज ॥ 2 ॥
तथैव देवी कर्तव्या शिवा परमसुन्दरी ॥
व्याधितास्यस्तथा कार्यो देवो व्याकुलमूर्धजः ॥ 3 ॥
वायुराश्रयतो धत्ते गन्धवर्णादिकं यतः ॥
तस्मादञ्जनवर्णस्तु गमनस्य समाश्रयात् ॥ 4॥
तदेव वसनं तस्य गगनं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
या गतिः सा शिवा देवी योऽनिरुद्धश्च सोऽनिलः ॥ 9 ॥
एतद्धि रूपं पवनस्य राजम्̐स्तवोदितं स वै जगन्मयस्य ॥।
देव्याः शिवायाश्च महानुभाव परं पवित्रं विदितं द्विजानाम ॥6॥
3.59
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
अथातो रूपनिर्माणं वच्म्यहं भैरवस्य ते ॥
लम्बोदरं तथा कुर्याद्वृत्तपिङ्गललोचनम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.12.m:
3.58 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Vāyu has the colour of the sky, and his garment should have the form of that [sky]. / His garment is filled with wind, and he is two-armed and endowed with beauty.
His wife, the auspicious Gamanecchā, should be made on his left. / The wind[-god] should be made holding the ends of his garment with both hands, O twice-born.
Likewise, the goddess Śivā should be made supremely beautiful. / The god should be made with an open mouth and dishevelled hair.
Because the wind takes on scent, colour, and the like from its support, / it therefore has the colour of collyrium, through its connection with motion.
That very sky is proclaimed to be his garment. / That motion is the goddess Śivā; and he who is Aniruddha is the wind.
Indeed, this form of Pavana, who consists of the universe, / and of the goddess Śivā has been spoken to you, O king of great majesty, known as supremely holy to the twice-born.
3.59 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now I shall tell you the fashioning of the form of Bhairava. / One should make him pot-bellied and with round, reddish-brown eyes,

दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं फुल्लनासापुटं तथा ॥
कपालमालिनं रौद्रं सर्वतः सर्पभूषणम् ॥ 2 ॥
व्यालेन त्रासयन्तं च देवीं पर्वतनन्दिनीम् ॥
सजलाम्बुदसंकाशं गजचर्मोत्तरच्छदम् ॥ 3 ॥
बाहुभिर्बहुभिव्याप्तं सर्वायुधविभूषणैः ॥
बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशैस्तथा तीक्ष्णनखैः शुभैः ॥ 4 ॥
साचीकृतमिदं रूपं भैरवस्य प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
महाकालस्य कथितमेतदेव च सन्मुखम् ॥ 5 ॥
देवी तु वामतः कार्या करे कार्यस्तु पन्नगः ।
न चास्य पुरतः कार्या देवी पर्वतनन्दिनी ॥ 6॥
शुक्ला न कार्या न तथास्य रक्ता समीपतो मातृगणप्रधाने ॥
कार्यस्त्वथान्यः परिबर्हमस्य गणाश्च कार्या बहुरूपरूपाः ॥ 7॥
3.60
॥वज्र उवाच॥
विष्णुभूम्यम्बराणां त्वं ब्रह्मणश्च तथा विभो ॥
रूपनिर्माणमाचक्ष्व भृगुवंशविवर्धन ॥ 1 ॥
3.12.m:
with a face dread with fangs, flaring nostrils, / wearing a garland of skulls, terrible, and adorned all over with serpents,
frightening the goddess, the mountain-daughter, with a snake, / resembling a rain-laden cloud, and having an elephant-hide as his upper garment,
covered with many arms adorned with all weapons, / resembling large sāl trees, with sharp and auspicious nails.
This form of Bhairava is proclaimed as turned sideways. / This same [form] is declared to be facing forward for Mahākāla.
The goddess is to be made on the left, and a snake in his hand; / but the goddess, the mountain-daughter, is not to be made in front of him.
She should not be made white, nor red, when near him at the head of the group of mothers. / Further, his attendants should be made, and the gaṇas should be made of manifold forms.
3.60 / Vajra said: / O lord, enhancer of the lineage of Bhṛgu, describe the fashioning / of the forms of Viṣṇu, the Earth, the Sky, and Brahmā.

3.12.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एकवक्त्रो द्विबाहुश्च गदाचक्रधरः प्रभुः ॥
देहविन्यासमपरं प्रागुक्तं कीर्तितं हरेः ॥ 2 ॥
गान्धारी तु स्मृता मायी जगद्बन्धाय वैष्णवी ॥
गदा देवकरे नित्यं सर्वभूतवशङ्करी ॥ 3 ॥
सैव लक्ष्मीर्धृतिः कीर्तिः पुष्टिः श्रद्धा सरस्वती ॥
गायत्री वेदजननी कालरात्रिस्तथैव सा ॥ 4 ॥
संसारभ्रमणं चक्रं चक्रं विष्णुकरे स्थितम् ॥
धर्मचक्रं कालचक्रं भचकं च महाभुज ॥ 5 ॥
ध्रुवो हि विप्णुर्भगवान्प्रदिष्टचक्रं सदा भ्रामयते स वीरः ॥
एतेन कार्येण जगत्प्रधानः स चक्रहस्तो भगवान्प्रदिष्टः॥6॥
3.12.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The lord has one face, two arms, and holds a mace and a discus; / the other arrangement of Hari's body has been proclaimed before.
Gāndhārī, the Vaiṣṇava Māyā, is known [as created] for binding the universe; / the mace is always in the god's hand, bringing all beings into subjection.
She indeed is Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Kīrti, Puṣṭi, Śraddhā, Sarasvatī, / Gāyatrī, mother of the Vedas, and likewise Kālarātri.
The wheel turning through saṃsāra is the discus resting in Viṣṇu’s hand; / it is the wheel of dharma, the wheel of time, and the wheel of constellations, O mighty-armed one.
For the fixed [pole] is declared to be the blessed lord Viṣṇu; that hero constantly sets the wheel spinning. / By this function, the foremost of the universe, the blessed lord, is described as holding the discus in hand.

3.61
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शुकवर्णा मही कार्या दिव्याभरणभूषिता ॥
चतुर्भुजा सौम्यवपुश्चन्द्रांशुसदृशाम्बरा ॥1॥
3.13.m: 3.61 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Earth should be made of parrot-green hue, adorned with divine ornaments, / four-armed, of gentle body, and clothed in garments resembling moonbeams.

3.13.s:
ratnapātraṃ sasyapātraṃ pātramoṣadhisaṃyutam ..
padmaṃ kare ca kartavyaṃ bhuvo yādavanandana .. 2 ..
3.13.d:
रत्नपात्रं सस्यपात्रं पात्रमोषधिसंयुतम् ॥
पद्मं करे च कर्तव्यं भुवो यादवनन्दन ॥ 2 ॥
3.13.m: In her hands, O delight of the Yādavas, should be placed a vessel of jewels, / a vessel of grain, a vessel filled with herbs, and a lotus.

3.13.s:
diṅnāgānāṃ caturṇāṃ sā kāryā pṛṣṭhagatā tathā ..
sarvauṣadhiyutā devī śuklavarṇā tataḥ smṛtā..3..
3.13.d:
दिङ्नागानां चतुर्णां सा कार्या पृष्ठगता तथा ॥
सर्वौषधियुता देवी शुक्लवर्णा ततः स्मृता॥3॥
3.13.m: She should be made standing on the backs of the four elephants of the directions; / the goddess is filled with all medicinal herbs, and hence is traditionally known as white in colour.

3.13.s: dharmaṃ vastraṃ sitaṃ tasyāḥ padmamarthaṃ tathā kare ..4..
3.13.d: धर्मं वस्त्रं सितं तस्याः पद्ममर्थं तथा करे ॥4॥
3.13.m: Her white garment is dharma, and the lotus in her hand is wealth.

3.13.s:
hetuśca śeṣo vidito budhānāmato mayā te kathito'dya rājan ..
rūpaṃ tvarūpasya tu vacmyatohaṃ prakarṣitaṃ yadgaganasya siddhaiḥ .. 5 ..
3.62
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
nīlotpalābhaṃ gaganaṃ tadvarṇāmbaradhāriṇam ..
candrārkahastaṃ kartavyaṃ dvibhujaṃ saumyadarśanam ..1..
etaddhi rūpaṃ gaganasya rājanproktaṃ mayā te parikalpitaṃ yata ..
rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmyatha te nibodha pitāmahasyāpratimasya tasya .. 2 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
padmapatrāsanasthastu brahmā kāryaścaturmukhaḥ ..
sāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṅgagatā tathā .. 1 ..
ādityavarṇā dharmajña sākṣamālākarā tathā ..
rūpaṃ pūrvoditaṃ kāryaṃ sarvamanyajjagatpate .. 2 ..
etaddhi rūpaṃ varadasya kāryaṃ pitāmahasyāpratimasya saumya ..
pūrvoditaṃ vā varadasya tasya lokaṃ samagraṃ vaśagaṃ hi yasya .. 3 ..
3.13.d:
हेतुश्च शेषो विदितो बुधानामतो मया ते कथितोऽद्य राजन् ॥
रूपं त्वरूपस्य तु वच्म्यतोहं प्रकर्षितं यद्गगनस्य सिद्धैः ॥ 5 ॥
3.62
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
नीलोत्पलाभं गगनं तद्वर्णाम्बरधारिणम् ॥
चन्द्रार्कहस्तं कर्तव्यं द्विभुजं सौम्यदर्शनम् ॥1॥
एतद्धि रूपं गगनस्य राजन्प्रोक्तं मया ते परिकल्पितं यत ॥
रूपं प्रवक्ष्याम्यथ ते निबोध पितामहस्याप्रतिमस्य तस्य ॥ 2 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पद्मपत्रासनस्थस्तु ब्रह्मा कार्यश्चतुर्मुखः ॥
सावित्री तस्य कर्तव्या वामोत्सङ्गगता तथा ॥ 1 ॥
आदित्यवर्णा धर्मज्ञ साक्षमालाकरा तथा ॥
रूपं पूर्वोदितं कार्यं सर्वमन्यज्जगत्पते ॥ 2 ॥
एतद्धि रूपं वरदस्य कार्यं पितामहस्याप्रतिमस्य सौम्य ॥
पूर्वोदितं वा वरदस्य तस्य लोकं समग्रं वशगं हि यस्य ॥ 3 ॥
3.13.m:
The remaining reason is known to the wise, and therefore has not been told to you today, O king. / But now I shall speak of the form of the formless, the Sky, which has been delineated by the Siddhas.
3.62 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Sky should have the lustre of a blue lotus, wearing garments of that same colour, / holding the moon and sun in its hands, two-armed, and of gentle appearance.
This form of the Sky has indeed been told to you by me, O king, as conceived [by the Siddhas]; / now learn, for I shall declare to you the form of that matchless Grandfather.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Brahmā should be made seated upon a lotus-petal seat, four-faced; / and Sāvitrī should be placed upon his left lap.
She is of sun-like splendour, O knower of dharma, holding a rosary in her hand; / all else of his form should be made as previously stated, O lord of the world.
This form of the matchless Grandfather, the giver of boons, should be made, O gentle one, / or as previously described for that giver of boons, under whose sway rests the entire world.

3.13.s:
3.64
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
devī sarasvatī kāryā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ..
caturbhujā sā kartavyā tathaiva ca samutthitā .. 1 ..
pustakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca tasyā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ..
vāmayośca tathā kāryā vaiṣṇavī ca kamaṇḍaluḥ .. 2 ..
samapādapratiṣṭhā ca kāryā sāmamukhī tathā ..
vedāstasya bhujā jñeyāḥ sarvaśāstrāṇi pustakam .. 3 ..
sarvaśāstrāmṛtaraso devyā jñeyaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ ..
akṣamālā kare tasyāḥ kālo bhavati pārthiva .. 4 ..
siddhirmūrtimatī jñeyā vaiṣṇavī nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
sāvitrī vadanaṃ tasyāḥ sarvādyā parikīrtitā .. 5 ..
3.13.d:
3.64
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
देवी सरस्वती कार्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता ॥
चतुर्भुजा सा कर्तव्या तथैव च समुत्थिता ॥ 1 ॥
पुस्तकं चाक्षमालां च तस्या दक्षिणहस्तयोः ॥
वामयोश्च तथा कार्या वैष्णवी च कमण्डलुः ॥ 2 ॥
समपादप्रतिष्ठा च कार्या साममुखी तथा ॥
वेदास्तस्य भुजा ज्ञेयाः सर्वशास्त्राणि पुस्तकम् ॥ 3 ॥
सर्वशास्त्रामृतरसो देव्या ज्ञेयः कमण्डलुः ॥
अक्षमाला करे तस्याः कालो भवति पार्थिव ॥ 4 ॥
सिद्धिर्मूर्तिमती ज्ञेया वैष्णवी नात्र संशयः ॥
सावित्री वदनं तस्याः सर्वाद्या परिकीर्तिता ॥ 5 ॥
3.13.m:
3.64 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Goddess Sarasvatī should be made adorned with all ornaments; / she should be made four-armed and standing upright.
A book and a rosary should be in her right hands; / and in her left [hands] should be placed a lute and a water-pot.
She should be made standing firmly with feet even, facing straight forward; / her arms are to be understood as the Vedas, and the book as all the scriptures.
The goddess’s water-pot is to be understood as the nectar-essence of all scriptures; / the rosary in her hand is time, O king.
The lute is to be understood as accomplishment embodied—of this there is no doubt; / her face is declared to be Sāvitrī, the foremost of all.
She is to be known as having the sun and moon as her eyes, and she is lotus-eyed.

3.13.s:
sārasvataṃ te kathitaṃ mayaitadrūpaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ manojñam ..
dhyeyaṃ ca kāryaṃ ca mahīpamukhya savārthasiddhiṃ samabhīpsamānaiḥ .. 7..
3.65
vajra uvāca ..
ācakṣva rūpanirmāṇaṃ mamānantasya devaja ..
viṣṇoramitavīryasya śeṣasya dharaṇībhṛtaḥ .. 1 ..
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca ..
kuryācchaśāṅkasaṅkāśaṃ ratnojjvalaphaṇānvitam..
nīlavastraṃ caturbāhuṃ sarvābharaṇadhāriṇam ..2..
phaṇāśca bahavaḥ kāryā yatphaṇaṃ tasya madhyamama..
tatra rūpavatī kāryā vasudhā yadunandana..3..
padmaṃ samusalaṃ kāryaṃ devadakṣiṇahastayoḥ ..
vāmayossīraśaṃkhe ca kare tasya surāmbudhiḥ ..4..
tālavṛkṣaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ tu mahābhuja ..
vikhyātau sīramusalau pūrvameva mayā tava .. 5 ..
vanamālā ca vikhyātā tathā yadukulodvaha ..
pṛthivī dhāryate tena saśailavanakānanā .. 6 ..
3.13.d:
सारस्वतं ते कथितं मयैतद्रूपं पवित्रं परमं मनोज्ञम् ॥
ध्येयं च कार्यं च महीपमुख्य सवार्थसिद्धिं समभीप्समानैः ॥ 7॥
3.65
वज्र उवाच ॥
आचक्ष्व रूपनिर्माणं ममानन्तस्य देवज ॥
विष्णोरमितवीर्यस्य शेषस्य धरणीभृतः ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कंडेय उवाच ॥
कुर्याच्छशाङ्कसङ्काशं रत्नोज्ज्वलफणान्वितम्॥
नीलवस्त्रं चतुर्बाहुं सर्वाभरणधारिणम् ॥2॥
फणाश्च बहवः कार्या यत्फणं तस्य मध्यमम॥
तत्र रूपवती कार्या वसुधा यदुनन्दन॥3॥
पद्मं समुसलं कार्यं देवदक्षिणहस्तयोः ॥
वामयोस्सीरशंखे च करे तस्य सुराम्बुधिः ॥4॥
तालवृक्षं जगत्सर्वं कथितं तु महाभुज ॥
विख्यातौ सीरमुसलौ पूर्वमेव मया तव ॥ 5 ॥
वनमाला च विख्याता तथा यदुकुलोद्वह ॥
पृथिवी धार्यते तेन सशैलवनकानना ॥ 6 ॥
3.13.m:
This form of Sarasvatī, pure, supreme, and charming, has been told to you by me; / it should be meditated upon and fashioned, O foremost of kings, by those desiring the attainment of all goals.
3.65 / Vajra said: / Describe to me, O god-born one, the fashioning of the form of Ananta, / Viṣṇu of boundless valour, Śeṣa who supports the earth.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / One should make him resembling the moon, endowed with hoods shining with jewels, / dressed in blue garments, four-armed, and wearing all ornaments.
Many hoods should be made; upon that hood which is his central one, / the shapely Earth should be made, O delight of the Yadus.
A lotus and a pestle should be placed in the god’s right hands; / in his left [hands], a plough and a conch, and in his hand the ocean of liquor.
The entire universe is proclaimed to be the palmyra tree, O mighty-armed one; / the plough and the pestle have already been explained to you by me.
And the forest garland is likewise celebrated, O enhancer of the Yadu race; / by him the earth is supported along with its mountains, forests, and groves.

3.13.s: pṛthivī tena kartavyā phaṇe tasya tu madhyame .. 7 ..
3.13.d: पृथिवी तेन कर्तव्या फणे तस्य तु मध्यमे ॥ 7 ॥
3.13.m: The earth should therefore be made upon his central hood.

3.13.s:
phaṇāvaliptasya tayā pratiṣṭhā kāmāstu te yādavavaṃśamukhya ..
etaddhi rūpaṃ parameśvarasya viṣṇoracintyasya mayeritaṃ te .. 8 ..
3.13.d:
फणावलिप्तस्य तया प्रतिष्ठा कामास्तु ते यादववंशमुख्य ॥
एतद्धि रूपं परमेश्वरस्य विष्णोरचिन्त्यस्य मयेरितं ते ॥ 8 ॥
3.13.m: For him who is covered with hoods, she is the basis; and all desires [are fulfilled for you], O foremost of the Yādava lineage; / for this form of the supreme lord, the inconceivable Viṣṇu, has been declared to you by me.

3.14.s:
3.66
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca ..
kartavyastumbururdevo mātṛmadhyagataḥ prabhuḥ ..
upaviṣṭo vṛṣe kāryaḥ śarvavatsa caturmukhaḥ .. 1 ..
3.14.d:
3.66
मार्कंडेय उवाच ॥
कर्तव्यस्तुम्बुरुर्देवो मातृमध्यगतः प्रभुः ॥
उपविष्टो वृषे कार्यः शर्ववत्स चतुर्मुखः ॥ 1 ॥
3.14.m: 3.66 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Lord Tumburu should be made situated amidst the mothers; / seated upon a bull, he should be made four-faced like Śarva.

3.14.s:
upaviṣṭastu kartavyaḥ sa tu pārthivasattama ..
mahādevena tasyoktaṃ rūpaṃ te sakalaṃ mayā .. 2 ..
3.14.d:
उपविष्टस्तु कर्तव्यः स तु पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
महादेवेन तस्योक्तं रूपं ते सकलं मया ॥ 2 ॥
3.14.m: He should indeed be made seated, O best of kings; / his entire form has been described to you [under the guise of] Mahādeva.

3.14.s:
kapālaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ mātuluṅgadhare kare ..
mātuluṅgaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tryambakeṇa tadīritam .. 3 ..
3.14.d:
कपालं तस्य कर्तव्यं मातुलुङ्गधरे करे ॥
मातुलुङ्गं च कर्तव्यं त्र्यम्बकेण तदीरितम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.14.m: A skull-cup should be placed in his hand that holds a citron, / and a citron should be placed; so it was declared by Tryambaka.

3.14.s:
tasya dakṣiṇataḥ kāryaṃ tathā mātṛdvayaṃ bhavet ..
vāmatastasya kartavyaṃ mātṛdvitayameva ca .. 4 ..
3.14.d:
तस्य दक्षिणतः कार्यं तथा मातृद्वयं भवेत् ॥
वामतस्तस्य कर्तव्यं मातृद्वितयमेव च ॥ 4 ॥
3.14.m: On his right side, likewise, should be two Mothers, / and on his left side should be two Mothers as well:

3.14.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva kartavyā dakṣiṇena tu ..
jayantī vāmataḥ kāryā tathā caivāparājitā .. 5 ..
3.14.d:
जया च विजया चैव कर्तव्या दक्षिणेन तु ॥
जयन्ती वामतः कार्या तथा चैवापराजिता ॥ 5 ॥
3.14.m: Jayā and Vijayā are to be placed on the right, / and Jayantī on the left, as well as Aparājitā.

3.14.s:
sarvāśca dvibhujāḥ kāryāścaturvaktrāstathaiva ca ..
sarvāsāṃ vāmahasteṣu kapālāni tu kārayet .. 6 ..
3.14.d:
सर्वाश्च द्विभुजाः कार्याश्चतुर्वक्त्रास्तथैव च ॥
सर्वासां वामहस्तेषु कपालानि तु कारयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.14.m: All of them should be made two-armed and likewise four-faced; / in the left hands of them all one should place skull-cups.

3.14.s:
daṇḍaḥ kāryo mahārāja dakṣiṇe tu jayā kare ..
vijayāyāḥ kare khaḍgaḥ kāryo bhinnāñjanaprabhaḥ .. 7 ..
3.14.d:
दण्डः कार्यो महाराज दक्षिणे तु जया करे ॥
विजयायाः करे खड्गः कार्यो भिन्नाञ्जनप्रभः ॥ 7 ॥
3.14.m: A staff should be placed, O great king, in Jayā's right hand; / in Vijayā's hand, a sword lustrous like split collyrium should be placed.

3.14.s:
akṣamālādharakarāṃ jayantīṃ nṛpa kārayeta ..
bhindipālakarā kāryā tathā devyaparājitā .. 8 ..
3.14.d:
अक्षमालाधरकरां जयन्तीं नृप कारयेत ॥
भिन्दिपालकरा कार्या तथा देव्यपराजिता ॥ 8 ॥
3.14.m: Jayantī should be made holding a rosary in her hand, O king; / and the goddess Aparājitā should be made holding a javelin.

3.14.s:
pādapīṭhagataṃ pādaṃ sarvāsāmeva kārayet ..
dakṣiṇaṃ yānagaṃ vāmaṃ kartavyaṃ nṛpa kuñcitam .. 9 ..
3.14.d:
पादपीठगतं पादं सर्वासामेव कारयेत् ॥
दक्षिणं यानगं वामं कर्तव्यं नृप कुञ्चितम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.14.m: One foot of all of them should be placed on a footstool; / the right foot should be resting on the mount, and the left bent, O king.

3.14.s:
jayā puruṣagā kāryā vijayā kauśikopamā ..
jayantī turagārūḍhā meghagā cāparājitā .. .. 3.66.10 ..
3.14.d:
जया पुरुषगा कार्या विजया कौशिकोपमा ॥
जयन्ती तुरगारूढा मेघगा चापराजिता ॥ ॥ 3.66.10 ॥
3.14.m: Jayā should be mounted on a man; Vijayā resembles an owl; / Jayantī is mounted on a horse; and Aparājitā rides on a cloud.

3.14.s: candrāṃśugauraḥ kartavyo mahādevastu tumburuḥ .. 11 ..
3.14.d: चन्द्रांशुगौरः कर्तव्यो महादेवस्तु तुम्बुरुः ॥ 11 ॥
3.14.m: The great god Tumburu should be made white as moonbeams.

3.14.s:
devīpriyārthaṃ bhuvanasya goptā tāsāṃ sa madhye bhagavānatheśaḥ ..
bhakteṣu kāmānvibhadhannathāste sa pūjanīyastridaśārihantā .. 12 ..
3.67
vajra uvāca ..
prāguktaṃ rūpanirmāṇaṃ tvayā candrāmbunāthayoḥ ..
tayorevāparaṃ brūhi rūpamakendurūpayoḥ .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
raviḥ kāryaḥ śubhaśmaśruḥ sindūrābharaṇaprabhaḥ ..
sudīptaveśaḥ svākāraḥ sarvābharaṇasaṃyutaḥ .. 2 ..
caturbāhurmahātejāḥ kavacenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ ..
kartavyā raśanā cāsya yāviyāṅgeti saṃjñitā .. 3 ..
raśmayastasya kartavyā vāmadakṣiṇahastayoḥ ..
ūrdhvasragdāmasaṃsthānāḥ sarvapuṣpāñcitāḥ śubhāḥ..4..
surūparūpaḥ svākāro daṇḍī kāryosya vāmataḥ..
dakṣiṇe piṅgalo bhāge kartavyaścātipiṅgalaḥ ..5..
uddīptaveśau kartavyau tāvubhāvapi yādava ..
tayormūrdhani vinyastau karau kāryau vibhāvasoḥ .. 6 ..
3.14.d:
देवीप्रियार्थं भुवनस्य गोप्ता तासां स मध्ये भगवानथेशः ॥
भक्तेषु कामान्विभधन्नथास्ते स पूजनीयस्त्रिदशारिहन्ता ॥ 12 ॥
3.67
वज्र उवाच ॥
प्रागुक्तं रूपनिर्माणं त्वया चन्द्राम्बुनाथयोः ॥
तयोरेवापरं ब्रूहि रूपमकेन्दुरूपयोः ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
रविः कार्यः शुभश्मश्रुः सिन्दूराभरणप्रभः ॥
सुदीप्तवेशः स्वाकारः सर्वाभरणसंयुतः ॥ 2 ॥
चतुर्बाहुर्महातेजाः कवचेनाभिसंवृतः ॥
कर्तव्या रशना चास्य यावियाङ्गेति संज्ञिता ॥ 3 ॥
रश्मयस्तस्य कर्तव्या वामदक्षिणहस्तयोः ॥
ऊर्ध्वस्रग्दामसंस्थानाः सर्वपुष्पाञ्चिताः शुभाः॥4॥
सुरूपरूपः स्वाकारो दण्डी कार्योस्य वामतः॥
दक्षिणे पिङ्गलो भागे कर्तव्यश्चातिपिङ्गलः ॥5॥
उद्दीप्तवेशौ कर्तव्यौ तावुभावपि यादव ॥
तयोर्मूर्धनि विन्यस्तौ करौ कार्यौ विभावसोः ॥ 6 ॥
3.14.m:
For the pleasure of the goddesses, that lord, the sovereign protector of the world, resides in their midst; / granting desires to his devotees, he who slays the enemies of the gods is worthy of worship.
3.67 / Vajra said: / Previously the fashioning of the forms of the moon and the lord of the waters was described by you; / tell of that other form of the two, the sun and the moon.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Ravi should be made with an auspicious beard, shining like an ornament of vermilion, / wearing blazing attire, well-proportioned, and endowed with all ornaments,
four-armed, of great splendour, covered with armour; / and his belt should be made, which is called yaviyāṅga.
Rays should be placed in his left and right hands, / standing upwards like garlands, adorned with all flowers and auspicious.
Handsome in form and well-shaped, Daṇḍin should be placed on his left; / on the right side, Piṅgala should be placed, extremely tawny.
Both of them should be made wearing radiant attire, O descendant of Yadu; / resting on their heads, the two hands of the sun should be placed.

3.14.m:
Piṅgala is to be made with a pen and writing-leaf in hand; / the god holding a shield and spear is also carefully fashioned.
A lion-banner is to be made likewise on Sūrya's left; / and his four sons should be made at his sides:
Revanta and Yama, and the two Manus; / or Ravi, the king of planets, should be made surrounded by the planets.
Rājñī and Rikṣubhā, Chāyā, and the goddess Suvarcasā: / these four wives should also be made on either side.
In an excellent chariot with one wheel, seven horses, and marked with six lines, / the seated god should be made, having the son of Varuṇa as his charioteer.
Gāyatrī, Uṣṇih, Anuṣṭubh, Bṛhatī, Paṅkti, / Triṣṭubh, and Jagatī: the seven metres are the horses of Arka's chariot.

3.14.m: By means of the rays placed in his hands, he upholds the entire world; / and the lion on his banner is proclaimed to be Dharma itself in visible form.

3.14.m: Likewise, the god upholds the entire world situated on his belt; / Rājñī is the earth, Rikṣubhā the sky, and Chāyā is proclaimed as shadow;

3.14.m: Suvarcasā is declared to be splendour: these are the wives of that god. / The blessed lord is red in colour, his abode radiant due to his splendour.

3.68
मार्कंडेय उवाच॥
चन्द्रः श्वेतवपुः कार्यस्तथा श्वेताम्बरः प्रभुः ॥
चतुर्बाहुर्महातेजाः सर्वाभरणवांस्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
कुमुदौ च सितौ कार्यौ तस्य देवस्य हस्तयोः ॥
कान्तिर्मूर्तिमती कार्या तस्य पार्श्वे तु दक्षिणे ॥ 2 ॥
वामे शोभा तथा कार्या रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि ॥
चिह्नं तथास्य सिंहांकं वामपार्श्वैकवद्भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
दशाश्वो वा रथः कार्यो द्विचक्रोम्बरसारथी ॥
स्रजश्च त्रिमनाश्चैव वृषो वादी नरो हयः ॥ 4 ॥
अथो वाक्सप्तधातुश्च हंसो व्योमो मृग स्तथा ॥
एते ते वामतः सर्वे दश चन्द्रमसो हयाः ॥5॥
अथ वैवास्य कर्तव्या अष्टविंशतिसङ्ख्यकाः।
अत्यर्थं रूपसंयुक्ताः पत्न्यो नक्षत्रसंज्ञिताः ॥ 6 ॥
3.14.m:
Thus this form of the lord of day, who embodies the whole world, / the treasure of light, supremely blazing, the eternal sovereign of all, has been described by me.
3.68 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Candra should be made with a white body, likewise the lord dressed in white garments, / four-armed, of great splendour, and adorned with all ornaments.
Two white night-lotuses should be placed in that god's hands; / Kānti should be placed embodied at his right side;
on the left, Śobhā should likewise be placed, matchless in form on earth; / and his emblem marked with a lion should be visible on the left side alone.
Or a ten-horse chariot should be made, two-wheeled, with the sky as charioteer: / Sraj, Trimanas, Vṛṣa, Vādin, Nara, Haya,
further Vāc, Saptadhātu, Haṃsa, Vyoman, and Mṛga; / all these ten on the left are the horses of the moon.
Or twenty-eight wives, exceedingly endowed with beauty / and known as the Nakṣatras, should be made for him;

अशीतिद्व्यधिकाः कार्या भावा वा देहभेदयोः ॥
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे प्राकाम्येन नृपोडुभिः ॥ 7 ॥
कृतानि स्वशरीराणि बहूनि यदुन न्दन ॥
स्वनाथदेवरूपाणि ततस्ते दानवा हताः ॥ 8 ॥
नक्षत्रेण कृतं रूपं यस्य यस्य सुरस्य तु ॥
सा चैव देवता तस्य नक्षत्रस्य प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 9 ॥
देवासुरे ततो वृत्ते प्राकाम्येनैव यादव ॥
स्त्रीरूपधारिणो देवास्तावन्तस्तु ततः कृताः ॥ 3.68.10 ॥
सर्वलोकस्य धर्मज्ञ चन्द्रमा वै पिता स्मृतः ॥
तस्मिन्सृष्टे जगत्सर्वं परं हर्षमुपैति च ॥ 11॥
सौम्यमूर्तिः परा ज्ञेया सा च विष्णोर्महात्मनः ॥
हर्षप्रसादौ विज्ञेयौ कुमुदौ चन्द्रहस्तयोः ॥ 12 ॥
शोभाकान्ती विनिर्दिष्टे स्वरूपं भृगुनन्दन ॥
अपां सारमयत्वाद्धि शुक्लवर्णस्तु चन्द्रमाः ॥ 13 ॥
3.14.m:
or eighty-two bodily forms and states should be made. / Formerly, in the battle between the gods and asuras, O king, by willful power,
many bodies resembling their lord deity were assumed by the asterisms, / O delight of the Yadus, and then those dānavas were slain.
Whichever deity's form was assumed by a Nakṣatra, / that very deity is proclaimed as the deity of that Nakṣatra.
When the battle between the gods and asuras took place, O descendant of Yadu, / the gods then assumed female forms by willful power, in that same number.
The moon is indeed considered the father of all the world, O knower of dharma; / when he was created, the entire world attained supreme joy.
His gentle form is supreme, and should be known as belonging to the great-souled Viṣṇu; / the two white night-lotuses in Candra's hands are to be understood as joy and serenity.
Śobhā and Kānti are indicated as his own form, O descendant of Bhṛgu; / because he consists of the essence of waters, the moon is indeed white in colour.

3.69
वज्र उवाच ॥
ग्रहाणां रूपनिर्माणं समाचक्ष्व महाभुज ॥
अनेनैव प्रसङ्गेन सर्वज्ञस्त्वं मतो मम ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
भौमोऽग्नितल्पः कर्तव्यश्चाष्टाश्वे काञ्चने रथे ॥
विष्णुतल्पो बुधः कार्यो भौमतल्पे तथा रथे ॥ 2 ॥
तप्तजाम्बूनदः कार्यो द्विभुजश्च बृहस्पतिः ॥
पुस्तकं चाक्षमालां च करयोस्तस्य कारयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
सर्वाभरणयुक्तश्च तथा पीताम्बरो गुरुः ॥
अष्टाश्वे काञ्चने दिव्ये रथे दृष्टिमनोहरे ॥ 4 ॥
शुक्रः श्वेतवपुः कार्यः श्वेताम्बरधरस्तथा ॥
द्वौ करौ कथितौ तस्य निधिपुस्तकसंयुतौ ॥ 5 ॥
दशाश्वे च रथे कार्यो राजते भृगुनन्दन ॥
कृष्णवासास्तथा कृष्णः शनिः कार्यस्सिराततः ॥6॥
3.14.m:
For the ancients say that the primeval abode of the waters is nectar; that nectar is declared equal to the moon; / they declare the lion-banner to be Dharma, O king, and the directions are declared to be the horses of the hare-marked moon.
3.69
Vajra said: / Relate the fashioning of the forms of the planets, O long-armed one; / on this very occasion, I deem you to be omniscient.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Mars should be made resembling the couch of Agni, on a golden chariot with eight horses. / Mercury should be made resembling the couch of Viṣṇu, on a chariot like the couch of Mars.
Bṛhaspati should be made [colored like] refined gold and two-armed; / one should place a manuscript and a rosary in his two hands.
Guru is endowed with all ornaments and similarly clad in yellow garments, / on an eight-horse, golden, divine chariot delightful to the eye.
Venus should be made white-bodied and wearing white garments; / his two hands are described as holding a treasure and a manuscript.
And he should be placed in a chariot with ten horses, made of silver, O scion of the Bhṛgus. / Saturn should be made dark, wearing dark clothes, with bulging veins,

jaṭādharo'kṣamālī ca kamaṇḍaludharastathā ..
kṛśo'pi tejasā yuktastapasyabhiratastathā .. 3 ..
kāryā yogena cānye'pi bhaviṣyā manavaśca ye ..
sāvarṇamanutulyena kāryo rūpeṇa yādava .. 4 ..
3.14.d:
दण्डाक्षमालासंयुक्तः करद्वितयभूषितः॥
कार्ष्णायसे रथे कार्यस्तथैवाष्टभुजङ्गमे ॥ 7 ॥
रौप्यै रथे तथाष्टाश्वो राहुः कार्यो विचक्षणः ॥
केवलं मस्तकं कार्यं भुजेनैकेन संयुतम् ॥ 8 ॥
करमेकं तु कर्तव्यं तस्य शून्यं तु दक्षिणम् ॥
भौमस्य च तथा कार्यं केतो रूपं विजानता ॥ 9 ॥
केवलं चास्य कर्तव्या दशराजंस्तुरङ्गमाः ॥3.69.10॥
3.70
वज्र उवाच ॥
मनुद्वयस्य मे रूपं कथयस्वामितद्युते ॥
देवेन्द्रस्य च धर्मज्ञ यमस्याभिहितं त्वया ॥1॥
मार्कंडेय उवाच ॥
वर्तमानो मनुः कार्यो राजलक्षणसंयुतः ॥
भविष्यन्तु तथा कार्यः सर्वाभरणवर्जितः ॥ 2 ॥
जटाधरोऽक्षमाली च कमण्डलुधरस्तथा ॥
कृशोऽपि तेजसा युक्तस्तपस्यभिरतस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
कार्या योगेन चान्येऽपि भविष्या मनवश्च ये ॥
सावर्णमनुतुल्येन कार्यो रूपेण यादव ॥ 4 ॥
3.14.m:
adorned with a pair of hands holding a staff and a rosary; / he should be placed in a chariot of black iron, drawn by eight serpents.
Rāhu should be made wise, in a chariot of silver with eight horses; / he should be made as only a head, endowed with a single arm.
One hand of his, the right, should be made empty. / Ketu's form should be made by one who knows, like that of Mars,
and his chariot should have only ten horses, O king.
3.70 / Vajra said: / Tell me the form of the two Manus, O one of boundless splendor; / for those of Devendra and Yama have already been related by you, O knower of dharma.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The present Manu should be made endowed with the marks of kingship; / but the future [Manu] should be made devoid of all ornaments,
wearing matted locks, bearing a rosary and holding a water pot; / emaciated, yet endowed with spiritual luster, and absorbed in ascetic practice.
The other future Manus, too, should be made through yoga; / they should be made in a form equal to that of Manu Sāvarṇi, O descendant of Yadu.

3.14.s:
atītā manavaḥ kāryā rājalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ ..
pṛṣṭheśve sūryavatkāryo revantaśca tathā prabhuḥ .. 5 ..
3.14.d:
अतीता मनवः कार्या राजलक्षणलक्षिताः ॥
पृष्ठेश्वे सूर्यवत्कार्यो रेवन्तश्च तथा प्रभुः ॥ 5 ॥
3.14.m: The past Manus should be made marked with the characteristics of kingship. / Revanta, the lord, should be made on horseback like the Sun.

3.15.s:
3.71
vajra uvāca ..
grahāṇāṃ devatā proktā yāstvayā pūrvameva tu ..
tāsāṃ svarūpanirmāṇaṃ kathayasvāmitadyute .. 1 ..
3.15.d:
3.71
वज्र उवाच ॥
ग्रहाणां देवता प्रोक्ता यास्त्वया पूर्वमेव तु ॥
तासां स्वरूपनिर्माणं कथयस्वामितद्युते ॥ 1 ॥
3.15.m: 3.71 / Vajra said: / The deities of the planets that were spoken of earlier by you— / tell of the fashioning of their own forms, O one of boundless splendor.

3.15.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pūrvameva mayā proktaṃ rūpaṃ vahnyambunāthayoḥ ..
tathā ca kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ viṣṇudevendrayoḥ purā..2..
3.15.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पूर्वमेव मया प्रोक्तं रूपं वह्न्यम्बुनाथयोः ॥
तथा च कथितं तुभ्यं विष्णुदेवेन्द्रयोः पुरा॥2॥
3.15.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The form of the lord of fire and of the lord of water was described by me earlier, / and it was told to you previously for Viṣṇu and Devendra.

3.15.s:
caturmūrteḥ kumārasya rūpaṃ te vacmi yādava ..
kumāraśca tathā skando viśākhaśca gurustathā .. 3 ..
3.15.d:
चतुर्मूर्तेः कुमारस्य रूपं ते वच्मि यादव ॥
कुमारश्च तथा स्कन्दो विशाखश्च गुरुस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
3.15.m: I shall tell you the form of the four-bodied Kumāra, O descendant of Yadu: / Kumāra, and likewise Skanda, Viśākha, and Guha.

3.15.s:
kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ kāryaḥ śikhaṇḍakavibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
raktāmbaradharaḥ kāryo mayūravaravāhanaḥ .. 4 ..
3.15.d:
कुमारः षण्मुखः कार्यः शिखण्डकविभूषणः ॥
रक्ताम्बरधरः कार्यो मयूरवरवाहनः ॥ 4 ॥
3.15.m: Kumāra should be made six-faced, adorned with locks of hair (śikhaṇḍaka), / dressed in red garments, with the excellent peacock as his mount.

3.15.s:
kukkuṭaśca tathā ghaṇṭā tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ..
patākāvaijayantī ca śaktiḥ kāryā ca vāmayoḥ .. 5 ..
3.15.d:
कुक्कुटश्च तथा घण्टा तस्य दक्षिणहस्तयोः ॥
पताकावैजयन्ती च शक्तिः कार्या च वामयोः ॥ 5 ॥
3.15.m: A cock and a bell are in his right hands; / a flag, the Vaijayantī banner, and a spear (śakti) should be placed in his left hands.

3.15.s:
skando viśākhaśca guhaḥ kartavyaśca kumāravat ..
ṣaṇmukhāste na kartavyā na mayūragatāstathā .. 6 ..
3.15.d:
स्कन्दो विशाखश्च गुहः कर्तव्यश्च कुमारवत् ॥
षण्मुखास्ते न कर्तव्या न मयूरगतास्तथा ॥ 6 ॥
3.15.m: Skanda, Viśākha, and Guha should be made like Kumāra, / [but] they should not be made six-faced, nor mounted on peacocks.

3.15.s:
caturātmā hi bhagavānvāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
prādurbhūtaḥ kumārastu devasenāninīṣayā .. 7 ..
3.15.d:
चतुरात्मा हि भगवान्वासुदेवः सनातनः ॥
प्रादुर्भूतः कुमारस्तु देवसेनानिनीषया ॥ 7 ॥
3.15.m: For the eternal blessed Vāsudeva is fourfold; / Kumāra manifested through the desire to lead the army of the gods.

3.15.s:
aṣṭādaśabhujā kāryā bhadrakālī manoharā ..
ālīḍhasthānasaṃsthānā catuḥsiṃhe rathe sthitā .. 8 ..
3.15.d:
अष्टादशभुजा कार्या भद्रकाली मनोहरा ॥
आलीढस्थानसंस्थाना चतुःसिंहे रथे स्थिता ॥ 8 ॥
3.15.m: Charming Bhadrakālī should be made with eighteen arms, / standing in the ālīḍha posture, stationed on a chariot with four lions.

3.15.s:
akṣamālā triśūlaṃ ca khaṅgaṃ carma ca yādava ..
bāṇacāpe ca kartavye śaṅkhapadmau tathaiva ca .. 9 ..
3.15.d:
अक्षमाला त्रिशूलं च खङ्गं चर्म च यादव ॥
बाणचापे च कर्तव्ये शङ्खपद्मौ तथैव च ॥ 9 ॥
3.15.m: A rosary, a trident, a sword, and a shield, O descendant of Yadu, / an arrow and a bow should be made, and likewise a conch and a lotus,

3.15.s:
suksrucau ca tathā kāryau tathā vedīkamaṇḍalū ..
daṇḍaśaktī ca kartavye kṛṣṇājinahutāśanau .. 3.71.10 ..
3.15.d:
सुक्स्रुचौ च तथा कार्यौ तथा वेदीकमण्डलू ॥
दण्डशक्ती च कर्तव्ये कृष्णाजिनहुताशनौ ॥ 3.71.10 ॥
3.15.m: the sruc and sruva ladles should be made, and likewise the altar and a water pot, / a staff and a spear should be made, a black-antelope skin and fire.

3.15.s:
hastānāṃ bhadrakālyāstu bhavecchāntikaraḥ karaḥ ..
ekaścaiva mahābhāga ratnapātradharo bhavet .. 11 ..
3.15.d:
हस्तानां भद्रकाल्यास्तु भवेच्छान्तिकरः करः ॥
एकश्चैव महाभाग रत्नपात्रधरो भवेत् ॥ 11 ॥
3.15.m: Among the hands of Bhadrakālī, there should be a hand granting peace, / and one hand, O highly fortunate one, should hold a vessel of gems.

3.15.s:
haṃsayānena kartavyo na ca kāryaścaturmukhaḥ ..
brahmoktamaparaṃ rūpaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prajāpateḥ .. 12 ..
3.15.d:
हंसयानेन कर्तव्यो न च कार्यश्चतुर्मुखः ॥
ब्रह्मोक्तमपरं रूपं सर्वं कार्यं प्रजापतेः ॥ 12 ॥
3.15.m: He should be made riding on a goose (haṃsa), and should not be made four-faced; / every other form described for Brahmā should be made for Prajāpati.

3.15.s:
vināyakastu kartavyo gajavaktraścaturbhujaḥ ..
śūlakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ .. 13 ..
3.15.d:
विनायकस्तु कर्तव्यो गजवक्त्रश्चतुर्भुजः ॥
शूलकं चाक्षमालां च तस्य दक्षिणहस्तयोः ॥ 13 ॥
3.15.m: Vināyaka should be made elephant-faced and four-armed; / a small pike and a rosary should be in his right hands,

3.15.s:
pātraṃ modakapūrṇaṃ tu paraśuścaiva vāmataḥ ..
dantaścāsya na kartavyo vāmo ripuniṣūdana .. 14 ..
3.15.d:
पात्रं मोदकपूर्णं तु परशुश्चैव वामतः ॥
दन्तश्चास्य न कर्तव्यो वामो रिपुनिषूदन ॥ 14 ॥
3.15.m: a bowl filled with modakas and an axe on the left; / and his left tusk must not be made, O slayer of foes.

3.15.s:
pādapīṭhakṛtaḥ pāda eka āsanago bhavet ..
pūrṇamodakapātraṃ tu karāgre tasya kārayeta .. 15 ..
3.15.d:
पादपीठकृतः पाद एक आसनगो भवेत् ॥
पूर्णमोदकपात्रं तु कराग्रे तस्य कारयेत ॥ 15 ॥
3.15.m: One foot should be placed on a footstool, and one on the seat; / one should place a bowl filled with modakas at the tip of his trunk (kara).

3.15.s:
lambodarastathā kāryaḥ stabdhakarṇaśca yādava ..
vyāghracarmāmbaradharaḥ sarpayajñopavītivān .. 16 ..
3.15.d:
लम्बोदरस्तथा कार्यः स्तब्धकर्णश्च यादव ॥
व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरधरः सर्पयज्ञोपवीतिवान् ॥ 16 ॥
3.15.m: He should be made pot-bellied and stiff-eared, O descendant of Yadu, / wearing a tiger-skin garment, with a snake as his sacred thread.

3.15.s:
viśvakarmā nu kartavyaḥ sūryarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ..
sa daśapāṇirdvibhujastejomūrtidharo bhavet .. 17 ..
3.15.d:
विश्वकर्मा नु कर्तव्यः सूर्यरूपधरः प्रभुः ॥
स दशपाणिर्द्विभुजस्तेजोमूर्तिधरो भवेत् ॥ 17 ॥
3.15.m: Viśvakarman, the lord, should be made bearing the form of the Sun; / he may have ten hands or two arms, bearing a form of light.

3.15.s:
viśvaṃ karoti vai yasmādviśvakarmā tataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
viśvakṛdbhagavānviṣṇurviśvakarmā sa ucyate .. 18 ..
3.72
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
vasūnāṃ deva me rūpaṃ tathaivāṅgirasaṃ śubham ..
viśveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ rudrāṇāmapi devatāḥ..1..
bhṛgūṇāmatha sādhyānāṃ cādityānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
marutāṃ ca tathā rūpamācakṣva surapūjita.. 2..
mārkaḍeya uvāca ..
prājāpatyena rūpeṇa dharo nāma vasurbhavet ..
vaiṣṇavena ca rūpeṇa dhruvo nāma prakīrtitaḥ..3..
somaścāndreṇa rūpeṇa vāyavyena tathā'nilaḥ ..
āgneyenānalaḥ kāryaḥ prabhāso vāruṇena ca..4..
viśvedevāstathā kāryāḥ śakrarūpadharāḥ surāḥ..
tiryaglalāṭenākṣṇā ca nāgarājo vivarjitaḥ .. 5 ..
jīvarūpeṇa kartavyā devāścāṅgirasastathā ..
māheśvareṇa rudrāśca sādhyākṣā vaiṣṇavena tu .. 6 ..
3.15.d:
विश्वं करोति वै यस्माद्विश्वकर्मा ततः स्मृतः ॥
विश्वकृद्भगवान्विष्णुर्विश्वकर्मा स उच्यते ॥ 18 ॥
3.72
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
वसूनां देव मे रूपं तथैवाङ्गिरसं शुभम् ॥
विश्वेषां चैव देवानां रुद्राणामपि देवताः॥1॥
भृगूणामथ साध्यानां चादित्यानां तथैव च ॥
मरुतां च तथा रूपमाचक्ष्व सुरपूजित॥ 2॥
मार्कडेय उवाच ॥
प्राजापत्येन रूपेण धरो नाम वसुर्भवेत् ॥
वैष्णवेन च रूपेण ध्रुवो नाम प्रकीर्तितः॥3॥
सोमश्चान्द्रेण रूपेण वायव्येन तथाऽनिलः ॥
आग्नेयेनानलः कार्यः प्रभासो वारुणेन च॥4॥
विश्वेदेवास्तथा कार्याः शक्ररूपधराः सुराः॥
तिर्यग्ललाटेनाक्ष्णा च नागराजो विवर्जितः ॥ 5 ॥
जीवरूपेण कर्तव्या देवाश्चाङ्गिरसस्तथा ॥
माहेश्वरेण रुद्राश्च साध्याक्षा वैष्णवेन तु ॥ 6 ॥
3.15.m:
Because he makes the universe, he is therefore remembered as Viśvakarman; / the creator of the universe is the blessed Viṣṇu: he is called Viśvakarman.
3.72 / Vajra said: / Tell me the auspicious form of the Vasus, O god, and likewise of the Āṅgirases, / and the deities of the Viśvedevas and also of the Rudras,
and of the Bhṛgus, the Sādhyas, and the Ādityas, / as well as the form of the Maruts, O one worshipped by the gods.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Vasu named Dhara should have the form of Prajāpati; / the one named Dhruva is proclaimed to have the form of Viṣṇu;
Soma with the form of the Moon, and Anila with that of Vāyu; / Anala should be made with the form of Agni, and Prabhāsa with that of Varuṇa.
The Viśvedevas, the gods, should be made bearing the form of Śakra; / the king of nāgas is devoid of a transverse eye on the forehead.
And the Āṅgiras gods should be made with the form of Jīva (Bṛhaspati); / the Rudras with the form of Maheśvara; and the Sādhyas with that of Viṣṇu.

3.15.s:
ādityāḥ sūryarūpeṇa ceti dvādaśa yādava ..
pṛthakkriyāyāṃ teṣāṃ tu navārkasadṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ ..7..
viṇvindravaruṇāḥ kāryāḥ yathā pūrvaṃ mayeritāḥ ..
kartavyāḥ śukrarūpeṇa maruto nāma devatāḥ .. 8 ..
3.73
.. vajra uvāca ..
anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ rūpanirmoṇameva ca ..
kathayasva mahābhāga tvaṃ hi sarvaviducyase .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
prājāpatyena rūpeṇa kartavyaḥ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ ..
aditirditirdanuḥ kāṣṭhā danāyuḥ siṃhikā muniḥ..2..
kadrūḥ krodhā darā prādhā vinatā surabhiḥ khaśā ..
sarvāḥ surūpāḥ kartavyā dvibhujāḥ pūrvamātaraḥ .. 3 ..
aditiśca ditiścaiva vinatā surabhistathā ..
dṛṣṭirāsāṃ tu kartavyā saumyā yādavanandana .. 4 ..
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa sarvā vai devamātaraḥ ..
kartavyā yādavaśreṣṭha rūpanirmāṇakarmaṇā .. 5 ..
3.15.d:
आदित्याः सूर्यरूपेण चेति द्वादश यादव ॥
पृथक्क्रियायां तेषां तु नवार्कसदृशाः स्मृताः ॥7॥
विण्विन्द्रवरुणाः कार्याः यथा पूर्वं मयेरिताः ॥
कर्तव्याः शुक्ररूपेण मरुतो नाम देवताः ॥ 8 ॥
3.73
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
अन्येषामपि देवानां रूपनिर्मोणमेव च ॥
कथयस्व महाभाग त्वं हि सर्वविदुच्यसे ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
प्राजापत्येन रूपेण कर्तव्यः कश्यपः प्रभुः ॥
अदितिर्दितिर्दनुः काष्ठा दनायुः सिंहिका मुनिः॥2॥
कद्रूः क्रोधा दरा प्राधा विनता सुरभिः खशा ॥
सर्वाः सुरूपाः कर्तव्या द्विभुजाः पूर्वमातरः ॥ 3 ॥
अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव विनता सुरभिस्तथा ॥
दृष्टिरासां तु कर्तव्या सौम्या यादवनन्दन ॥ 4 ॥
अनेनैव तु रूपेण सर्वा वै देवमातरः ॥
कर्तव्या यादवश्रेष्ठ रूपनिर्माणकर्मणा ॥ 5 ॥
3.15.m:
The twelve Ādityas, O Yādava, [should be made] in the form of Sūrya. / When they are made separately, however, they are traditionally held to resemble the rising sun.
Viṣṇu, Indra, and Varuṇa should be made as described by me previously. / The deities called Maruts should be made in the form of Śukra.
3.73 / Vajra spoke: / Describe, O highly fortunate one, the fashioning of the forms of the other gods as well; / for you are said to be all-knowing.
Mārkaṇḍeya spoke: / Lord Kaśyapa should be made in the form of Prajāpati. / Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kāṣṭhā, Danāyu, Siṃhikā, Muni,
Kadrū, Krodhā, Darā, Prādhā, Vinatā, Surabhi, and Khaśā— / all these primeval mothers should be made beautiful and two-armed.
Aditi, Diti, Vinatā, and Surabhi— / their gaze should be made gentle, O delighter of the Yādavas.
Indeed, all the mothers of the gods should be made / with this very form in the act of fashioning images, O best of the Yādavas.

3.15.s:
kaśyapasyāparāḥ patnyaḥ kāryā vyākulalocanāḥ ..
viṣṇurūpadharaḥ kāryo dhruvo grahagaṇeśvaraḥ .. 6 ..
cakraraśmikaraḥ śrīmāndvibhujaḥ saumyadarśanaḥ ..
bhaviṣyamanurūpeṇa kāryo'gastyo mahāmuniḥ .. 7 ..
rūpaṃ tadevaṃ kathitaṃ bhṛgvādīnāṃ mahātmanām ..
śukraputrau jayantaśca kartavyo rūpasaṃyutaḥ .. 8 ..
cāpabāṇakaraḥ śrīmāndvibhujaḥ saumyadarśanaḥ ..
balo yamasutaḥ kāryaścarmaśūladharaḥ prabhuḥ .. 9 ..
puṣkaraśca tathā kāryaḥ padmapatrasamaprabhaḥ ..
khaḍgaṃ ca pustakaṃ cobhau karayostasya kārayeta .. 3.73.10 ..
candraputrī tathā jyotsnā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ..
vāmapārśve tu kartavyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇā .. 11 ..
surūparūpaḥ kartavyo ratnapātrakaro vibhuḥ ..
dvidaṃṣṭrāyuktavadano dhanādirnalakūbaraḥ ..12..
3.15.d:
कश्यपस्यापराः पत्न्यः कार्या व्याकुललोचनाः ॥
विष्णुरूपधरः कार्यो ध्रुवो ग्रहगणेश्वरः ॥ 6 ॥
चक्ररश्मिकरः श्रीमान्द्विभुजः सौम्यदर्शनः ॥
भविष्यमनुरूपेण कार्योऽगस्त्यो महामुनिः ॥ 7 ॥
रूपं तदेवं कथितं भृग्वादीनां महात्मनाम् ॥
शुक्रपुत्रौ जयन्तश्च कर्तव्यो रूपसंयुतः ॥ 8 ॥
चापबाणकरः श्रीमान्द्विभुजः सौम्यदर्शनः ॥
बलो यमसुतः कार्यश्चर्मशूलधरः प्रभुः ॥ 9 ॥
पुष्करश्च तथा कार्यः पद्मपत्रसमप्रभः ॥
खड्गं च पुस्तकं चोभौ करयोस्तस्य कारयेत ॥ 3.73.10 ॥
चन्द्रपुत्री तथा ज्योत्स्ना रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि ॥
वामपार्श्वे तु कर्तव्या सर्वाभरणभूषणा ॥ 11 ॥
सुरूपरूपः कर्तव्यो रत्नपात्रकरो विभुः ॥
द्विदंष्ट्रायुक्तवदनो धनादिर्नलकूबरः ॥12॥
3.15.m:
The other wives of Kaśyapa should be made with agitated eyes. / Dhruva, the lord of the planetary host, should be made bearing the form of Viṣṇu,
holding rays [of light] like a discus, glorious, two-armed, and of gentle appearance. / The great sage Agastya should be made in the form of the future Manu.
The form of the noble [sages] beginning with Bhṛgu has thus been described. / The two sons of Śukra and Jayanta should be made endowed with beauty,
holding a bow and arrow, glorious, two-armed, and of gentle appearance. / Bala, the son of Yama, the lord, should be made holding a shield and spear.
Puṣkara should be made with a radiance like a lotus petal; / one should cause both a sword and a book to be placed in his hands.
And Jyotsnā, daughter of the Moon, incomparable in beauty on earth, / should be made on his left side, adorned with all ornaments.
Nalakūbara, [son of] Dhanada and others, the lord, should be made handsome in form, / holding a jewel-vessel, his face having two tusks.

3.15.s:
dhanadasya tu rūpeṇa maṇibhadraṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
na kāryā śibikā tasya sabhāryo naravāhanaḥ .. 13 ..
vāyuputrastu kartavyo vāyurūpaḥ purojavaḥ ..
atīva rūpavānkāryo varcāḥ somasutaḥ prabhuḥ .. 14 ..
līlākamalapāṇistu varcasvī yena jāyate ..
nandī kāryastrinetrastu caturbāhurmahābhujaḥ .. 15 ..
sindūrāruṇasaṅkāśo vyāghracarmāmbaracchadaḥ ..
triśūlabhindipālau ca karayostasya kārayet .. 16 ..
śirogataṃ tṛtīyantu tarjayantaṃ tathā parama ..
ālokamānaṃ kartavyaṃ dūrādāgāmikaṃ janam .. 17 ..
anenaiva ca rūpeṇa vīrabhadraṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
upariṣṭātpravakṣyāmi dharmarūpamahaṃ tava .. 18 ..
3.15.d:
धनदस्य तु रूपेण मणिभद्रं विदुर्बुधाः ॥
न कार्या शिबिका तस्य सभार्यो नरवाहनः ॥ 13 ॥
वायुपुत्रस्तु कर्तव्यो वायुरूपः पुरोजवः ॥
अतीव रूपवान्कार्यो वर्चाः सोमसुतः प्रभुः ॥ 14 ॥
लीलाकमलपाणिस्तु वर्चस्वी येन जायते ॥
नन्दी कार्यस्त्रिनेत्रस्तु चतुर्बाहुर्महाभुजः ॥ 15 ॥
सिन्दूरारुणसङ्काशो व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरच्छदः ॥
त्रिशूलभिन्दिपालौ च करयोस्तस्य कारयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
शिरोगतं तृतीयन्तु तर्जयन्तं तथा परम ॥
आलोकमानं कर्तव्यं दूरादागामिकं जनम् ॥ 17 ॥
अनेनैव च रूपेण वीरभद्रं विदुर्बुधाः ॥
उपरिष्टात्प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्मरूपमहं तव ॥ 18 ॥
3.15.m:
The wise know Maṇibhadra to have the form of Dhanada; / he should not have a litter, [but] have a human mount, accompanied by his wife.
The son of Vāyu, Purojava, should be made with the form of Vāyu. / The lord Varcas, son of Soma, should be made exceedingly handsome,
with a play-lotus in his hand, so that he appears radiant. / Nandī should be made three-eyed, four-armed, and mighty-armed,
resembling red vermilion, wearing a tiger-skin as a garment; / and one should place a trident and a bhindipāla javelin in his hands,
the third [hand] placed upon his head, and the other gesturing threateningly; / he should be made looking from afar at people who are approaching.
By this very form the wise know Vīrabhadra. / Later on I will declare to you the form of Dharma.

3.15.s:
arthaḥ kāryastu rūpeṇa dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ ..
kāmadevastu kartavyo rūpeṇāpratimo bhuvi .. 19 ..
3.15.d:
अर्थः कार्यस्तु रूपेण धनदस्य महात्मनः ॥
कामदेवस्तु कर्तव्यो रूपेणाप्रतिमो भुवि ॥ 19 ॥
3.15.m: Artha should be made in the form of the noble Dhanada. / Kāmadeva should be made incomparable in beauty on earth;

3.15.s:
aṣṭabāhuḥ sa kartavyaḥ śaṅkhapadmavibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
cāpabāṇakaraścaiva madādañcitalocanaḥ .. 3.73.20 ..
3.15.d:
अष्टबाहुः स कर्तव्यः शङ्खपद्मविभूषणः ॥
चापबाणकरश्चैव मदादञ्चितलोचनः ॥ 3.73.20 ॥
3.15.m: he should be made eight-armed, adorned with a conch and a lotus, / holding a bow and arrow, his eyes slanted with passion.

3.15.s:
ratiḥ prītistathā śaktirmadaśaktistathojjvalā ..
catasrastasya kartavyāḥ patnyo rūpamanoharāḥ .. 21 ..
3.15.d:
रतिः प्रीतिस्तथा शक्तिर्मदशक्तिस्तथोज्ज्वला ॥
चतस्रस्तस्य कर्तव्याः पत्न्यो रूपमनोहराः ॥ 21 ॥
3.15.m: Rati, Prīti, Śakti, and the radiant Madaśakti— / four wives, captivating in beauty, should be made for him.

3.15.s:
catvāraśca karāstasya kāryā bhāryāstanopagāḥ ..
ketuśca makaraḥ kāryaḥ pañcabāṇa mukho mahān .. 22 ..
3.15.d:
चत्वारश्च करास्तस्य कार्या भार्यास्तनोपगाः ॥
केतुश्च मकरः कार्यः पञ्चबाण मुखो महान् ॥ 22 ॥
3.15.m: And four of his hands should be made touching the breasts of his wives; / his emblem should be made a makara, the great [god] having five arrows as his mouth.

3.15.s:
kareṇa kaṭigenātha nidrāṃ vāmena kārayet ..
dakṣiṇe tu tathā pārśve tasyāḥ saṅkarṣaṇo bhavet .. 23 ..
3.15.d:
करेण कटिगेनाथ निद्रां वामेन कारयेत् ॥
दक्षिणे तु तथा पार्श्वे तस्याः सङ्कर्षणो भवेत् ॥ 23 ॥
3.15.m: Then, one should make Nidrā with her left hand placed upon her hip; / on her right side Saṃkarṣaṇa should be present,

3.15.s:
vāsudevastathā vāme maikāneśā tathā sutaḥ ..
rūpaṃ lakṣmyāḥ pravakṣyāmi upariṣṭāttavānagha .. 294 ..
3.15.d:
वासुदेवस्तथा वामे मैकानेशा तथा सुतः ॥
रूपं लक्ष्म्याः प्रवक्ष्यामि उपरिष्टात्तवानघ ॥ 294 ॥
3.15.m: and Vāsudeva on her left, and likewise his son [...]. / I will declare the form of Lakṣmī to you later, O sinless one.

3.15.s:
caturbhujā ca kartavyā tathā devī sarasvatī. ..
akṣamālā triśūlaṃ ca pustakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum .. 25 ..
3.15.d:
चतुर्भुजा च कर्तव्या तथा देवी सरस्वती॥।
अक्षमाला त्रिशूलं च पुस्तकं च कमण्डलुम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.15.m: And the goddess Sarasvatī should be made four-armed, / [holding] a rosary, a trident, a book, and a water-pot;

3.15.s:
tasyā kareṣu kāryāṇi yathāvadyadunandana ..
kāryā sakalaśā devī vāruṇī cātisundarī .. 26 ..
3.15.d:
तस्या करेषु कार्याणि यथावद्यदुनन्दन ॥
कार्या सकलशा देवी वारुणी चातिसुन्दरी ॥ 26 ॥
3.15.m: these should be properly placed in her hands, O delighter of the Yadus. / Goddess Vāruṇī should be made complete with all parts and exceedingly beautiful.

3.15.s:
lambodarī tu kartavyā raktāmbarapayodharā ..
śūlahastā mahābhāgā bhujapraharaṇā tathā .. 27 ..
3.15.d:
लम्बोदरी तु कर्तव्या रक्ताम्बरपयोधरा ॥
शूलहस्ता महाभागा भुजप्रहरणा तथा ॥ 27 ॥
3.15.m: She should be made pot-bellied, her breasts covered by a red garment, / spear in hand, highly fortunate, with arms used as weapons;

3.15.s:
bṛhadrathā ca kartavyā bahubāhustathaiva sā ..
cāmuṇḍā kathitā saiva sarvasattvavaśaṅkarī .. 28 ..
3.15.d:
बृहद्रथा च कर्तव्या बहुबाहुस्तथैव सा ॥
चामुण्डा कथिता सैव सर्वसत्त्ववशङ्करी ॥ 28 ॥
3.15.m: she should be made with a great chariot and with many arms. / She is called Cāmuṇḍā, subduer of all beings;

3.15.s:
tathaivāntramukhī śuṣkā śuṣkā kāryā viśeṣataḥ ..
bahubāhuyutā devī bhujagaiḥ pariveṣṭitā .. 29 ..
3.15.d:
तथैवान्त्रमुखी शुष्का शुष्का कार्या विशेषतः ॥
बहुबाहुयुता देवी भुजगैः परिवेष्टिता ॥ 29 ॥
3.15.m: likewise [she should be made] with entrails at her mouth, and especially emaciated, / the goddess endowed with many arms, encircled by serpents,

3.15.s:
kapālamālinī bhīmā tathā khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇī ..
śivā dūtī tu kartavyā śṛgālavadanā śubhā .. 3.73.30 ..
3.15.d:
कपालमालिनी भीमा तथा खट्वाङ्गधारिणी ॥
शिवा दूती तु कर्तव्या शृगालवदना शुभा ॥ 3.73.30 ॥
3.15.m: wearing a garland of skulls, terrifying, and holding a skull-topped club. / Śivadūtī should be made auspicious, with the face of a jackal,

3.15.s:
ālīḍhasthānasaṃsthānā tathā rājaṃścaturbhujā..
asṛkpātradharā devī khaḍgaśūladharā tathā .. 31 ..
3.15.d:
आलीढस्थानसंस्थाना तथा राजंश्चतुर्भुजा॥
असृक्पात्रधरा देवी खड्गशूलधरा तथा ॥ 31 ॥
3.15.m: standing in the ālīḍha posture, four-armed, O king, / the goddess holding a blood-bowl, and also holding a sword and a trident,

3.15.s:
caturthaṃ tu karaṃ tasyāstathā kāryaṃ tu sāmiṣam ..
devatulyena cihnena yathārūpeṇa mātaraḥ .. 32 ..
3.15.d:
चतुर्थं तु करं तस्यास्तथा कार्यं तु सामिषम् ॥
देवतुल्येन चिह्नेन यथारूपेण मातरः ॥ 32 ॥
3.15.m: and her fourth hand should be made holding raw flesh. / With signs equal to the gods and corresponding to their forms, the mothers

3.15.s:
kartavyā devanāmāṅkā yā mayā te puroditāḥ ..
asṛkpātrakarāḥ kāryāḥ sāmiṣaiśca tathā karaiḥ .. 33 ..
3.15.d:
कर्तव्या देवनामाङ्का या मया ते पुरोदिताः ॥
असृक्पात्रकराः कार्याः सामिषैश्च तथा करैः ॥ 33 ॥
3.15.m: marked with the names of the gods should be made, as previously described by me to you; / they should be made holding a blood-bowl and with hands [holding] raw flesh,

3.15.s:
nṛtyamānā mahābhāgā yāsāṃ rūpaṃ tu noditam..
pūrvā gajagatā bālā raktavarṇā tu digbhavet .. 34 ..
3.15.d:
नृत्यमाना महाभागा यासां रूपं तु नोदितम्॥
पूर्वा गजगता बाला रक्तवर्णा तु दिग्भवेत् ॥ 34 ॥
3.15.m: dancing, highly fortunate, whose forms have not yet been described. / The eastern direction should be a red-complexioned maiden riding an elephant;

3.15.s:
kareṇugā bṛhatkanyā padmābhā pūrvadakṣiṇā ..
rathasthā dakṣiṇā pītā tathā syātprāptayauvanā .. 35 ..
3.15.d:
करेणुगा बृहत्कन्या पद्माभा पूर्वदक्षिणा ॥
रथस्था दक्षिणा पीता तथा स्यात्प्राप्तयौवना ॥ 35 ॥
3.15.m: the south-eastern should be a large maiden riding a female elephant, lotus-hued; / the southern should be standing in a chariot, yellow, and having attained youth;

3.15.s:
uṣṭragā kṛṣṇapītā ca varuṇā yāmyapaścimā ..
yauvanādvicyutā kṛṣṇā paścimā turagasthitā .. 36 ..
3.15.d:
उष्ट्रगा कृष्णपीता च वरुणा याम्यपश्चिमा ॥
यौवनाद्विच्युता कृष्णा पश्चिमा तुरगस्थिता ॥ 36 ॥
3.15.m: the south-western should be riding a camel, dark yellow, and [like] Varuṇa; / the western should be seated on a horse, dark, and past her youth;

3.15.s:
āsannapalitā nīlā vaḍavā yadunandana ..
śvetā narabhṛtā vṛddhā tathā bhavati cottarā .. 37 ..
3.15.d:
आसन्नपलिता नीला वडवा यदुनन्दन ॥
श्वेता नरभृता वृद्धा तथा भवति चोत्तरा ॥ 37 ॥
3.15.m: the north-western [should be] blue, approaching grey-haired age, riding a mare, O delighter of the Yadus; / and the northern becomes white, borne by a human, and old;

3.15.s:
ativṛddhā vṛṣasthā ca śuklā pūrvottarā bhavet ..
adhastātpṛthivī tulyā cordhvā gaganasaṃsthitā .. 38 ..
3.15.d:
अतिवृद्धा वृषस्था च शुक्ला पूर्वोत्तरा भवेत् ॥
अधस्तात्पृथिवी तुल्या चोर्ध्वा गगनसंस्थिता ॥ 38 ॥
3.15.m: the north-eastern should be extremely old, seated on a bull, and white; / the downward [direction] resembles the earth, and the upward stands in the sky.

3.15.s:
kālaḥ karālavadano nityagaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ...
pāśahastaśca kartavyaḥ sarpavṛścikaromavān .. 39 ..
3.15.d:
कालः करालवदनो नित्यगश्च विभीषणः ॥।
पाशहस्तश्च कर्तव्यः सर्पवृश्चिकरोमवान् ॥ 39 ॥
3.15.m: Kāla has a terrifying face, moves constantly, is dreadful, / should be made holding a noose in his hand, with body hair like serpents and scorpions.

3.15.s:
jvarastripādaḥ kartavyastrinetrairvadanaistribhiḥ ..
bhasmapraharaṇo raudrastribāhurvyākulekṣaṇaḥ .. 3.73.40 ..
3.15.d:
ज्वरस्त्रिपादः कर्तव्यस्त्रिनेत्रैर्वदनैस्त्रिभिः ॥
भस्मप्रहरणो रौद्रस्त्रिबाहुर्व्याकुलेक्षणः ॥ 3.73.40 ॥
3.15.m: Jvara should be made three-legged, with three three-eyed faces, / armed with ashes, ferocious, three-armed, with agitated eyes.

3.15.s:
dhanvantariśca kartavyaḥ surūpaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ..
karadvayagataṃ cāsya sāmṛtaṃ kalaśaṃ bhavet .. 41 ..
3.15.d:
धन्वन्तरिश्च कर्तव्यः सुरूपः प्रियदर्शनः ॥
करद्वयगतं चास्य सामृतं कलशं भवेत् ॥ 41 ॥
3.15.m: Dhanvantari should be made handsome and pleasant to behold; / in his two hands there should be a vessel filled with nectar.

3.15.s:
sāmavedastu kartavyaḥ kiṃ tu śvavadanaḥ prabhuḥ ..
atha vā devarūpeṇa vedāḥ kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 42 ..
3.15.d:
सामवेदस्तु कर्तव्यः किं तु श्ववदनः प्रभुः ॥
अथ वा देवरूपेण वेदाः कार्या विचक्षणैः ॥ 42 ॥
3.15.m: The Sāmaveda, the lord, should indeed be made with the face of a dog; / or rather, the Vedas should be made by the discerning in the form of gods.

3.15.s:
ṛgvedastu smṛto brahmā yajurvedastu vāsavaḥ ..
sāmavedastathā viṣṇuḥ śambhuścātharvaṇo bhavet .. 43 ..
3.15.d:
ऋग्वेदस्तु स्मृतो ब्रह्मा यजुर्वेदस्तु वासवः ॥
सामवेदस्तथा विष्णुः शम्भुश्चाथर्वणो भवेत् ॥ 43 ॥
3.15.m:
The Ṛgveda is recorded as Brahmā, the Yajurveda as Vāsava,
the Sāmaveda as Viṣṇu, and the Atharvaveda should be Śambhu.

3.15.s:
śikṣā prajāpatirjñeyā kalpo brahmā prakīrtitaḥ ..
sarasvatī vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ .. 44 ..
3.15.d:
शिक्षा प्रजापतिर्ज्ञेया कल्पो ब्रह्मा प्रकीर्तितः ॥
सरस्वती व्याकरणं निरुक्तं वरुणः प्रभुः ॥ 44 ॥
3.15.m:
Phonetics should be known as Prajāpati; ritual is declared to be Brahmā;
grammar is Sarasvatī; the etymological text is lord Varuṇa.

3.15.s:
chando kṣitistathaivāgnirjyotiṣaṃ bhagavānraviḥ ..
mīmāṃsā bhagavānsomo nyāyamārgaḥ samīraṇaḥ .. 45 ..
3.15.d:
छन्दो क्षितिस्तथैवाग्निर्ज्योतिषं भगवान्रविः ॥
मीमांसा भगवान्सोमो न्यायमार्गः समीरणः ॥ 45 ॥
3.15.m:
Metre is the earth, and fire likewise; astronomy is the blessed sun;
exegesis is the blessed moon; the method of logic is the wind.

3.15.s:
dharmaśca dharmaśāstrāṇi purāṇaṃ ca tathā manuḥ ..
itihāsaṃ prajādhyakṣo dhanurvedaṃ śatakratuḥ .. 46 ..
3.15.d:
धर्मश्च धर्मशास्त्राणि पुराणं च तथा मनुः ॥
इतिहासं प्रजाध्यक्षो धनुर्वेदं शतक्रतुः ॥ 46 ॥
3.15.m:
The legal treatises are Dharma, and the Purāṇa is Manu;
epic is the lord of creatures; archery is Śatakratu.

3.15.s:
āyurvedastathā sākṣāddevo dhanvantariḥ prabhuḥ ..
phalavedaṃ mahī devī nṛtyaśāstraṃ maheśvaraḥ .. 47 ..
3.15.d:
आयुर्वेदस्तथा साक्षाद्देवो धन्वन्तरिः प्रभुः ॥
फलवेदं मही देवी नृत्यशास्त्रं महेश्वरः ॥ 47 ॥
3.15.m:
Medicine is the lord god Dhanvantari in visible form;
the Veda of agriculture is the goddess Earth; the treatise on dance is Maheśvara.

3.15.s:
saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pāñcarātraṃ rudraḥ pāśupataṃ tathā ..
pātañjalamanantaśca sāṃkhyaśca kapilo muniḥ .. 48..
3.15.d:
सङ्कर्षणः पाञ्चरात्रं रुद्रः पाशुपतं तथा ॥
पातञ्जलमनन्तश्च सांख्यश्च कपिलो मुनिः ॥ 48॥
3.15.m:
Saṃkarṣaṇa is the Pāñcarātra, and Rudra is the Pāśupata;
Ananta is Patañjali's [treatise], and the sage Kapila is Sāṃkhya.

3.15.s:
arthaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi dhanādhyakṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
kalāśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kāmadevo jagadguruḥ .. 49 ..
3.15.d:
अर्थशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि धनाध्यक्षः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
कलाशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि कामदेवो जगद्गुरुः ॥ 49 ॥
3.15.m:
All treatises on statecraft are proclaimed to be the lord of wealth;
all treatises on the arts are the world-teacher Kāmadeva.

3.15.s:
anyāni yāni śāstrāṇi yatkartṝṇi pracakṣate..
sa caiva devatā tasya śāstra kāvyasya dehavat..3.73.50..
3.15.d:
अन्यानि यानि शास्त्राणि यत्कर्तॄणि प्रचक्षते॥
स चैव देवता तस्य शास्त्र काव्यस्य देहवत्॥3.73.50॥
3.15.m:
Whatever other treatises they declare according to their authors,
that very deity of that treatise or poetic composition is embodied.

3.15.s:
rūpaṃ tu kālāvayavasya kāryaṃ svadevatārūpapasamaṃ ripughna ..
etaṃ tavoktaṃ surasattamānāṃ rūpaṃ mayā te yaduvaṃśacandra .. 51..
3.74
vajra uvāca ..
liṅgasya rūpanirmāṇaṃ kathayasva mamānagha .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
liṅge hi pūjitaṃ pūjā kṛtā tu jagato bhavet ..
bhogosya vṛttaḥ kartavyo bhāgamaṣṭāsrameva tu .. 2 ..
caturasraṃ tathā bhāgaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūridakṣiṇama ..
vṛttaṃ dṛśyaṃ ta kartavyaṃ aṣṭāsraṃ piṇḍikāgatam .. 3 ..
caturasraṃ tu kartavyaṃ brahmapīṭhagataṃ tathā ..
adhastādbhadrapīṭhasya brahmapīṭhaṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 4 ..
liṅgopariṣṭāttu gatā purastāllekhā suvṛttā tu tathaiva kāryā ..
ūrdhvāyatā buddhiguṇā tathāsyā yā brahmasūtre vibudhaiḥ pradiṣṭā..5..
3.15.d:
रूपं तु कालावयवस्य कार्यं स्वदेवतारूपपसमं रिपुघ्न ॥
एतं तवोक्तं सुरसत्तमानां रूपं मया ते यदुवंशचन्द्र ॥ 51॥
3.74
वज्र उवाच ॥
लिङ्गस्य रूपनिर्माणं कथयस्व ममानघ ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
लिङ्गे हि पूजितं पूजा कृता तु जगतो भवेत् ॥
भोगोस्य वृत्तः कर्तव्यो भागमष्टास्रमेव तु ॥ 2 ॥
चतुरस्रं तथा भागं कर्तव्यं भूरिदक्षिणम ॥
वृत्तं दृश्यं त कर्तव्यं अष्टास्रं पिण्डिकागतम् ॥ 3 ॥
चतुरस्रं तु कर्तव्यं ब्रह्मपीठगतं तथा ॥
अधस्ताद्भद्रपीठस्य ब्रह्मपीठं विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 4 ॥
लिङ्गोपरिष्टात्तु गता पुरस्ताल्लेखा सुवृत्ता तु तथैव कार्या ॥
ऊर्ध्वायता बुद्धिगुणा तथास्या या ब्रह्मसूत्रे विबुधैः प्रदिष्टा॥5॥
3.15.m:
The form of a division of time should be made equal to the form of its presiding deity, O slayer of foes!
This form of the foremost gods has been described by me to you, O moon of the Yadu lineage!
3.74
Vajra said:
Tell me the making of the form of the liṅga, O sinless one!
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
For when worship is offered to the liṅga, worship is rendered to the universe.
Its shaft should be made round, and one part octagonal,
and one part should be made square, O you of bountiful sacrificial fees!
The round part should be made visible; the octagonal part enters the pedestal;
and the square part should be made to enter the base of Brahmā.
The wise know the base of Brahmā to be beneath the auspicious pedestal.
Going above the liṅga, in front, a well-rounded line should likewise be made;
it extends upwards, three times in length, which is prescribed by the wise on the cord of Brahmā.

3.15.s:
iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare tṛtīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde liṅgarūpanirmāṇo nāma catuḥsaptatitamo 'dhyāya ..74..
3.75
vajra uvāca ..
vyomarūpaṃ samācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara..
vyomni tu pūjite pūjā kṛtā syājjagato bhavet.. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
caturasraṃ bhavenmūle tato vṛttaṃ mahābhuja ..
tatolpacaturasraṃ ca caturasraṃ tato bhavet .. 2 ..
tatolpacaturasraṃ ca meruvatsaṃsthitaṃ tataḥ ..
bhadrapīṭhamidaṃ proktaṃ vyomabhāgaṃ tṛtīyakam .. 3 ..
sarveṣāṃ bhadrapīṭhānāmetallakṣaṇamucyate ..
sambhavaścaturasraṃ tu madhyabhāgaṃ prakīrtitam .. 4 ..
3.15.d:
इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे तृतीयखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे लिङ्गरूपनिर्माणो नाम चतुःसप्ततितमो ऽध्याय ॥74॥
3.75
वज्र उवाच ॥
व्योमरूपं समाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतां वर॥
व्योम्नि तु पूजिते पूजा कृता स्याज्जगतो भवेत्॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
चतुरस्रं भवेन्मूले ततो वृत्तं महाभुज ॥
ततोल्पचतुरस्रं च चतुरस्रं ततो भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥
ततोल्पचतुरस्रं च मेरुवत्संस्थितं ततः ॥
भद्रपीठमिदं प्रोक्तं व्योमभागं तृतीयकम् ॥ 3 ॥
सर्वेषां भद्रपीठानामेतल्लक्षणमुच्यते ॥
सम्भवश्चतुरस्रं तु मध्यभागं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.15.m:
Thus ends the seventy-fourth chapter, entitled 'The Making of the Form of the Liṅga', in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the third book of the glorious Viṣṇudharmottara.
3.75
Vajra said:
Describe the form of the sky, O best of all upholders of dharma!
For when the sky is worshipped, worship would be rendered to the universe.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
At the base it should be square; then round, O strong-armed one;
then a smaller square, and then it should be square.
And then a smaller square, situated like Mount Meru;
this is declared to be the auspicious pedestal, the third part representing the sky.
This is stated as the characteristic mark of all auspicious pedestals;
the central portion is declared to be of square form.

3.15.s:
bhadrapīṭhaṃ tato bhāgaṃ tatra padma niveśayet ..
śubhāṣṭapatraṃ tanmadhye karṇikāyāṃ divākaram ..85..
patreṣu kalpayettatra dikpālām̐śca yathādiśam ..
bhadrapīṭhamadhastāttu pṛthivīṃ parikalpayet .. 6 ..
antarikṣaṃ tathā stambhamūrddhvabhāgaṃ tato viduḥ ..
tatra sannihitāḥ sarve bhavanti tridaśottamāḥ .. 7 ..
sarvadevamayaṃ vyoma kathitaṃ te mahābhuja ..
tasya sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāta .. 8 ..
vyomnaḥ svarūpaṃ kathitaṃ mayaitadvyomnastu pūjā karaṇātsamagram ..
sampūjitaṃ syājjagadekavīra carācaraṃ yādavavaṃśamukhya..9..
3.15.d:
भद्रपीठं ततो भागं तत्र पद्म निवेशयेत् ॥
शुभाष्टपत्रं तन्मध्ये कर्णिकायां दिवाकरम् ॥85॥
पत्रेषु कल्पयेत्तत्र दिक्पालाम्̐श्च यथादिशम् ॥
भद्रपीठमधस्तात्तु पृथिवीं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
अन्तरिक्षं तथा स्तम्भमूर्द्ध्वभागं ततो विदुः ॥
तत्र सन्निहिताः सर्वे भवन्ति त्रिदशोत्तमाः ॥ 7 ॥
सर्वदेवमयं व्योम कथितं ते महाभुज ॥
तस्य सम्पूजनं कृत्वा सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात ॥ 8 ॥
व्योम्नः स्वरूपं कथितं मयैतद्व्योम्नस्तु पूजा करणात्समग्रम् ॥
सम्पूजितं स्याज्जगदेकवीर चराचरं यादववंशमुख्य॥9॥

3.16.s:
3.76
vajra uvāca..
naranārāyaṇau kāryau kena rūpeṇa saṃyutau..
hariḥ kṛṣṇaśca kartavyaḥ kathaṃ vā bhṛgunandana.. 1 ..
3.16.d:
3.76
वज्र उवाच॥
नरनारायणौ कार्यौ केन रूपेण संयुतौ॥
हरिः कृष्णश्च कर्तव्यः कथं वा भृगुनन्दन॥ 1 ॥
3.16.m:
3.76
Vajra said:
With what form should Nara and Nārāyaṇa be endowed?
Or how should Hari and Kṛṣṇa be depicted, O descendant of Bhṛgu?

3.16.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dūrvāśyāmo naraḥ kāryo dvibhujaśca mahābhuja ..
nārāyaṇaścaturbāhurnīlotpaladalacchaviḥ .. 2..
3.16.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
दूर्वाश्यामो नरः कार्यो द्विभुजश्च महाभुज ॥
नारायणश्चतुर्बाहुर्नीलोत्पलदलच्छविः ॥ 2॥

3.16.s:
tayormadhye ca badarī kāryā phalavibhūṣaṇā ...
badaryāmanu tau kāryāvakṣamālādharāvubhau .. 3 ..
3.16.d:
तयोर्मध्ये च बदरी कार्या फलविभूषणा ॥।
बदर्यामनु तौ कार्यावक्षमालाधरावुभौ ॥ 3 ॥
3.16.m:
Between the two, a jujube tree adorned with fruits should be made;
alongside the jujube tree, both of them should be made holding rosaries,

3.16.s:
aṣṭacakre sthitau yāne bhūtiyukte manohare ..
kṛṣṇājinadharau dāntau jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇau .. 4 ..
3.16.d:
अष्टचक्रे स्थितौ याने भूतियुक्ते मनोहरे ॥
कृष्णाजिनधरौ दान्तौ जटामण्डलधारिणौ ॥ 4 ॥
3.16.m:
standing on an eight-wheeled chariot that is endowed with splendour and charming,
wearing black antelope skins, self-restrained, wearing a mass of matted hair.

3.16.s:
pādena caikena rathasthitena pādena caikena ca jānugena ..
kāryo hariścātra nareṇa tulyaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi nārāyaṇatulyamūrtiḥ .. 5 ..
3.77
vajra uvāca ..
dharmasya rūpanirmāṇaṃ jānasya ca parantapa ..
vairāgyasya va dharmajña tathaiśvaryasya me vada .. 1 ..
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca ..
caturvaktraścatuṣpādaścaturbāhussitāmbaraḥ ..
sarvābharaṇavāñchveto dharmaḥ kāryo vijānatā .. 2 ..
dakṣiṇe cākṣamālāṃ ca tasya vāme tu pustakam ..
mūrtimānvyavasāyastu kāryo dakṣiṇabhāgagaḥ .. 3 ..
vāmabhāgagataḥ kāryaḥ sukhaḥ parama rūpavān ..
kāryau dharmakarau mūrdhni vinyastau ca tathā tayoḥ .. 4 ..
akṣamālā smṛtaḥ kālaḥ pustakaṃ cāgamaṃ smṛtam ..
yajñaḥ satyaṃ tapo dānaṃ tasya vaktracatuṣṭayam .. 5 ..
3.16.d:
पादेन चैकेन रथस्थितेन पादेन चैकेन च जानुगेन ॥
कार्यो हरिश्चात्र नरेण तुल्यः कृष्णोऽपि नारायणतुल्यमूर्तिः ॥ 5 ॥
3.77
वज्र उवाच ॥
धर्मस्य रूपनिर्माणं जानस्य च परन्तप ॥
वैराग्यस्य व धर्मज्ञ तथैश्वर्यस्य मे वद ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कंडेय उवाच ॥
चतुर्वक्त्रश्चतुष्पादश्चतुर्बाहुस्सिताम्बरः ॥
सर्वाभरणवाञ्छ्वेतो धर्मः कार्यो विजानता ॥ 2 ॥
दक्षिणे चाक्षमालां च तस्य वामे तु पुस्तकम् ॥
मूर्तिमान्व्यवसायस्तु कार्यो दक्षिणभागगः ॥ 3 ॥
वामभागगतः कार्यः सुखः परम रूपवान् ॥
कार्यौ धर्मकरौ मूर्ध्नि विन्यस्तौ च तथा तयोः ॥ 4 ॥
अक्षमाला स्मृतः कालः पुस्तकं चागमं स्मृतम् ॥
यज्ञः सत्यं तपो दानं तस्य वक्त्रचतुष्टयम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.16.m:
With one foot resting on the chariot and one foot resting on the knee,
Hari here should be made equal to Nara, and Kṛṣṇa also having a form equal to Nārāyaṇa.
3.77
Vajra said:
Tell me the making of the form of Dharma and of Knowledge, O scorcher of foes,
and of Dispassion, O knower of dharma, as well as of Sovereignty.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
With four faces, four feet, four arms, and white garments,
adorned with all ornaments and white, Dharma should be made by one who knows.
In his right [hand] a rosary, and in his left a book;
and Endeavour should be made embodied, standing on his right side.
Standing on his left side, Happiness should be made extremely handsome;
the two hands of Dharma should be made placed on the heads of those two.
The rosary is recorded as Time, and the book is recorded as Scripture;
sacrifice, truth, asceticism, and generosity are his four faces.

3.16.s:
deśakālau tathā śaucaṃ śuddhiścāsya bhujaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyamātmanaḥ .. 6 ..
3.16.d:
देशकालौ तथा शौचं शुद्धिश्चास्य भुजः स्मृतः ॥
श्रुतिः स्मृतिः सदाचारः स्वस्य च प्रियमात्मनः ॥ 6 ॥
3.16.m:
Place and time, as well as ritual purity and internal cleansing, are recorded as his arms;
revelation, tradition, virtuous conduct, and what is pleasing to one's own self—

3.16.s:
tasya devasya dharmajña jñeyaṃ pādacatuṣṭayam ..
sattvādhiktvācchuklastu jñānavāsaśca kīrtyate .. 7 ..
3.16.d:
तस्य देवस्य धर्मज्ञ ज्ञेयं पादचतुष्टयम् ॥
सत्त्वाधिक्त्वाच्छुक्लस्तु ज्ञानवासश्च कीर्त्यते ॥ 7 ॥
3.16.m:
these are to be known as the four feet of that god, O knower of dharma;
he is celebrated as white due to the predominance of sattva, and his garment is knowledge.

All these have been described to you as the gateways of Dharma.

कार्याः सरूपा द्विभुजाश्च सर्वास्तेजोन्वितास्ताश्च सुभूषणाश्च ॥
धर्मः स्थितः स्याद्यदि चैक एव भार्यान्वितश्चेदथ चोपदिष्टः ॥ 3.77.10 ॥
3.78
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
य एव भगवान्विष्णुर्नरसिंह वपुर्धरः ॥
ध्यानविद्भिः स एवोक्तो ज्ञानः पलवरार्दनः ॥ 1 ॥
पीनस्कन्दकटिग्रीवः कृशमध्यः कृशोदरः ॥
सिंहासने नृदेहस्तु नीलवासाः प्रभान्वितः ॥ ऐ ॥
आलीढस्थानसंस्थानः सर्वाभरणभूषितः ॥
ज्वालामालाकुलमुखो ज्वालाकेसरमण्डलः ॥ 3 ॥
हिरण्यकशिपोर्वक्षः पाटयन्नखरैः खरैः ॥
नीलोत्पलाभः कर्तव्यो देवजानुगतस्तथा ॥ 4 ॥
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यस्तमज्ञानं विदुर्बुधाः ॥
सङ्कर्षणात्मा भगवानज्ञानस्य विनाशनः ॥ 5 ॥
वाङ्मनःकायसम्भूतं त्रिविधं जगतां मलम् ॥
एतत्सङ्कर्षणो देवः सदा पाटयति द्विज ॥ 6॥
3.16.m:
They should all be made well-formed, two-armed, endowed with splendour, and beautifully adorned. / Dharma may stand alone, or else he is prescribed as accompanied by his wives.
3.78 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / That very Lord Viṣṇu who assumed the body of Narasiṃha / is declared by those who know meditation to be knowledge, the destroyer of the strength of the enemy.
With stout shoulders, waist, and neck, with slender midriff and lean belly, / having a human body upon a lion-throne, clad in blue garments, endowed with radiance, / [or] assuming the ālīḍha stance, adorned with all ornaments, / with a face filled with wreaths of flames, and a circle of flaming manes,
tearing the chest of Hiraṇyakaśipu with his sharp claws, / having the lustre of a blue lotus, he should be made thus, with the demon fallen on his knees.
Hiraṇyakaśipu is the Daitya; the wise know him to be ignorance. / The Lord, whose self is Saṃkarṣaṇa, is the destroyer of ignorance.
The three-fold impurity of the worlds arising from speech, mind, and body— / this, O twice-born, the divine Saṃkarṣaṇa ever tears asunder.

3.16.s:
hariḥ saṅkarṣaṇāṃśena narasiṃhavapurdharaḥ ..
tamasastrividhasyāpi nāśano jagatāṃ hariḥ .. 7 ..

3.16.d:
हरिः सङ्कर्षणांशेन नरसिंहवपुर्धरः ॥
तमसस्त्रिविधस्यापि नाशनो जगतां हरिः ॥ 7 ॥
हार्द्दमूर्तिनिभस्तस्य नान्यो जगति विद्यते ॥
नृसिंहमूर्तिर्देवस्य सर्वाज्ञानविनाशिनी ॥ 8 ॥
सिंहासने सुखासीनः कार्यो वा भगवान्हरिः ॥
गदामस्तकविन्यस्तकरद्वितयभूषणः ॥ 9 ॥
ज्वालामालाकुलवपुः शङ्खपद्मधरः प्रभुः ॥
मूर्तिमत्पृथिवीहस्तन्यस्तपादोऽथ वोत्थितः ॥ 3.78.10 ॥
3.16.m:
Hari, through a portion of Saṃkarṣaṇa, assumes the body of Narasiṃha; / Hari is the destroyer even of the three-fold darkness of the worlds.
No other form resembles his heart-abiding image in the world; / the Nṛsiṃha form of the Lord destroys all ignorance.
Or the divine Hari should be made comfortably seated upon a lion-throne, / adorned with both hands resting upon the head of a mace,
his body covered with wreaths of flames, the Lord bearing a conch and a lotus; / or standing, with his feet placed upon the hands of the personified Earth,
splendid with hands marked by conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / his body-hairs adorned with whirling masses of fire-flames.

3.16.s:
narasiṃho'tha vā kāryaḥ prabhāmaṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ ..
sarvābharaṇasampannaḥ kāryo bhūṣaṇavarjitaḥ .. 12 ..
3.16.d:
नरसिंहोऽथ वा कार्यः प्रभामण्डलदुर्दृशः ॥
सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नः कार्यो भूषणवर्जितः ॥ 12 ॥
3.16.m: Or else Narasiṃha should be made difficult to behold due to his circle of radiance; / he may be made equipped with all ornaments, or free of ornaments.

3.79
॥ मार्कंडेय उवाच ॥
ऐश्वर्यमनिरुद्धस्तु वराहो भगवान्हरिः ॥
ऐश्वर्यशक्त्या दंष्ट्राग्रसमुद्धृतवसुन्धरः ॥ 1 ॥
नृवराहोऽथ वा कार्यः शेषोपरिगतः प्रभुः ॥
शेषश्चतुर्भुजः कार्यश्चारुरत्नफणान्वितः ॥ 2॥
आश्चर्योत्फुल्लनयनो देवीवीक्षणतत्परः ॥
कर्तव्यौ सीरमुसलौ करयोस्तस्य यादव ॥ 3 ॥
सर्पभूषश्च कर्तव्यस्तथैव रचिताञ्जलिः ॥
आलीढस्थानसंस्थानस्तत्पृष्ठे भगवान्भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
सव्येऽरत्निगता तस्य योषिद्रूपा वसुन्धरा ॥
नमस्कारपरा तस्य कर्तव्या द्विभुजा शुभा ॥ 5 ॥
यस्मिन्भुजे धरा देवी तत्र शङ्खः करे भवेत ॥
अन्ये तस्य कराः कार्याः पद्मचक्रगदाधराः ॥ 6 ॥
3.16.m:
Nṛsiṃha, the sovereign lord of the worlds, is knowledge, the abode of splendour, resembling the sky. / This threefold form of that immeasurable Janārdana has been taught by me.
3.79 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Sovereign power is Aniruddha, the divine Hari as the Boar, / who by his power of sovereignty raised up the earth upon the tip of his tusk.
Or the man-boar should be made, the Lord standing upon Śeṣa; / and Śeṣa should be made four-armed, endowed with hoods of beautiful jewels,
his eyes wide open in wonder, intent upon gazing at the goddess. / A plough and a pestle should be made in his hands, O descendant of Yadu,
and he should be made adorned with serpents, with folded hands as well. / The Lord should be upon his back, positioned in the ālīḍha stance.
Upon his left elbow is the Earth in the form of a woman; / she, auspicious and two-armed, should be made intent upon offering obeisance to him.
On the arm upon which the goddess Earth rests, the conch should be in that hand; / his other hands should be made holding lotus, discus, and mace.

3.16.d:
हिरण्याक्षशिरच्छेदश्चक्रोद्यतकरोऽथ वा ॥
शूलोद्यतहिरण्याक्षसम्मुखो भगवान्भवेत् ॥ 7 ॥
मूर्तिमन्तमनैश्वर्यं हिरण्याक्षं विदुर्बुधाः ॥
ऐश्वर्येण वराहेण स निरस्तोऽरिमर्दनः ॥ 8 ॥
नृवराहोऽथ वा कार्यो ध्याने कपिलवत्स्थितः ॥
द्विभुजस्त्वथ वा कार्यः पिण्डनिर्वहणोद्यतः ॥ 9 ॥
समग्रक्रोडरूपो वा बहुदानवमध्यगः ॥
नृवराहो वराहो वा कर्तव्यः क्ष्माविधाणे ॥ 3.79.10 ॥
ऐश्वर्ययोगोद्धृतसर्वलोकः कार्योऽनिरुद्धो भगवान्वराहः ॥
रुद्धा न यस्य क्वचिदेव शक्तिः समस्तपापापहरस्य राजन् ॥ 11 ॥
3.80
वज्र उवाच ॥
अथाश्वशिरसो रूपं विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥
श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यनेनैव प्रसङ्गेन महाभुज॥ 1॥
मार्कंडेय उवाच ॥
मूर्तिमत्पृथिवीपाल हस्तपादस्मितच्छविः ॥
नीलाम्बरधरः कार्यो देवो हयशिरोधरः ॥ 2 ॥
3.16.m:
Or his hand may be raised with the discus to sever the head of Hiraṇyākṣa; / the Lord should face Hiraṇyākṣa, who has raised his trident.
The wise know Hiraṇyākṣa to be personified lack of sovereignty. / By sovereign power, the Boar, the crusher of enemies, struck him down.
Or the man-boar should be made situated in meditation like Kapila; / or he should be made two-armed, intent upon carrying the lump [of earth],
or in the form of an entire boar, standing in the midst of many demons. / Either the man-boar or the boar should be made supporting the earth.
By the yoga of sovereignty, the divine Boar Aniruddha, who lifted up all the worlds, should be made, / whose power is nowhere obstructed, who removes all sins, O king.
3.80 / Vajra said: / Now I wish to hear about the form of the horse-headed Viṣṇu of boundless splendour / in this very connection, O mighty-armed one.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / O ruler of the earth, with the bodily lustre of his hands and feet smiling, / clad in blue garments, the horse-headed god should be made.

3.16.d:
विद्धि संङ्कर्षणाङ्गं वै देवं हयशिरोधरम् ॥
कर्तव्योऽष्टभुजो देवस्तत्करेषु चतुर्ष्वथ ॥ 3 ॥
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मान्साकारान्कारयेद्बुधः ॥
चत्वारश्च करा कार्या वेदानां देहधारिणाम् ॥ 4 ॥
देवेन मूर्ध्नि विन्यस्ता सर्वा भरणधारिणा ॥
अश्वग्रीवेन देवेन पुरा वेदाः समुद्धृताः ॥ 5 ॥
वेदा हृता दानवपुङ्गवाभ्यां रसातलाद्देव वरेण तेन॥
समुद्धृता यादववंशमुख्य तुरङ्गमूर्ध्ना पुरुषोत्तमेन ॥ 6 ॥
3.16.m:
Know the horse-headed god to indeed be a limb of Saṃkarṣaṇa. / The god should be made eight-armed, and in four of his hands,
the wise one should have conch, discus, mace, and lotus made in personified form; / and four hands should be made placed on the heads
of the personified Vedas by the god wearing all ornaments. / In ancient times, the Vedas were retrieved by the horse-necked god.
The Vedas, stolen by two foremost demons, from the netherworld by that best of gods, / by the horse-headed Puruṣottama, were retrieved, O chief of Yadu’s lineage.

There the god of gods should be made asleep, four-armed.

eko bhujo'sya kartavyastatra jānau prasāritaḥ .. 4 ..
