तथापरश्च कर्तव्यः शेषभोगाङ्कसंस्थितः ॥
एको भुजोऽस्य कर्तव्यस्तत्र जानौ प्रसारितः ॥ 4 ॥
3.17.m: and the other should be made resting upon the lap of Śeṣa's coils. / One of his arms should be made stretched out over his knee there;

3.17.s:
kartavyo nābhideśasthastathā tasyāparaḥ karaḥ ..
tathā cānyaḥ karaḥ kāryo devasya tu śirodhare .. 5 ..
3.17.d:
कर्तव्यो नाभिदेशस्थस्तथा तस्यापरः करः ॥
तथा चान्यः करः कार्यो देवस्य तु शिरोधरे ॥ 5 ॥
3.17.m: another of his hands should be placed at the region of the navel; / and another hand of the god should be placed at his neck;

3.17.s:
santānamañjarīdhārī tathaivāsyāparo bhavet ..
nābhīsarasi sambhūte kamale tasya yādava ..6..
3.17.d:
सन्तानमञ्जरीधारी तथैवास्यापरो भवेत् ॥
नाभीसरसि सम्भूते कमले तस्य यादव ॥6॥
3.17.m: and another of his [hands] should be holding a cluster of santāna blossoms. / In the lotus born from the lake of his navel, O descendant of Yadu,

3.17.s:
sarvapṛthvīmaye devyāḥ prāgvatkāryaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
nālalagnau ca kartavyau padmasya madhukaiṭabhau .. 7 ..
3.17.d:
सर्वपृथ्वीमये देव्याः प्राग्वत्कार्यः पितामहः ॥
नाललग्नौ च कर्तव्यौ पद्मस्य मधुकैटभौ ॥ 7 ॥
3.17.m: which consists of the whole earth of the goddess, the Grandfather should be made as before; / and Madhu and Kaiṭabha should be made clinging to the stalk of the lotus.

3.17.s:
nṛrūpadhārīṇi bhujaṅgamasya kāryāṇyathāstrāṇi tathā samīpe ..
etattavoktaṃ yadupuṅgavāgrya devasya rūpaṃ paramasya tasya .. 8 ..
3.82
vajra uvāca ..
ācakṣva rūpaṃ lakṣmyā me bhṛguvaṃśavivardhana ..
yā mātā sarvalokasya patnī viṣṇormahātmanaḥ .. .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
hareḥ samīpe kartavyā lakṣmīstu dvibhujā nṛpa ..
divyarūpāmbujakarā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā .. 2 ..
gaurī śuklāmbarā devī rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ..
pṛthakcaturbhujā kāryā devī siṃhāsane śubhe .. 3 ..
siṃhāsane'syāḥ kartavyaṃ kamalaṃ cārukarṇikam ..
aṣṭapatraṃ mahābhāga karṇikāyāntu saṃsthitā .. 4 ..
vināyakavadāsīnā devī kāryā mahābhuja ..
bṛhannālaṃ kare kāryaṃ tasyāśca kamalaṃ śubham .. 5 ..
dakṣiṇe yādava śreṣṭha keyūraprāntasaṃsthitam ..
vāme'mṛtaghaṭaḥ kāryastathā rājanmanoharaḥ .. 6 ..
3.17.d:
नृरूपधारीणि भुजङ्गमस्य कार्याण्यथास्त्राणि तथा समीपे ॥
एतत्तवोक्तं यदुपुङ्गवाग्र्य देवस्य रूपं परमस्य तस्य ॥ 8 ॥
3.82
वज्र उवाच ॥
आचक्ष्व रूपं लक्ष्म्या मे भृगुवंशविवर्धन ॥
या माता सर्वलोकस्य पत्नी विष्णोर्महात्मनः ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
हरेः समीपे कर्तव्या लक्ष्मीस्तु द्विभुजा नृप ॥
दिव्यरूपाम्बुजकरा सर्वाभरणभूषिता ॥ 2 ॥
गौरी शुक्लाम्बरा देवी रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि ॥
पृथक्चतुर्भुजा कार्या देवी सिंहासने शुभे ॥ 3 ॥
सिंहासनेऽस्याः कर्तव्यं कमलं चारुकर्णिकम् ॥
अष्टपत्रं महाभाग कर्णिकायान्तु संस्थिता ॥ 4 ॥
विनायकवदासीना देवी कार्या महाभुज ॥
बृहन्नालं करे कार्यं तस्याश्च कमलं शुभम् ॥ 5 ॥
दक्षिणे यादव श्रेष्ठ केयूरप्रान्तसंस्थितम् ॥
वामेऽमृतघटः कार्यस्तथा राजन्मनोहरः ॥ 6 ॥
3.17.m:
And the weapons of the serpent should be made nearby, bearing human forms. / Thus has been told to you, O foremost among the best of the Yadus, the form of that supreme god.
3.82
Vajra said:
Describe to me the form of Lakṣmī, O enhancer of the lineage of Bhṛgu, / she who is the mother of all the worlds and the wife of the great-souled Viṣṇu.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Beside Hari, Lakṣmī should be made with two arms, O king, / of divine form, with a lotus in her hand, adorned with all ornaments;
fair-complexioned, clothed in white garments, the goddess of matchless beauty on earth. / Separately, the goddess should be made with four arms on an auspicious lion-throne.
On her lion-throne a lotus with a lovely pericarp should be made, / eight-petalled, O fortunate one; and she is seated upon the pericarp.
Seated like Vināyaka, the goddess should be made, O mighty-armed one. / In her hand should be made an auspicious lotus with a large stalk,
situated on the right, O best of the Yādavas, resting near the edge of her armlet. / On the left should be made a jar of nectar, similarly charming, O king.

3.17.s:
tathaivānyau karau kāryau bilvaśaṅkhadharau nṛpa ..
āvarjitaghaṭaṃ kāryaṃ tatpṛṣṭhe kuñjaradvayam .. 7 ..
devyāśca mastake padmaṃ tathā kāryaṃ manoharam ..
saubhāgyaṃ tadvijānīhi śaṅkhamṛddhiṃ tathā param..8..
3.17.d:
तथैवान्यौ करौ कार्यौ बिल्वशङ्खधरौ नृप ॥
आवर्जितघटं कार्यं तत्पृष्ठे कुञ्जरद्वयम् ॥ 7 ॥
देव्याश्च मस्तके पद्मं तथा कार्यं मनोहरम् ॥
सौभाग्यं तद्विजानीहि शङ्खमृद्धिं तथा परम्॥8॥
3.17.m:
Likewise her other two hands should be made holding a bilva fruit and a conch, O king. / Behind her should be made a pair of elephants with overturned jars.
And on the head of the goddess a charming lotus should be made. / Know that to be good fortune; the conch is supreme prosperity;

3.17.s:
bilvaṃ ca sakalaṃ lokamapāṃ sārāmṛtaṃ tathā ..
padmaṃ lakṣmīkare viddhi vibhavaṃ dvijapuṅgava .. 9 ..
3.17.d:
बिल्वं च सकलं लोकमपां सारामृतं तथा ॥
पद्मं लक्ष्मीकरे विद्धि विभवं द्विजपुङ्गव ॥ 9 ॥
3.17.m: the bilva is the entire world; and the nectar is the essence of the waters. / Know the lotus in Lakṣmī's hand to be sovereignty, O foremost of the twice-born.

3.17.s:
hastidvayaṃ vijānīhi śaṃkhapadmāvubhau nidhī ..
samutthitā vā kartavyā śaṃkhāmbujakarā tathā..3.82.10..
3.17.d:
हस्तिद्वयं विजानीहि शंखपद्मावुभौ निधी ॥
समुत्थिता वा कर्तव्या शंखाम्बुजकरा तथा॥3.82.10॥
3.17.m: Know the pair of elephants to be both treasures, the conch and the lotus. / Or else she may be made standing, holding a conch and a lotus in her hands,

3.17.s:
samukṣitā mahābhāgā padme padmāntaraprabhā ..
dvibhujā cārusarvāṃgī sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇā .. 11 ..
3.17.d:
समुक्षिता महाभागा पद्मे पद्मान्तरप्रभा ॥
द्विभुजा चारुसर्वांगी सर्वाभरणभूषणा ॥ 11 ॥
3.17.m: sprinkled [with water], the greatly fortunate one, standing on a lotus, shining like the interior of a lotus, / two-armed, with every limb lovely, adorned with all ornaments.

3.17.s: dvau ca maulicarau mūrdhni kāryā vidyādharau śubhau .. 12 ..
3.17.d: द्वौ च मौलिचरौ मूर्ध्नि कार्या विद्याधरौ शुभौ ॥ 12 ॥
3.17.m: And on her head two auspicious Vidyādharas moving around her crown should be made,

3.17.s:
karābhyāṃ maulilagnābhyāṃ dakṣiṇābhyāṃ virājitau ..
karābhyāṃ khaḍgadhāribhyāṃ devīvīkṣaṇatatparau .. 13 ..
3.17.d:
कराभ्यां मौलिलग्नाभ्यां दक्षिणाभ्यां विराजितौ ॥
कराभ्यां खड्गधारिभ्यां देवीवीक्षणतत्परौ ॥ 13 ॥
3.17.m: splendid with their right hands touching her crown, / with their [other] hands holding swords, intent on looking upon the goddess.

3.17.s:
rājaśrīḥ svargalakṣmīśca brāhmī lakṣmīstathaiva ca ..
jayalakṣmīśca kartavyā tasyā devyāḥ samīpagāḥ .. 14 ..
3.17.d:
राजश्रीः स्वर्गलक्ष्मीश्च ब्राह्मी लक्ष्मीस्तथैव च ॥
जयलक्ष्मीश्च कर्तव्या तस्या देव्याः समीपगाः ॥ 14 ॥
3.17.m: Rājaśrī, Svargalakṣmī, Brāhmī Lakṣmī, / and Jayalakṣmī should be made standing near that goddess.

3.17.s: sarvāḥ surūpāḥ kartavyāstathā ca suvibhūṣaṇāḥ .. 15 ..
3.17.d: सर्वाः सुरूपाः कर्तव्यास्तथा च सुविभूषणाः ॥ 15 ॥
3.17.m: All should be made beautiful in form and well-adorned.

3.17.s:
lakṣmīḥ sthitā sā kamale tu yasmim̐stāṃ keśavaṃ viddhi mahānubhāva ..
vinā kṛtā sā madhusūdanena kṣaṇaṃ na santiṣṭhati lokamātā .. 16 ..
3.83
vajra uvāca ..
rūpeṇa kena kartavyo viśvarūpadharo hariḥ ..
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ hi sarvaviducyase .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ādau devasya kartavyāścatvāro vai stavonmukhāḥ ..
teṣāmupari kartavyāstathā māheśvarāḥ punaḥ .. 2 ..
īśānaṃ vaktrahīnāste tathā proktā mayā purā ..
teṣāmupari kartavyā mukhyā brāhmī yatheritā .. 3 ..
tataścānyamukhāḥ kāryāstiryagūrdhve tathaiva ca ..
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ tathānyānapi kārayet .. 4 ..
ye mukhāḥ sattvajātānāṃ nānārūpā vibhāgaśaḥ ..
yāvanto dṛṣṭayaḥ proktāścitrasūtre mahātmabhiḥ .. 5 ..
darśanīyāstu tāḥ sarvāstasya mūrdhasu bhāgaśaḥ ..
nānāvidhāni sattvāni mukhairanyaistathaiva ca .. 6 ..
3.17.d:
लक्ष्मीः स्थिता सा कमले तु यस्मिम्̐स्तां केशवं विद्धि महानुभाव ॥
विना कृता सा मधुसूदनेन क्षणं न सन्तिष्ठति लोकमाता ॥ 16 ॥
3.83
वज्र उवाच ॥
रूपेण केन कर्तव्यो विश्वरूपधरो हरिः ॥
एतं मे संशयं छिन्धि त्वं हि सर्वविदुच्यसे ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आदौ देवस्य कर्तव्याश्चत्वारो वै स्तवोन्मुखाः ॥
तेषामुपरि कर्तव्यास्तथा माहेश्वराः पुनः ॥ 2 ॥
ईशानं वक्त्रहीनास्ते तथा प्रोक्ता मया पुरा ॥
तेषामुपरि कर्तव्या मुख्या ब्राह्मी यथेरिता ॥ 3 ॥
ततश्चान्यमुखाः कार्यास्तिर्यगूर्ध्वे तथैव च ॥
सर्वेषामपि देवानां तथान्यानपि कारयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
ये मुखाः सत्त्वजातानां नानारूपा विभागशः ॥
यावन्तो दृष्टयः प्रोक्ताश्चित्रसूत्रे महात्मभिः ॥ 5 ॥
दर्शनीयास्तु ताः सर्वास्तस्य मूर्धसु भागशः ॥
नानाविधानि सत्त्वानि मुखैरन्यैस्तथैव च ॥ 6 ॥
3.17.m:
Know that lotus upon which Lakṣmī stands to be Keśava, O great-souled one; / separated from Madhusūdana, the mother of the worlds does not abide even for a moment.
3.83
Vajra said:
In what form should Hari bearing the universal form be made? / Cut away this doubt of mine, for you are called all-knowing.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
First, four [faces] of the god turned upward in praise should be made; / above them should again be made the faces belonging to Maheśvara,
lacking the Īśāna face, as previously stated by me; / above them should be made the primary [face] of Brahmā, as described.
Then other faces should be made, oblique and upward likewise; / and one should also make other [faces] of all the gods,
the various forms of the faces of the classes of living beings according to their divisions. / As many gazes as have been taught in the Citrasūtra by the great-souled ones,
all of them are to be shown on his heads according to their divisions. / Likewise, by other faces, all kinds of living beings,

3.17.s:
grasamānaḥ sa kartavyaḥ sarvaiḥ sattvabhayaṅkaraiḥ ..
kāryāṇyuddhūyamānāni mukhāḥ kecana te śubhāḥ .. 7 ..
yathā śaktyā ca kartavyāstasya devasya bāhavaḥ ..
hastāni yāni dṛṣṭāni nṛttaśāstre mahātmabhiḥ .. 8 ..
tāni sarvāṇi kāryāṇi tasya devasya bāhuṣu ..
hastāḥ kāryāstathaivānye sarvāyudhavibhūṣaṇāḥ .. 9 ..
yajñadaṇḍadharāścānye śilpabhāṇḍadharāstathā ..
kālabhāṇḍadharāścānye vādyabhāṇḍadharāḥ pare .. 3.83.10 ..
rūpamanyatprakartavyaṃ vaikuṇṭhavadato'cyute ..
tatrāpi gātragāstasya darśayeccitrakarmaṇā .. 11 ..
trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ rājanyathāśāstrānusārataḥ ..
darśanīyāni varṇāni sarvāṇyeva mahātmanaḥ .. 12 ..
bahurūpasya devasya vahumastakagāni tu .. 13 ..
3.17.d:
ग्रसमानः स कर्तव्यः सर्वैः सत्त्वभयङ्करैः ॥
कार्याण्युद्धूयमानानि मुखाः केचन ते शुभाः ॥ 7 ॥
यथा शक्त्या च कर्तव्यास्तस्य देवस्य बाहवः ॥
हस्तानि यानि दृष्टानि नृत्तशास्त्रे महात्मभिः ॥ 8 ॥
तानि सर्वाणि कार्याणि तस्य देवस्य बाहुषु ॥
हस्ताः कार्यास्तथैवान्ये सर्वायुधविभूषणाः ॥ 9 ॥
यज्ञदण्डधराश्चान्ये शिल्पभाण्डधरास्तथा ॥
कालभाण्डधराश्चान्ये वाद्यभाण्डधराः परे ॥ 3.83.10 ॥
रूपमन्यत्प्रकर्तव्यं वैकुण्ठवदतोऽच्युते ॥
तत्रापि गात्रगास्तस्य दर्शयेच्चित्रकर्मणा ॥ 11 ॥
त्रैलोक्यं सकलं राजन्यथाशास्त्रानुसारतः ॥
दर्शनीयानि वर्णानि सर्वाण्येव महात्मनः ॥ 12 ॥
बहुरूपस्य देवस्य वहुमस्तकगानि तु ॥ 13 ॥
3.17.m:
devouring [them], he should be made, terrifying to all living beings. / Some auspicious faces of his should be made blowing [them] away.
And according to one's capacity the arms of that god should be made. / Whatever hand-gestures have been seen in the treatise on dance by the great-souled ones,
all of them should be made on the arms of that god. / Likewise, other hands should be made adorned with all weapons,
and others holding sacrificial staffs, and holding the vessels of crafts, / others holding the vessels of time, and others holding musical instruments.
The rest of the form of Acyuta should be made like Vaikuṇṭha; / there too, on his limbs, one should display by the art of painting
the entire triple world, O king, according to the treatises. / All the castes of the great-souled one are to be shown,
placed on the many heads of the god of manifold forms.

3.17.s:
evaṃ hi śaktyā jagatāṃ pradhānaḥ samagrarūpo bhagavānhi kāryaḥ ..
kārtsnyena rūpaṃ puruṣottamasya vaktuṃ na śakyaṃ kuta eva kartum .. 14 ..
3.84
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
aiḍūkarūpanirmāṇaṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama ..
aiḍūkapūjanātpūjā kṛtāsya jagato bhavet .. 1 ..
bhadrapīṭhaṃ budhaḥ kuryātsopānaiḥ śobhanairyutam ..
caturbhiryādavaśreṣṭha yathādiśamarindama .. 2 ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ tu kārayet ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparaṃ tādṛgvidhamarindama .. 3 ..
tasyopariṣṭātkartavyaṃ liṅgarūpaṃ vijānatā ..
tattu tatrāpi kartavyaṃ liṃgarekhā virājitam .. 4 ..
tasya madhye dhruvāṃ yaṣṭiṃ caturasrāṃ tu kārayet ..
tasyopariṣṭātkartavyā bhūmikāstu trayodaśa .. 5 ..
tasyopariṣṭātkartavyaṃ tathaivāmalatārakam ..
tasyopari punaryaṣṭiḥ kāryā rājansuvartulā .. 6 ..
3.17.d:
एवं हि शक्त्या जगतां प्रधानः समग्ररूपो भगवान्हि कार्यः ॥
कार्त्स्न्येन रूपं पुरुषोत्तमस्य वक्तुं न शक्यं कुत एव कर्तुम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.84
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ऐडूकरूपनिर्माणं शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥
ऐडूकपूजनात्पूजा कृतास्य जगतो भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
भद्रपीठं बुधः कुर्यात्सोपानैः शोभनैर्युतम् ॥
चतुर्भिर्यादवश्रेष्ठ यथादिशमरिन्दम ॥ 2 ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरं भद्रपीठं तु कारयेत् ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरं तादृग्विधमरिन्दम ॥ 3 ॥
तस्योपरिष्टात्कर्तव्यं लिङ्गरूपं विजानता ॥
तत्तु तत्रापि कर्तव्यं लिंगरेखा विराजितम् ॥ 4 ॥
तस्य मध्ये ध्रुवां यष्टिं चतुरस्रां तु कारयेत् ॥
तस्योपरिष्टात्कर्तव्या भूमिकास्तु त्रयोदश ॥ 5 ॥
तस्योपरिष्टात्कर्तव्यं तथैवामलतारकम् ॥
तस्योपरि पुनर्यष्टिः कार्या राजन्सुवर्तुला ॥ 6 ॥
3.17.m:
In this way, according to one's capacity, the Lord, the foremost of the worlds, of complete form, should indeed be made. / It is not possible to describe the form of Puruṣottama in its entirety; how much less to make it!
3.84
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Listen to me as I describe the making of the form of the eḍūka; / by worshipping the eḍūka, worship of this [entire] world is performed.
A wise man should make an auspicious pedestal provided with handsome steps, / four [flights of them], O best of the Yādavas, according to the cardinal directions, O subduer of foes.
Above it he should make another auspicious pedestal, / and above it another of the same kind, O subduer of foes.
Above it the form of a liṅga should be made by one who knows; / and that too should be made there adorned with the lines of a liṅga.
In the middle of it one should make a firm, square pillar; / and above it thirteen storeys should be made.
Above that should likewise be made a spotless star-shaped [amalaka-stone]; / and above that, O king, a pillar should again be made, well-rounded,

वज्र उवाच ॥
वासुदेवस्य देवस्य बहुरूपस्य भार्गव ॥
ब्रूहि मे रूपनिर्माणं शाश्वतस्य महात्मनः ॥ 1 ॥

एकवक्त्रश्चतुर्बाहुः सौम्यरूपः सुदर्शनः ॥

कण्ठेन शुभरेखेण कम्बुतुल्येन राजता ॥
वराभरणयुक्तेन कुण्डलोत्तमभूषिणा ॥ 3 ॥
अङ्गदी बद्धकेयूरो वनमालाविभूषणः ॥
उरसा कौस्तुभं बिभ्रत्किरीटं शिरसा तथा ॥ 4 ॥
शिरःपद्मस्तथैवास्य कर्तव्यश्चारुकर्णिकः ॥
मुष्टिश्लिष्टायतभुजस्तनुस्ताम्रनखाङ्गुलिः ॥ 5 ॥

तत्करस्थांघ्रियुगुलो देवः कार्यो जनार्दनः ॥
तालान्तरपदन्यासः किञ्चिन्निष्क्रान्तदक्षिणः ॥ 7 ॥
3.17.m:
This form of the aiḍūka, called 'beneficial to creatures', has been told by me, O foremost of the Yadu lineage!
3.85 / Vajra said: / O descendant of Bhṛgu, tell me the fashioning of the form of the god Vāsudeva, / who possesses many forms, the eternal, great-souled one.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / He has one face, four arms, a gentle form, handsome to look upon, / resembling a cloud swollen with water, and adorned with all ornaments,
shining with a neck having auspicious lines and resembling a conch, / endowed with excellent ornaments, adorned with superior earrings,
wearing armlets, bound with bracelets, adorned with a forest-garland, / bearing the Kaustubha gem upon his chest, and likewise a diadem on his head.
Likewise, the lotus on his head should be made with a beautiful pericarp; / his long arms joined with fists, his fingers slender with coppery nails,
his waist adorned with the fold of three lines, exceedingly charming. / The Earth, bearing the form of a woman, should be made standing between his feet.
The god Janārdana should be made with both his feet resting in her hands, / the placement of his feet separated by a tāla, with his right [foot] slightly advanced.

3.17.d:
अन्तर्दृशा मही कार्या देवदर्शनविस्मिता ॥
देवश्च कटिवासेन कार्यो जान्ववलम्बिना ॥ 8 ॥
वनमाला च कर्तव्या देवजान्ववलम्बिनी ॥
यज्ञोपवीतः कर्तव्यो नाभिदेशमुपागतः ॥ 9 ॥
उत्फुल्लकमलं पाणौ कुर्याद्देवस्य दक्षिणे ॥
वाम पाणिगतं शङ्खं शङ्खाकारं तु कारयेत् ॥ 3.85.10 ॥
दक्षिणे तु गदा देवी तनुमध्या सुलोचना ॥
स्त्रीरूपधारिणी मुग्धा सर्वाभरणभूषणा ॥ 11 ॥
पश्यन्ती देवदेवेशं कार्या चामरधारिणी ॥
कार्यं तन्मूर्ध्निविन्यस्तं देवहस्तं तु दक्षिणम्॥12॥
वामभागगतश्चक्रः कार्यो लम्बोदरस्तथा॥।
सर्वाभरण संयुक्तो नृत्तविस्फारितेक्षणः॥13॥
कर्तव्यश्चामरकरो देववीक्षणतत्परः॥
कार्यो देवकरो वामो विन्यस्तस्तस्य मूर्धनि॥14॥
वज्र उवाच ॥
किं भयं तस्य देवस्य नित्यं सर्वायुधोद्यतः ॥
यतस्तिष्ठति सर्वात्मा भयहा त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.17.m:
The Earth should be made with inward-directed gaze, astonished at the sight of the god; / and the god should be made with a waist-cloth hanging down to his knees.
A forest-garland should be made hanging down to the god's knees; / a sacred thread should be made reaching down to the region of his navel.
In the god's right hand one should place a fully blossomed lotus; / in his left hand he should have a conch made in the shape of a conch shell.
On his right, however, the goddess Gadā, slender-waisted, with beautiful eyes, / bearing a female form, charming, adorned with all ornaments,
looking at the lord of the gods of gods, should be made holding a fly-whisk; / and the god's right hand should be placed upon her head.
And on his left side, Cakra should be made, pot-bellied, / endowed with all ornaments, his eyes wide-open in dance,
holding a fly-whisk in his hand, intent upon gazing at the god; / and the god's left hand should be placed upon his head.
Vajra said: / What fear does that god have, that he stands constantly raised with all weapons, / since he, the Self of all, is the dispeller of fear for the denizens of heaven?

स तु दूर्वाङ्कुरश्यामस्सितवासा विधीयते ॥ 23 ॥
3.17.m: Pradyumna likewise should be fashioned in the likeness of Vāsudeva; / but he is prescribed as dark as a sprout of dūrvā grass, clad in white garments.

3.17.m: In place of the discus should be a bow, and likewise an arrow in place of the mace; / these two should be made of the same kind, as were the pestle and plough.

3.17.s:

3.17.m: One should likewise fashion this very form for Aniruddha, / whose body has the lustre of a lotus petal, and who wears red garments.

3.17.s:
cakrasthāne bhaveccarma gadāsthāne'sireva ca ..

3.17.m: In place of the discus should be a shield, and in place of the mace a sword; / the shield should be in the form of a discus, and the sword is prescribed as tall.

3.17.s:

रम्याण्यायुधरूपाणि चक्रादीन्येव यादव ॥ 27 ॥
3.17.m: One should display the inherent forms of the discus and the others slightly on their heads; / for the weapons, discus and the rest, are indeed delightful in form, O Yādava.

3.17.s:
