वामपार्श्वगताः कार्या देवानां प्रवरा ध्वजाः ॥
स्वपताकायुता राजन्यष्टिस्थास्ते यथेरिताः ॥ 28 ॥
3.17.m: On the left side of the gods their excellent banners should be made, / fixed on poles, endowed with their respective flags, as described, O king.

3.17.s:
pītavarṇaṃ pratīhāraṃ vāsudevasya kārayet ..
subhadravasubhadrākhyau vīrau prāsakarāvubhau .. 29 ..
3.17.d:
पीतवर्णं प्रतीहारं वासुदेवस्य कारयेत् ॥
सुभद्रवसुभद्राख्यौ वीरौ प्रासकरावुभौ ॥ 29 ॥
3.17.m: One should fashion yellow-coloured gatekeepers for Vāsudeva, / named Subhadra and Vasubhadra, both heroes holding barbed darts.

3.17.s:
āṣāḍho yajñatātaśca kāryaḥ saṅkarṣaṇasya tu ..
nalivarṇau mahābhāgau tathā mudgaradhāriṇau .. 3.85.30 ..
3.17.d:
आषाढो यज्ञतातश्च कार्यः सङ्कर्षणस्य तु ॥
नलिवर्णौ महाभागौ तथा मुद्गरधारिणौ ॥ 3.85.30 ॥
3.17.m: For Saṃkarṣaṇa, Āṣāḍha and Yajñatāta should be made, / lotus-coloured, illustrious, and likewise holding clubs.

3.17.s:
pradyumnasya pratīhārau jayo vijaya eva ca ..
śvetavarṇau mahābhāga tathā khaṅgadharāvubhau .. 31 ..
3.17.d:
प्रद्युम्नस्य प्रतीहारौ जयो विजय एव च ॥
श्वेतवर्णौ महाभाग तथा खङ्गधरावुभौ ॥ 31 ॥
3.17.m: The two gatekeepers of Pradyumna are Jaya and Vijaya, / white-coloured, illustrious, and both holding swords.

3.17.s:
āmodaśca pramodaśca mahābalaparākramau ..
aniruddhasya vijñeyau pratīhārau sureśvarau .. 32 ..
3.17.d:
आमोदश्च प्रमोदश्च महाबलपराक्रमौ ॥
अनिरुद्धस्य विज्ञेयौ प्रतीहारौ सुरेश्वरौ ॥ 32 ॥
3.17.m: Āmoda and Pramoda, endowed with great strength and valour, / should be known as the two gatekeepers of Aniruddha, lords of gods,

3.17.s:
raktavarṇau mahābhāga tathobhau śaktidhāriṇau ..
sarve surūpāḥ kartavyāḥ sarvābharaṇadhāriṇaḥ .. 33 ..
3.17.d:
रक्तवर्णौ महाभाग तथोभौ शक्तिधारिणौ ॥
सर्वे सुरूपाः कर्तव्याः सर्वाभरणधारिणः ॥ 33 ॥
3.17.m: red-coloured, illustrious, and both holding spears. / All should be made handsome in form, adorned with all ornaments.

3.17.s:
dvibāhavastu kartavyāstarjanyucchritapāṇayaḥ ..
dṛṣṭisteṣāṃ tu kartavyā dvāranyastā mahābhuja .. 34 ..
3.17.d:
द्विबाहवस्तु कर्तव्यास्तर्जन्युच्छ्रितपाणयः ॥
दृष्टिस्तेषां तु कर्तव्या द्वारन्यस्ता महाभुज ॥ 34 ॥
3.17.m: They should be made with two arms, their hands with raised forefingers; / and their gaze should be directed at the door, O mighty-armed one.

3.17.s:
śakraṃ subhadraṃ jānīhi vasubhadraṃ hutāśanam ..
āṣāḍhaṃ devadeveśaṃ yamaṃ jānīhi yādava .. 35 ..
3.17.d:
शक्रं सुभद्रं जानीहि वसुभद्रं हुताशनम् ॥
आषाढं देवदेवेशं यमं जानीहि यादव ॥ 35 ॥
3.17.m: Know Subhadra to be Śakra, and Vasubhadra to be Agni; / know Āṣāḍha, the lord of gods, to be Yama, O Yādava.

3.17.s:
yajñatātaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viddhi devamaninditam ..
jayaṃ jānīhi varuṇaṃ yādogaṇamaheśvaram .. 36 ..
3.17.d:
यज्ञतातं विरूपाक्षं विद्धि देवमनिन्दितम् ॥
जयं जानीहि वरुणं यादोगणमहेश्वरम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.17.m: Know the blameless god Yajñatāta to be Virūpākṣa; / know Jaya to be Varuṇa, the great lord of the host of aquatic creatures.

3.17.s:
pavanaṃ ca vijānīhi vijayaṃ yadunandana ..
āmodaṃ dhanadaṃ viddhi pramodaṃ śivameva ca .. 37 ..
3.17.d:
पवनं च विजानीहि विजयं यदुनन्दन ॥
आमोदं धनदं विद्धि प्रमोदं शिवमेव च ॥ 37 ॥
3.17.m: And know Vijaya to be Pavana, O delight of the Yadus; / know Āmoda to be Dhanada, and Pramoda to be Śiva.

3.17.s:
ete kāryāśca vā sarve dinagoktavapurdharāḥ ..
eta eva tathā proktā bhūya eva mahātmabhiḥ .. 38 ..
3.17.d:
एते कार्याश्च वा सर्वे दिनगोक्तवपुर्धराः ॥
एत एव तथा प्रोक्ता भूय एव महात्मभिः ॥ 38 ॥
3.17.m: Or else all of these should be made possessing the bodies described for the [guardians of the] directions; / for these very ones have been proclaimed once again by the great-souled ones.

3.17.s:
aṣṭau devagaṇā rājam̐stanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ..
vāsudevapratīhārāvaṇimā laghimā smṛtau .. 39 ..
3.17.d:
अष्टौ देवगणा राजम्̐स्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
वासुदेवप्रतीहारावणिमा लघिमा स्मृतौ ॥ 39 ॥
3.17.m: Listen as I speak to you of the eight classes of deities, O king: / the two gatekeepers of Vāsudeva are declared to be Aṇimā and Laghimā.

3.17.s:
saṃkarṣaṇapratīhārau mahimāprāptisaṃjñitau ..
prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ pradyumne kathitāvubhau .. 3.85.40 ..
3.17.d:
संकर्षणप्रतीहारौ महिमाप्राप्तिसंज्ञितौ ॥
प्राकाम्यं च तथेशित्वं प्रद्युम्ने कथितावुभौ ॥ 3.85.40 ॥
3.17.m: The two doorkeepers of Saṃkarṣaṇa are named Mahimā and Prāpti; / both Prākāmya and Īśitva are declared [as the attendants] of Pradyumna.

3.17.s:
vaśitvaṃ viddhi cāmodaṃ yatra kāmāvasāyitā ..
pramodamatha jānīhi sarvalokanamaskṛtam .. 41 ..
3.17.d:
वशित्वं विद्धि चामोदं यत्र कामावसायिता ॥
प्रमोदमथ जानीहि सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.17.m: Know Vaśitva and Āmoda [as the attendants] where Kāmāvasāyitā is, / and know Pramoda, who is bowed to by all the worlds.

3.17.s:
etatte rūpanirmāṇaṃ caturmūrtermayeritam ..
ekamūrtidharaḥ kāryā vaikuṇṭhetyabhiśabditāḥ .. 42 ..
3.17.d:
एतत्ते रूपनिर्माणं चतुर्मूर्तेर्मयेरितम् ॥
एकमूर्तिधरः कार्या वैकुण्ठेत्यभिशब्दिताः ॥ 42 ॥
3.17.m: Thus the creation of the fourfold forms has been told by me to you. / Those bearing a single form are to be made, named Vaikuṇṭha.

3.17.s:
caturmukhaḥ sa kartavyaḥ prāguktavadanaḥ prabhuḥ ..
caturmūrtiḥ sa bhavati kṛte mukhacatuṣṭaye .. 43 ..
3.17.d:
चतुर्मुखः स कर्तव्यः प्रागुक्तवदनः प्रभुः ॥
चतुर्मूर्तिः स भवति कृते मुखचतुष्टये ॥ 43 ॥
3.17.m: The Lord is to be made with four faces, having the faces described previously. / He becomes the fourfold form when four faces are made.

3.17.s:
pūrvaṃ saumyamukhaṃ kāryaṃ yattu mukhyatamaṃ viduḥ ..
kartavyaṃ siṃhavaktrābhaṃ jñānavaktraṃ tu dakṣiṇam .. 44 ..
3.17.d:
पूर्वं सौम्यमुखं कार्यं यत्तु मुख्यतमं विदुः ॥
कर्तव्यं सिंहवक्त्राभं ज्ञानवक्त्रं तु दक्षिणम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.17.m: The eastern face should be made placid, which they consider the principal one; / the southern face, [that of] knowledge, should be made resembling the face of a lion.

3.17.s:
paścimaṃ vadanaṃ raudraṃ yattadaiśvaryamucyate ..
caturvaktrasya kartavyaṃ rūpamanyattatheritam .. 45 ..
3.17.d:
पश्चिमं वदनं रौद्रं यत्तदैश्वर्यमुच्यते ॥
चतुर्वक्त्रस्य कर्तव्यं रूपमन्यत्तथेरितम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.17.m: The western face is terrible, which is called sovereignty; / thus the other form of the four-faced one is described to be made.

3.17.s:
caturbhujo vā kartavyastārkṣyo yādavanandana ..
gāruḍaśca tathā kāryo dharmajña racitāñjaliḥ .. 46 ..
3.17.d:
चतुर्भुजो वा कर्तव्यस्तार्क्ष्यो यादवनन्दन ॥
गारुडश्च तथा कार्यो धर्मज्ञ रचिताञ्जलिः ॥ 46 ॥
3.17.m: Or Tārkṣya should be made with four arms, O joy of the Yadus; / and, O knower of dharma, the son of Garuḍa is to be made with folded hands.

3.17.s:
sukhopaviṣṭaistatpṛṣṭhe tatkarastho hi paṅkajaḥ ..
upaviṣṭau gadā cakrau kartavyau tārkṣyapakṣayoḥ .. 47 ..
3.17.d:
सुखोपविष्टैस्तत्पृष्ठे तत्करस्थो हि पङ्कजः ॥
उपविष्टौ गदा चक्रौ कर्तव्यौ तार्क्ष्यपक्षयोः ॥ 47 ॥
3.17.m: A lotus should indeed be in His hand as He sits comfortably on his back; / the mace and the discus should be made seated upon the wings of Tārkṣya.

3.17.s:
tārkṣyāsanasthā śrīḥ kāryā vāmotsaṅgagatāpi vā ..
śeṣabhogopaviṣṭo vā kāryo devo manoharaḥ .. 48 ..
3.17.d:
तार्क्ष्यासनस्था श्रीः कार्या वामोत्सङ्गगतापि वा ॥
शेषभोगोपविष्टो वा कार्यो देवो मनोहरः ॥ 48 ॥
3.17.m: Śrī should be made resting on the seat of Tārkṣya, or seated on His left lap. / Or the charming God is to be made seated upon the coils of Śeṣa.

3.17.s:
tatphaṇaireva racitaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ prabhormukham ..
śeṣabhogopaviṣṭasya śūnyaṃ karacatuṣṭayam .. 49 ..
3.17.d:
तत्फणैरेव रचितं दुर्निरीक्ष्यं प्रभोर्मुखम् ॥
शेषभोगोपविष्टस्य शून्यं करचतुष्टयम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.17.m: With its hoods alone the difficult-to-look-upon face of the Lord is shaded. / The four hands of Him seated on the coils of Śeṣa should be made empty.

3.17.s:
kāryaṃ cakraṃ gadā kāryā sadehā tatsamīpagā ..
lakṣmīḥ kāryā tathā tasya śeṣabhogagatāpi vā .. 3.85.50 ..
3.17.d:
कार्यं चक्रं गदा कार्या सदेहा तत्समीपगा ॥
लक्ष्मीः कार्या तथा तस्य शेषभोगगतापि वा ॥ 3.85.50 ॥
3.17.m: The discus is to be made, and the mace is to be made, embodied and beside Him. / Lakṣmī also is to be made beside Him, or on the coils of Śeṣa.

3.17.s:
śeṣaparyaṅkaśayane kāryo vā bhagavānhariḥ ..
airāvatī sumudbhūte yathārūpo mayeritaḥ .. 51..
3.17.d:
शेषपर्यङ्कशयने कार्यो वा भगवान्हरिः ॥
ऐरावती सुमुद्भूते यथारूपो मयेरितः ॥ 51॥
3.17.m: Or the Lord Hari is to be made reclining on the couch of Śeṣa, / having the form as was described by me upon the rising of the Airāvatī river.

3.17.s:
nṛsiṃha rūpaṃ kathitaṃ vārāhaṃ kāpilaṃ tathā ..
viśvarūpaṃ hayagrīvaṃ padmanābhaṃ tathaiva ca .. 52 ..
3.17.d:
नृसिंह रूपं कथितं वाराहं कापिलं तथा ॥
विश्वरूपं हयग्रीवं पद्मनाभं तथैव च ॥ 52 ॥
3.17.m: The forms of Nṛsiṃha, Varāha, and Kapila have been told, / and likewise Viśvarūpa, Hayagrīva, and Padmanābha;

3.17.s:
brāhmyaṃ raudraṃ ca rāmīya puṣkareṇa mahātmanā ..
kartavyo vāmano devaḥ saṅkaṭairgātraparvabhiḥ .. 53 ..
3.17.d:
ब्राह्म्यं रौद्रं च रामीय पुष्करेण महात्मना ॥
कर्तव्यो वामनो देवः सङ्कटैर्गात्रपर्वभिः ॥ 53 ॥
3.17.m: [and] that of Brahmā, that of Rudra, and that of Rāma by the great-souled Puṣkara. / The divine Vāmana is to be made with compact limbs and joints,

3.17.s:
pīnagātraśca kartavyo daṇḍī cādhyayanodyataḥ ..
dūrvāśyāmaśca kartavyaḥ kṛṣṇājinadharastathā .. 54 ..
3.17.d:
पीनगात्रश्च कर्तव्यो दण्डी चाध्ययनोद्यतः ॥
दूर्वाश्यामश्च कर्तव्यः कृष्णाजिनधरस्तथा ॥ 54 ॥
3.17.m: with stout limbs, holding a staff, intent on study, / dark as dūrvā grass, and wearing a black antelope skin.

3.17.s:
sajalāmbudasaṅkāśastathā kāryastrivikramaḥ ..
daṇḍapāśadharaḥ kāryaḥ śaṅkhasañcumbitādharaḥ .. 55 ..
3.17.d:
सजलाम्बुदसङ्काशस्तथा कार्यस्त्रिविक्रमः ॥
दण्डपाशधरः कार्यः शङ्खसञ्चुम्बिताधरः ॥ 55 ॥
3.17.m: Likewise Trivikrama is to be made resembling a cloud full of water, / holding a staff and a noose, with His lower lip kissed by the conch.

3.17.s:
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmāḥ kāryāstasya svarūpiṇaḥ ..
nṛdehāste na kartavyā śeṣaṃ kāryaṃ tu pūrvavat .. 56 ..
3.17.d:
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्माः कार्यास्तस्य स्वरूपिणः ॥
नृदेहास्ते न कर्तव्या शेषं कार्यं तु पूर्ववत् ॥ 56 ॥
3.17.m: His conch, discus, mace, and lotus are to be made in their own [weapon] forms; / they are not to be made with human bodies; the rest is to be made as before.

3.17.s:
ekordhvavadanaḥ kāryo devo visphāritekṣaṇaḥ ..
rūpaṃ narasya kathitaṃ tathā nārāyaṇasya te .. 57 ..
3.17.d:
एकोर्ध्ववदनः कार्यो देवो विस्फारितेक्षणः ॥
रूपं नरस्य कथितं तथा नारायणस्य ते ॥ 57 ॥
3.17.m: The God is to be made with one face turned upward, with wide-open eyes. / The forms of Nara and Nārāyaṇa were told to you,

3.17.s:
kṛṣṇasya hariṇā sārdhaṃ pūrvaṃ varuṇasūnunā ..
haṃso matsyastathā kūrmaḥ kāryāstadrūpadhāriṇaḥ .. 58 ..
3.17.d:
कृष्णस्य हरिणा सार्धं पूर्वं वरुणसूनुना ॥
हंसो मत्स्यस्तथा कूर्मः कार्यास्तद्रूपधारिणः ॥ 58 ॥
3.17.m: and that of Kṛṣṇa together with Hari, formerly by the son of Varuṇa. / The Swan, the Fish, and the Tortoise are to be made bearing those [very] forms.

3.17.s:
śṛṅgamatsyastu kartavyau devadevo janārdanaḥ ..
strīrūpaśca tathā kāryaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 59 ..
3.17.d:
शृङ्गमत्स्यस्तु कर्तव्यौ देवदेवो जनार्दनः ॥
स्त्रीरूपश्च तथा कार्यः सर्वाभरणभूषितः ॥ 59 ॥
3.17.m: The Lord of gods, Janārdana, is to be made as a horned fish. / He is also to be made in female form, adorned with all ornaments,

3.17.s:
kare'mṛtaghaṭaścāsya kartavyo bhūridakṣiṇaḥ ..
pṛthuḥ kāryastathā rājā cakravatyanta lakṣaṇaḥ .. 3.85.60 ..
3.17.d:
करेऽमृतघटश्चास्य कर्तव्यो भूरिदक्षिणः ॥
पृथुः कार्यस्तथा राजा चक्रवत्यन्त लक्षणः ॥ 3.85.60 ॥
3.17.m: and in Her hand a pot of nectar should be made, highly auspicious. / King Pṛthu is to be made with the complete marks of a universal ruler.

3.17.s:
kāryastu bhārgavo rāmo jaṭāmaṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ ..
haste'sya paraśuḥ kāryaḥ kṛṣṇājinadharasya tu .. 61 ..
3.17.d:
कार्यस्तु भार्गवो रामो जटामण्डलदुर्दृशः ॥
हस्तेऽस्य परशुः कार्यः कृष्णाजिनधरस्य तु ॥ 61 ॥
3.17.m: Rāma the descendant of Bhṛgu is to be made hard to gaze upon with a mass of matted locks, / with an axe in his hand, and wearing a black antelope skin.

3.17.s:
rāmo dāśarathiḥ kāryo rājalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ..
bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahāyaśāḥ ..62..
3.17.d:
रामो दाशरथिः कार्यो राजलक्षणलक्षितः ॥
भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश्च महायशाः ॥62॥
3.17.m: Rāma, son of Daśaratha, is to be made characterized by the marks of kingship, / as well as Bharata, Lakṣmaṇa, and the far-famed Śatrughna.

3.17.s:
tathaiva sarve kartavyāḥ kintu maulivivarjitāḥ ..
gaurastu kāryo vālmīkirjaṭā maṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ .. 63 ..
3.17.d:
तथैव सर्वे कर्तव्याः किन्तु मौलिविवर्जिताः ॥
गौरस्तु कार्यो वाल्मीकिर्जटा मण्डलदुर्दृशः ॥ 63 ॥
3.17.m: All [three] are to be made in the very same way, but devoid of crowns. / Vālmīki should be made fair-complexioned, hard to gaze upon with a mass of matted locks,

3.17.s:
tapasyabhirataḥ śānto na kṛśo na ca pīvaraḥ ..
vālmīkirūpaṃ sakalaṃ dattātreyasya kārayet .. 64 ..
3.17.d:
तपस्यभिरतः शान्तो न कृशो न च पीवरः ॥
वाल्मीकिरूपं सकलं दत्तात्रेयस्य कारयेत् ॥ 64 ॥
3.17.m: intent on asceticism, peaceful, neither emaciated nor stout. / The complete form of Vālmīki should be made for Dattātreya.

3.17.s:
kṛṣṇaśāntatanu rvyāsaḥ piṅgalo'tijaṭādharaḥ ..
sumanturjaiminiḥ pailo vaiśampāyana eva ca .. 65 ..
3.17.d:
कृष्णशान्ततनु र्व्यासः पिङ्गलोऽतिजटाधरः ॥
सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिः पैलो वैशम्पायन एव च ॥ 65 ॥
3.17.m: Vyāsa has a dark, peaceful body, tawny, bearing heavy matted locks; / Sumantu, Jaimini, Paila, and Vaiśampāyana —

3.17.s:
tasya śiṣyāstu kartavyāścatvāraḥ paripārśvayoḥ ..
yudhiṣṭhiro'tha karttavyo rājalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ .. 66 ..
3.17.d:
तस्य शिष्यास्तु कर्तव्याश्चत्वारः परिपार्श्वयोः ॥
युधिष्ठिरोऽथ कर्त्तव्यो राजलक्षणलक्षितः ॥ 66 ॥
3.17.m: his four disciples are to be made on both sides. / Then Yudhiṣṭhiro is to be made characterized by the marks of kingship.

3.17.s:
śmaśruhīno'tipīnāṅgaḥ kṣāmamadhyo vṛkodaraḥ ..
tiryakprekṣī saṃhatabhruḥ kartavyaśca tathā gadī .. 67 ..
3.17.d:
श्मश्रुहीनोऽतिपीनाङ्गः क्षाममध्यो वृकोदरः ॥
तिर्यक्प्रेक्षी संहतभ्रुः कर्तव्यश्च तथा गदी ॥ 67 ॥
3.17.m: Vṛkodara is to be made beardless, with very stout limbs, a slender waist, / looking sideways, with knitted brows, and holding a mace.

3.17.s:
dūrvāśyāmorjunaḥ kāryaḥ kirīṭī lohitāṅgadaḥ ..
bāṇacāpadharaḥ śrīmānsarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 68 ..
3.17.d:
दूर्वाश्यामोर्जुनः कार्यः किरीटी लोहिताङ्गदः ॥
बाणचापधरः श्रीमान्सर्वाभरणभूषितः ॥ 68 ॥
3.17.m: Arjuna is to be made dark as dūrvā grass, crowned, with red armlets, / holding bow and arrows, glorious, and adorned with all ornaments.

3.17.s:
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca kāryāvaśvisamāvubhau ..
khaṅgacarmadharau kāryau na tvevauṣadhipāṇinau .. 69 ..
3.17.d:
नकुलः सहदेवश्च कार्यावश्विसमावुभौ ॥
खङ्गचर्मधरौ कार्यौ न त्वेवौषधिपाणिनौ ॥ 69 ॥
3.17.m: Nakula and Sahadeva are both to be made resembling the two Aśvins; / they are to be made holding sword and shield, but not with herbs in their hands.

3.17.s:
nīlanīrajapatrābhā kṛṣṇā kāryātirūpiṇī ..
padmapatrāgragaurā tu karttavyā devakī tathā .. 3.85.70 ..
3.17.d:
नीलनीरजपत्राभा कृष्णा कार्यातिरूपिणी ॥
पद्मपत्राग्रगौरा तु कर्त्तव्या देवकी तथा ॥ 3.85.70 ॥
3.17.m: Kṛṣṇā is to be made very beautiful, with the hue of blue lotus petals; / Devakī is to be made fair as the tip of a lotus petal;

3.17.s:
madhūkapuṣpasacchāyā yaśodāpi tathā bhavet ..
ekānaṃśāpi kartavyā devī padmakarā tathā .. 71 ..
3.17.d:
मधूकपुष्पसच्छाया यशोदापि तथा भवेत् ॥
एकानंशापि कर्तव्या देवी पद्मकरा तथा ॥ 71 ॥
3.17.m: Yaśodā should likewise have the fair hue of a madhūka flower. / The goddess Ekānaṃśā is also to be made with a lotus in her hand,

3.17.s:
kaṭisthavāmahastā sā madhyasthā rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ ..
sīrapāṇirbalaḥ kāryo musalī caiva kuṇḍalī .. 72 ..
3.17.d:
कटिस्थवामहस्ता सा मध्यस्था रामकृष्णयोः ॥
सीरपाणिर्बलः कार्यो मुसली चैव कुण्डली ॥ 72 ॥
3.17.m: with her left hand on her waist, standing between Rāma and Kṛṣṇa. / Bala is to be made with a plough in his hand, holding a pestle, and wearing earrings,

3.17.s:
śveto'tinīlavasano madādañcitalocanaḥ ..
kṛṣṇaścakradharaḥ kāryo nīlotpaladalacchaviḥ .. 73 ..
3.17.d:
श्वेतोऽतिनीलवसनो मदादञ्चितलोचनः ॥
कृष्णश्चक्रधरः कार्यो नीलोत्पलदलच्छविः ॥ 73 ॥
3.17.m: white, wearing deep blue garments, with eyes rolling from intoxication. / Kṛṣṇa is to be made holding a discus, with the radiance of a blue lotus petal.

3.17.s:
indīvarakarā kāryā tathā śyāmā ca rukmiṇī ..
tārkṣyasthā sā ca kartavyā satyabhāmā surūpiṇī .. 74 ..
3.17.d:
इन्दीवरकरा कार्या तथा श्यामा च रुक्मिणी ॥
तार्क्ष्यस्था सा च कर्तव्या सत्यभामा सुरूपिणी ॥ 74 ॥
3.17.m: Rukmiṇī is to be made holding a blue water-lily, and dark-complexioned; / and the well-formed Satyabhāmā is to be made seated upon Tārkṣya.

3.17.s:
anyāśca devyaḥ kartavyāḥ surūpāḥ sumanoharāḥ ..
cāpabāṇadharaḥ kāryaḥ pradyumnaśca sudarśanaḥ .. .. 75 ..
3.17.d:
अन्याश्च देव्यः कर्तव्याः सुरूपाः सुमनोहराः ॥
चापबाणधरः कार्यः प्रद्युम्नश्च सुदर्शनः ॥ ॥ 75 ॥
3.17.m: The other queens are to be made well-formed and very charming. / Pradyumna is to be made handsome, holding a bow and arrows,

3.17.s:
rājandūrvādalaśyāmaḥ śvetavāsā madotkaṭaḥ ..
kartavyaścāniruddho'pi khaḍgacarmadharaḥ prabhuḥ .. 76 ..
3.17.d:
राजन्दूर्वादलश्यामः श्वेतवासा मदोत्कटः ॥
कर्तव्यश्चानिरुद्धोऽपि खड्गचर्मधरः प्रभुः ॥ 76 ॥
3.17.m: O king, dark as a blade of dūrvā grass, wearing white garments, wild with intoxication. / The lord Aniruddha is also to be made holding sword and shield.

3.17.s:
sāmbaḥ kāryo gadāhastaḥ surūpaśca viśeṣataḥ ..
sāmbāniruddhau kartavyau padmābhau raktavāsasau ..
khaṅgahastau ca kartavyau striyo veṣau tu pārśvayoḥ .. 77 ..
3.17.d:
साम्बः कार्यो गदाहस्तः सुरूपश्च विशेषतः ॥
साम्बानिरुद्धौ कर्तव्यौ पद्माभौ रक्तवाससौ ॥
खङ्गहस्तौ च कर्तव्यौ स्त्रियो वेषौ तु पार्श्वयोः ॥ 77 ॥
3.17.m: Sāmba is to be made with a mace in his hand, and especially handsome. / Sāmba and Aniruddha should be made lotus-complexioned, with red garments, / holding swords in their hands, with the dress of women on both sides.

3.17.s:
yuyudhānastathā prāṃśurbāṇacāpadharo bhaveta ..
varṇenotpalagarbhābho dīrghabāhuḥ sulocanaḥ..78..
3.17.d:
युयुधानस्तथा प्रांशुर्बाणचापधरो भवेत ॥
वर्णेनोत्पलगर्भाभो दीर्घबाहुः सुलोचनः॥78॥
3.17.m: Yuyudhāna should likewise be tall, holding bow and arrows, / in color resembling the interior of a lotus, long-armed, and fair-eyed.

3.17.s:
prādurbhāvā devadevasya viṣṇorvaktuṃ śakyā vistarānnaiva rājan ..
buddhyā teṣāṃ karmayogaṃ yathā vacchāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā te tu kāryā budhena..79..
3.17.d:
प्रादुर्भावा देवदेवस्य विष्णोर्वक्तुं शक्या विस्तरान्नैव राजन् ॥
बुद्ध्या तेषां कर्मयोगं यथा वच्छास्त्रं दृष्ट्वा ते तु कार्या बुधेन॥79॥
3.17.m: The manifestations of the God of gods, Viṣṇu, cannot be told in full detail, O king; / having understood their combination of actions as it is, and examining the treatise, they should be made by the wise.

3.18.s:
3.86
..vajra uvāca..
proktaṃ tvayā dvijaśreṣṭha pratimālakṣaṇaṃ śubham ..
prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ samyakkathayasvāmitadyute ..1 ..
3.18.d:
3.86
॥वज्र उवाच॥
प्रोक्तं त्वया द्विजश्रेष्ठ प्रतिमालक्षणं शुभम् ॥
प्रासादलक्षणं सम्यक्कथयस्वामितद्युते ॥1 ॥
3.18.m:
3.86
Vajra said:
The auspicious characteristics of images have been declared by you, O best of the twice-born. / Duly declare the characteristics of temples, O you of boundless splendor!

3.18.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
hastapramāṇantatproktaṃ prāsādānāṃ tu lakṣaṇam ..
saṃsthānato vinirdiṣṭaṃ hastamānānukīrtanam..2..
3.18.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
हस्तप्रमाणन्तत्प्रोक्तं प्रासादानां तु लक्षणम् ॥
संस्थानतो विनिर्दिष्टं हस्तमानानुकीर्तनम्॥2॥
3.18.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
The characteristics of temples have been stated in cubit measurements; / the specification of the cubit measure has been explained in terms of their plan.

3.18.s:
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ..
prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vijayārogyavardhanam ..3..
3.18.d:
तदहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
प्रासादलक्षणं श्रेष्ठं विजयारोग्यवर्धनम् ॥3॥
3.18.m: That I shall declare to you; listen to me as I speak: / the foremost characteristics of a temple, which increase victory and health.

3.18.s:
bhāgaṃ tu jagatī kāryā prāsādo bhāgameva ca ..
kartavyā jagatī mātratalpocchrāyatribhṛmikā ..4 ..
3.18.d:
भागं तु जगती कार्या प्रासादो भागमेव च ॥
कर्तव्या जगती मात्रतल्पोच्छ्रायत्रिभृमिका ॥4 ॥
3.18.m: The plinth should be made [of one] part, and the temple [body] also [of one] part; / the plinth is to be made with three storeys, each of equal height.

3.18.s:
ucchrāyā tena kartavyā hyekaikā bhūmikā gatiḥ ..
bhadrapīṭhākṛtiḥ kāryā bhūmikā bhūmikā punaḥ .. 5 ..
3.18.d:
उच्छ्राया तेन कर्तव्या ह्येकैका भूमिका गतिः ॥
भद्रपीठाकृतिः कार्या भूमिका भूमिका पुनः ॥ 5 ॥
3.18.m: Each single storey should thus be made of that [same] height, / and each storey should further be given the form of an auspicious seat.

3.18.s:
prasādārthaṃ kaṭiḥ kāryā kūṭameva tathaiva ca ..
kaṭimūlāṣṭabhāgena sopānavistarā bhavet .. 6 ..
3.18.d:
प्रसादार्थं कटिः कार्या कूटमेव तथैव च ॥
कटिमूलाष्टभागेन सोपानविस्तरा भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.18.m: For the temple, a waist should be made, and likewise indeed a spire; / by one-eighth part of the base of the waist, a staircase should be wide.

3.18.s:
samasaṃkhyaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sopānaṃ bhūmikāṃ prati ..
kūṭaḥ kāryastridhocchedaḥ śubhāmalakasārakaḥ .. 7 ..
3.18.d:
समसंख्यं तु कर्तव्यं सोपानं भूमिकां प्रति ॥
कूटः कार्यस्त्रिधोच्छेदः शुभामलकसारकः ॥ 7 ॥
3.18.m: The staircase should be made with equal numbers [of steps] for each storey; / the spire should be made with three divisions, having a beautiful āmalasāraka.

3.18.s:
caturasrastathā rājankramopacayasaṃyutaḥ ..
vicchedāścātra kartavyāḥ siṃhamālāvibhūṣitāḥ .. 8 ..
3.18.d:
चतुरस्रस्तथा राजन्क्रमोपचयसंयुतः ॥
विच्छेदाश्चात्र कर्तव्याः सिंहमालाविभूषिताः ॥ 8 ॥
3.18.m: It should be square, O king, with gradual tapering steps, / and here divisions should be made, adorned with rows of lions.

3.18.s:
dvārocchrāyāśca kartavyā devāścāṣṭāṃśasaṃyutāḥ ..
vistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ cātra dvārocchrāyaṃ tu kārayet .. 9 ..
3.18.d:
द्वारोच्छ्रायाश्च कर्तव्या देवाश्चाष्टांशसंयुताः ॥
विस्तारं द्विगुणं चात्र द्वारोच्छ्रायं तु कारयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.18.m: The heights of the doors should be made, and the gods, with an eighth part [proportion]; / and here one should make the door's height twice its width.

3.18.s:
dvāraśobhāvatī kāryā candraśālā samucchritā ..
kūṭaprathamavicchede śubhāmalakasārakaiḥ .. 3.86.10 ..
3.18.d:
द्वारशोभावती कार्या चन्द्रशाला समुच्छ्रिता ॥
कूटप्रथमविच्छेदे शुभामलकसारकैः ॥ 3.86.10 ॥
3.18.m: An elevated dormer-window should be made, bestowing beauty on the door; / in the first division of the spire, with beautiful āmalasārakas,

3.18.s:
dvāraiścaturbhirbhagnaistu na bhagnairvā mahīpate ..
prāsādametatkartavyaṃ kūṭacchedadvaye tathā .. 11 ..
3.18.d:
द्वारैश्चतुर्भिर्भग्नैस्तु न भग्नैर्वा महीपते ॥
प्रासादमेतत्कर्तव्यं कूटच्छेदद्वये तथा ॥ 11 ॥
3.18.m: this temple should be made with four doors, broken or not broken, O king; / and likewise in the two divisions of the spire,

3.18.s:
vicchinna candraśālābhiścatasṛbhirivāvṛtam ..
himavānnāma vikhyātaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ manoharaḥ .. 12 ..
3.18.d:
विच्छिन्न चन्द्रशालाभिश्चतसृभिरिवावृतम् ॥
हिमवान्नाम विख्यातः प्रासादोऽयं मनोहरः ॥ 12 ॥
3.18.m: it is as if surrounded by four broken dormer-windows. / This delightful temple is celebrated under the name of Himavat.

3.18.s:
kūṭacchedadvayopeto mālyavānabhidhīyate ..
ekakūṭastathaivāyaṃ śṛṅgavāniti kīrtitaḥ .. 13 ..
3.18.d:
कूटच्छेदद्वयोपेतो माल्यवानभिधीयते ॥
एककूटस्तथैवायं शृङ्गवानिति कीर्तितः ॥ 13 ॥
3.18.m: When provided with two divisions of the spire, it is called Mālyavat; / and this [same temple] having a single spire is proclaimed as Śṛṅgavat.

3.18.s:
āgārākhyo bhavatyeṣa dvāreṇaikena śṛṅgavān ..
agāro bhavanākhyaḥ syātprāsādastu dvimekhalaḥ .. 14 ..
3.18.d:
आगाराख्यो भवत्येष द्वारेणैकेन शृङ्गवान् ॥
अगारो भवनाख्यः स्यात्प्रासादस्तु द्विमेखलः ॥ 14 ॥
3.18.m: This Śṛṅgavat temple with one door becomes named Āgāra; / an Āgāra with two girdles would be named Bhavana.

3.18.s:
gṛhākhyaścaiṣa nirdiṣṭaḥ prāsādaścaikamekhalaḥ ..
śṛṅgavānniṣadhākhyaḥ syātprāsādastu dvimekhalaḥ .. 15 ..
3.18.d:
गृहाख्यश्चैष निर्दिष्टः प्रासादश्चैकमेखलः ॥
शृङ्गवान्निषधाख्यः स्यात्प्रासादस्तु द्विमेखलः ॥ 15 ॥
3.18.m: And with one girdle this temple is designated as Gṛha; / but the Śṛṅgavat with two girdles would be named Niṣadha.

3.18.s:
sa eva nīlo bhavati tathā caivaikamekhalaḥ..
mālyavāñśvetasaṃjñaḥ syātprāsādastu dvimekhalaḥ .. 16
3.18.d:
स एव नीलो भवति तथा चैवैकमेखलः॥
माल्यवाञ्श्वेतसंज्ञः स्यात्प्रासादस्तु द्विमेखलः ॥ 16
3.18.m: That same [Śṛṅgavat], having one girdle, becomes Nīla; / the Mālyavat with two girdles would be named Śweta.

3.18.s:
vindhyanāmā bhavatyeṣa tathā caivaikamekhalaḥ ..
agārabhedarahitaḥ sarvaḥ sarvadivaukasām ..17 ..
3.18.d:
विन्ध्यनामा भवत्येष तथा चैवैकमेखलः ॥
अगारभेदरहितः सर्वः सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥17 ॥
3.18.m: That same, having one girdle, is named Vindhya; / without difference of chambers, all [these] are for all the gods.

3.18.s:
rājandevagṛhāḥ kāryā yatheṣṭāśāmukhāḥ śubhā..
āgārabhedāḥ kartavyāḥ pūrvapaścimadiṅmukhāḥ ..18..
3.18.d:
राजन्देवगृहाः कार्या यथेष्टाशामुखाः शुभा॥
आगारभेदाः कर्तव्याः पूर्वपश्चिमदिङ्मुखाः ॥18॥
3.18.m: Auspicious houses of the gods, O king, should be made facing any desired direction; / the varieties of chambers should be made facing east or west.

3.18.s:
teṣāṃ liṅgapratiṣṭhaikā śastā bhavati pārthiva ..
dvimekhalā ye kathitāstathā caivaikamekhalāḥ .. 19 ..
3.18.d:
तेषां लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठैका शस्ता भवति पार्थिव ॥
द्विमेखला ये कथितास्तथा चैवैकमेखलाः ॥ 19 ॥
3.18.m: For them, the installation of a single liṅga is praised, O king. / As for those described as having two girdles, and likewise those with one girdle,

3.18.s:
bhāgasteṣāṃ tu jagatī bhāgasteṣāṃ tathā kaṭiḥ ..
bhāgamekaṃ tathā kāryaṃ kūṭaṃ prāgvanmahīpate .. .. 3.86.20 ..
3.18.d:
भागस्तेषां तु जगती भागस्तेषां तथा कटिः ॥
भागमेकं तथा कार्यं कूटं प्राग्वन्महीपते ॥ ॥ 3.86.20 ॥
3.18.m: their plinth is one part, their waist is also one part, / and one part likewise should be the spire, as before, O ruler of the earth.

3.18.s:
valabhīsaṃsthitaṃ ramyaṃ prāsādaṃ tu caturdiśam ..
vistāratriguṇāyāmaṃ tathā caivaikamekhalam..21..
3.18.d:
वलभीसंस्थितं रम्यं प्रासादं तु चतुर्दिशम् ॥
विस्तारत्रिगुणायामं तथा चैवैकमेखलम्॥21॥
3.18.m: A charming temple resting on a barrel-vault, facing all four directions, / with a length three times its width, and also having a single girdle,

3.18.s:
pārśvayorvalabhīpṛṣṭhe candraśālāyutaṃ bhavet ..
prāsāde tatra kartavyastrayāścāmalasārakāḥ .. 22 ..
3.18.d:
पार्श्वयोर्वलभीपृष्ठे चन्द्रशालायुतं भवेत् ॥
प्रासादे तत्र कर्तव्यस्त्रयाश्चामलसारकाः ॥ 22 ॥
3.18.m: should have dormer-windows on the sides and on the back of the barrel-vault; / three āmalasārakas should be made on that temple.

3.18.s:
bhāgastu mekhalā tatra kaṭibhāgastathā bhavet ..
bhāga ekastu valabhī tathā tatra prakīrtitā .. 23..
3.18.d:
भागस्तु मेखला तत्र कटिभागस्तथा भवेत् ॥
भाग एकस्तु वलभी तथा तत्र प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 23॥
3.18.m: There the girdle should be one part, the waist should also be one part, / and one part is taught there for the barrel-vault.

3.18.s:
prāsādasyāṣṭamo bhāgaḥ kartavyo mekhalāgatiḥ ..
kaṣṭyaṣṭabhāgo dvau hitvā sopānaṃ vistarādbhavet .. 24 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादस्याष्टमो भागः कर्तव्यो मेखलागतिः ॥
कष्ट्यष्टभागो द्वौ हित्वा सोपानं विस्तराद्भवेत् ॥ 24 ॥
3.18.m: An eighth part of the temple should be made as the path on the girdle; / leaving aside two-eighths of the waist, the staircase should be of that width.

3.18.s:
ekasyā diśi caivātra dvāraḥ kāryaḥ samucchrayaḥ ..
svecchāśābhimukhaḥ kāryo valabhīsaṃjñitastvayam .. 25 ..
3.18.d:
एकस्या दिशि चैवात्र द्वारः कार्यः समुच्छ्रयः ॥
स्वेच्छाशाभिमुखः कार्यो वलभीसंज्ञितस्त्वयम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.18.m: And on one side here, an elevated door should be made; / this one called Valabhī should be made facing the desired direction.

3.18.s:
prāsāde'smim̐stu kartavyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
ekānaṃśātha vā kāryā madhyagā rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ..26..
3.18.d:
प्रासादेऽस्मिम्̐स्तु कर्तव्या ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ॥
एकानंशाथ वा कार्या मध्यगा रामकृष्णयोः॥26॥
3.18.m: In this temple Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara should be placed; / or Ekānaṃśā should be made, situated between Rāma and Kṛṣṇa;

3.18.s:
gaṇeśaskandayormadhye kartavyo vā trilocanaḥ ..
madhyerkacandrayoḥ kāryastvaṣṭā vāpi janārdanaḥ..27..
3.18.d:
गणेशस्कन्दयोर्मध्ये कर्तव्यो वा त्रिलोचनः ॥
मध्येर्कचन्द्रयोः कार्यस्त्वष्टा वापि जनार्दनः॥27॥
3.18.m: or the Three-Eyed One [Śiva] should be made between Gaṇeśa and Skanda; / or the Creator, or Janārdana, should be made between the Sun and the Moon.

3.18.s:
ekaiva durgā kartavyā bahubāhu vibhūṣitā ..
tatra kāryātha vā lakṣmīrjagattritayabhūṣaṇā ..28..
3.18.d:
एकैव दुर्गा कर्तव्या बहुबाहु विभूषिता ॥
तत्र कार्याथ वा लक्ष्मीर्जगत्त्रितयभूषणा ॥28॥
3.18.m: Durgā alone should be made, adorned with many arms; / or Lakṣmī should be made there, an ornament to the three worlds.

3.18.s:
viṣṇurbhogaśayaḥ kāryaḥ prāsāde tatra vā nṛpa ..
caturātmāthavā kāryo devadevo janārdanaḥ .. 29 ..
3.18.d:
विष्णुर्भोगशयः कार्यः प्रासादे तत्र वा नृप ॥
चतुरात्माथवा कार्यो देवदेवो जनार्दनः ॥ 29 ॥
3.18.m: Or Viṣṇu reclining on the serpent's coils should be made in that temple, O king; / or the four-formed Janārdana, the god of gods, should be made;

3.18.s:
śakrakīnāśavaruṇaiḥ sahito vā dhaneśvaraḥ ..
anye devā na kartavyā ye mayā nānukīrtitāḥ .. 3.86.30 ..
3.18.d:
शक्रकीनाशवरुणैः सहितो वा धनेश्वरः ॥
अन्ये देवा न कर्तव्या ये मया नानुकीर्तिताः ॥ 3.86.30 ॥
3.18.m: or the Lord of Wealth accompanied by Śakra, Kīnāśa, and Varuṇa. / Other gods who have not been mentioned by me should not be made.

3.18.s:
ekāśābhimukhairdvāraiścaturbhiḥ saṃyutastvayama ..
brahmaṇā vṛddhido nāma prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..31 ..
3.18.d:
एकाशाभिमुखैर्द्वारैश्चतुर्भिः संयुतस्त्वयम ॥
ब्रह्मणा वृद्धिदो नाम प्रासादः परिकीर्तितः ॥31 ॥
3.18.m: Provided with four doors facing one direction, / this temple is proclaimed by Brahmā under the name Vṛddhida.

3.18.s:
kartavyastatra lokeśaścaturātmā haristvatha ..
vistāratriguṇaiśchāyāṃ dvārāṃstatra niveśayet .. 32 ..
3.18.d:
कर्तव्यस्तत्र लोकेशश्चतुरात्मा हरिस्त्वथ ॥
विस्तारत्रिगुणैश्छायां द्वारांस्तत्र निवेशयेत् ॥ 32 ॥
3.18.m: There the Lord of the World, or Hari in his fourfold form, should be made; / one should place doors there whose lintel-shades are three times the width.

3.18.s:
vistāratriguṇocchrāyairdvārairvā saṃyutastribhiḥ ..
prāsādo'yaṃ bhavedrājam̐striguṇo nāmataḥ śubhaḥ .. 33 ..
3.18.d:
विस्तारत्रिगुणोच्छ्रायैर्द्वारैर्वा संयुतस्त्रिभिः ॥
प्रासादोऽयं भवेद्राजम्̐स्त्रिगुणो नामतः शुभः ॥ 33 ॥
3.18.m: Or, provided with three doors whose height is three times their width, / this auspicious temple, O king, would be Triguṇa by name.

3.18.s:
ekāśābhimukhadvāragarbhabhittisamanvi taḥ ..
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca prāsāde'tra niveśayet .. 34 ..
3.18.d:
एकाशाभिमुखद्वारगर्भभित्तिसमन्वि तः ॥
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च प्रासादेऽत्र निवेशयेत् ॥ 34 ॥
3.18.m: Endowed with an inner chamber wall and doors facing one direction, / in this temple one should install Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra;

3.18.s:
ādityaviṣṇucandrārkāḥ pṛthagbhūpālasattama ..
gaṇeśarudraskandānvā prāsāde'sminniveśayet..35..
3.18.d:
आदित्यविष्णुचन्द्रार्काः पृथग्भूपालसत्तम ॥
गणेशरुद्रस्कन्दान्वा प्रासादेऽस्मिन्निवेशयेत्॥35॥
3.18.m: or Āditya, Viṣṇu, Candra, and Arka separately, O best of kings; / or one should install Gaṇeśa, Rudra, and Skanda in this temple.

3.18.s:
pārśvasthavalabhīhīno valabhīsaṃjñito bhavet ..
prāsādaḥ pārśvasaṃyuktaḥ śikharo nāmato nṛpa..36..
3.18.d:
पार्श्वस्थवलभीहीनो वलभीसंज्ञितो भवेत् ॥
प्रासादः पार्श्वसंयुक्तः शिखरो नामतो नृप॥36॥
3.18.m: Deprived of a side barrel-vault, it would be named Valabhī; / the temple joined with sides is named Śikhara, O king.

3.18.s:
pārśvasthavalabhīhīnaṃ vṛttidaṃ kāmadaṃ bhaveta ..
pārśvasthavalabhīhīnaṃ triguṇaṃ nṛgṛhaṃ bhavet .. 37 ..
3.18.d:
पार्श्वस्थवलभीहीनं वृत्तिदं कामदं भवेत ॥
पार्श्वस्थवलभीहीनं त्रिगुणं नृगृहं भवेत् ॥ 37 ॥
3.18.m: Deprived of a side barrel-vault, it grants livelihood and fulfills desires; / deprived of a side barrel-vault, the Triguṇa temple would be a human dwelling.

3.18.s:
kṛtavistṛtadigdvāraṃ prāsādaṃ valabhīgatam..
turagākhyaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ retomandagṛhaṃ hitam .. 38 ..
3.18.d:
कृतविस्तृतदिग्द्वारं प्रासादं वलभीगतम्॥
तुरगाख्यं विनिर्दिष्टं रेतोमन्दगृहं हितम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.18.m: A temple resting on a barrel-vault with wide doors in the cardinal directions / is designated by the name Turaga, beneficial as a house for semen and slow fire.

3.18.s:
vināyakasya tatkāryaṃ bhadrakālyastathaiva ca ..
skandasya kāryaṃ tadrājam̐llakṣmyā kāryamathāpi vā .. 39 ..
3.18.d:
विनायकस्य तत्कार्यं भद्रकाल्यस्तथैव च ॥
स्कन्दस्य कार्यं तद्राजम्̐ल्लक्ष्म्या कार्यमथापि वा ॥ 39 ॥
3.18.m: It should be made for Vināyaka, and likewise for Bhadrakālī; / it should be made for Skanda, O king, or even for Lakṣmī,

3.18.s:
nāgānāṃ pramathānāṃ vā nānyasya tu vidhīyate ..
kṛtavistṛtadigdvāraṃ turagaṃ kuñjaraṃ smṛtam .. 3.86.40 ..
3.18.d:
नागानां प्रमथानां वा नान्यस्य तु विधीयते ॥
कृतविस्तृतदिग्द्वारं तुरगं कुञ्जरं स्मृतम् ॥ 3.86.40 ॥
3.18.m: or for the Nāgas, or for the Pramathas; it is not prescribed for anyone else. / The Turaga temple with wide doors in the cardinal directions is known as Kuñjara;

3.18.s:
turagābhihatānāṃ ca devānāṃ tatpraśasyate ..
śakrasya ca mahābhāga nānyeṣāṃ tadvidhīyate .. 41 ..
3.18.d:
तुरगाभिहतानां च देवानां तत्प्रशस्यते ॥
शक्रस्य च महाभाग नान्येषां तद्विधीयते ॥ 41 ॥
3.18.m: and it is praised for the gods who struck down the horses [of the demons], / and for Śakra, O highly fortunate one; it is not prescribed for others.

3.18.s:
yatheṣṭasaṃkhyāgarbhaṃ tu prāsādaṃ valabhīgatam ..
yatheṣṭannāma vikhyātaṃ yatheṣṭāyāmasaṃjñitam .. 42 ..
3.18.d:
यथेष्टसंख्यागर्भं तु प्रासादं वलभीगतम् ॥
यथेष्टन्नाम विख्यातं यथेष्टायामसंज्ञितम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.18.m: A temple resting on a barrel-vault, having an inner chamber of any desired number, / known by the name Yatheṣṭa, is also designated as Yatheṣṭāyāma.

3.18.s:
yatheṣṭamānaṃ dvārantad dvāreṇaikena saṃyutam ..
ekagarbhaṃ tadevoktaṃ viśālaṃ nāma pārthiva ..43 ..
3.18.d:
यथेष्टमानं द्वारन्तद् द्वारेणैकेन संयुतम् ॥
एकगर्भं तदेवोक्तं विशालं नाम पार्थिव ॥43 ॥
3.18.m: That door of desired measure, provided with a single door, / and having a single inner chamber, is called Viśāla, O king.

3.18.s:
yatheṣṭe ca viśāle ca kartavyā mātaro nṛpa ..
grahā vā rājaśārdūla nakṣatrāṇyatha vā punaḥ .. 44 ..
3.18.d:
यथेष्टे च विशाले च कर्तव्या मातरो नृप ॥
ग्रहा वा राजशार्दूल नक्षत्राण्यथ वा पुनः ॥ 44 ॥
3.18.m: In the Yatheṣṭa and in the Viśāla, the Mothers should be made, O king; / or the planets, O tiger among kings, or again the asterisms,

3.18.s:
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ..
bhṛgavoṅgirasaḥ sādhyā devo vā yadi vāśvinau .. 45 ..
3.18.d:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवा मरुद्गणाः ॥
भृगवोङ्गिरसः साध्या देवो वा यदि वाश्विनौ ॥ 45 ॥
3.18.m: or the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Viśvedevas, the Marut hosts, / the Bhṛgus, the Aṅgirases, the Sādhyas, or the God, or the two Aśvins,

3.18.s:
aṣṭau vātha diśāṃ pālā yadi vā bhūtapañcakam ..
evaṃ devagaṇaḥ kāryo rājanprāsādayostayoḥ..46 ..
3.18.d:
अष्टौ वाथ दिशां पाला यदि वा भूतपञ्चकम् ॥
एवं देवगणः कार्यो राजन्प्रासादयोस्तयोः॥46 ॥
3.18.m: or the eight guardians of the directions, or the five elements; / in this way the host of gods should be made in those two temples, O king.

3.18.s:
āyatā mālyavatpṛṣṭhe valabhī tu yadā bhavet ..
kartavyo bhadrakālyarthe prāsādo bhadrasaṃjñitaḥ .. 47 ..
3.18.d:
आयता माल्यवत्पृष्ठे वलभी तु यदा भवेत् ॥
कर्तव्यो भद्रकाल्यर्थे प्रासादो भद्रसंज्ञितः ॥ 47 ॥
3.18.m: When an elongated barrel-roof is on the back of a Mālyavat [temple], / a temple called Bhadra should be built for the purpose of Bhadrakālī.

3.18.s:
tiryaksthā mālyavatpṛṣṭhe valabhī tu yadā bhaveta ..
dvārapāleti sa proktaḥ prāsādo vibudhapriyaḥ .. 48 ..
3.18.d:
तिर्यक्स्था माल्यवत्पृष्ठे वलभी तु यदा भवेत ॥
द्वारपालेति स प्रोक्तः प्रासादो विबुधप्रियः ॥ 48 ॥
3.18.m: When a transverse barrel-roof is on the back of a Mālyavat [temple], / it is declared to be the Dvārapāla temple, beloved of the gods.

3.18.s:
subhadrākhyasya nirdiṣṭaḥ śvetākhyo bhadravatkṛtaḥ ..
kṛtastu dvāraśālāvatsaumyaḥ syādgandhamādanaḥ .. 49 ..
3.18.d:
सुभद्राख्यस्य निर्दिष्टः श्वेताख्यो भद्रवत्कृतः ॥
कृतस्तु द्वारशालावत्सौम्यः स्याद्गन्धमादनः ॥ 49 ॥
3.18.m: The [temple] called Śveta is described as made like a Bhadra for the one called Subhadra; / but the Saumya Gandhamādana should be made like a gateway pavilion.

3.18.s:
saumyaḥ subhadraśca tathā sarveṣāmeva śasyate ..
aṣṭatrikūṭaṃ tricchedaṃ śubhāmalakasārakam .. 3.86.50 ..
3.18.d:
सौम्यः सुभद्रश्च तथा सर्वेषामेव शस्यते ॥
अष्टत्रिकूटं त्रिच्छेदं शुभामलकसारकम् ॥ 3.86.50 ॥
3.18.m: Both the Saumya and the Subhadra are praised for all [deities]. / [A temple] having eight trikūṭas, three divisions, an auspicious crowning āmalaka stone,

3.18.s:
aṣṭāṃśajagatībandhaṃ tathā caivaikamekhalam ..
aṣṭagarbhāṣṭadigdvāraṃ kamalaṃ parikīrtitam .. 51 ..
3.18.d:
अष्टांशजगतीबन्धं तथा चैवैकमेखलम् ॥
अष्टगर्भाष्टदिग्द्वारं कमलं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 51 ॥
3.18.m: with a plinth construction of eight parts, and having one belt, / with eight chambers and eight cardinal doors, is proclaimed as the Kamala.

3.18.s:
aṣṭau tatra tu kartavyā grahāḥ ketuvivarjitāḥ ..
sūryaḥ śukraḥ kujo rāhuḥ sauraścandro budho guruḥ .. 52 ..
3.18.d:
अष्टौ तत्र तु कर्तव्या ग्रहाः केतुविवर्जिताः ॥
सूर्यः शुक्रः कुजो राहुः सौरश्चन्द्रो बुधो गुरुः ॥ 52 ॥
3.18.m: There, eight planets should be made, devoid of Ketu: / Sūrya, Śukra, Kuja, Rāhu, Saura, Candra, Budha, and Guru.

3.18.s:
krameṇānena kartavyaṃ tatra rājangṛhāṣṭakam ..
bhūjalākāśavahnīndudīkṣitārkamaruttanuḥ .. 53 ..
3.18.d:
क्रमेणानेन कर्तव्यं तत्र राजन्गृहाष्टकम् ॥
भूजलाकाशवह्नीन्दुदीक्षितार्कमरुत्तनुः ॥ 53 ॥
3.18.m: In this order, O king, an octad of chambers should be made there, / [or] the god Mahādeva, the teacher of the world, whose body consists of earth, water, space,

3.18.s:
mahādevo'tha vā kāryastatra devo jagadguruḥ ..
aṣṭātmā vāsudevo vā prabhave yāpanena ca ..54 ..
3.18.d:
महादेवोऽथ वा कार्यस्तत्र देवो जगद्गुरुः ॥
अष्टात्मा वासुदेवो वा प्रभवे यापनेन च ॥54 ॥
3.18.m: fire, moon, the initiated sacrificer, sun, and wind, should be made there; / or the eightfold Vāsudeva, in origin and preservation.

3.18.s:
prāsāde'smiṃstu kartavyo vidhinānena vā hariḥ ..
caturātmā tu kartavyo digdvāreṣvatra keśavaḥ .. 55 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादेऽस्मिंस्तु कर्तव्यो विधिनानेन वा हरिः ॥
चतुरात्मा तु कर्तव्यो दिग्द्वारेष्वत्र केशवः ॥ 55 ॥
3.18.m: Or Hari should be placed in this temple according to this rule: / Keśava should be made fourfold at the doors of the cardinal directions;

3.18.s:
aśvaśīrṣaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam ..
īśānādiṣu koṇeṣu kāryā devā narottama .. 56 ..
3.18.d:
अश्वशीर्षं वराहं च नरसिंहं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥
ईशानादिषु कोणेषु कार्या देवा नरोत्तम ॥ 56 ॥
3.18.m: and Aśvaśīrṣa, Varāha, Narasiṃha, and Trivikrama— / these deities should be made in the corners beginning with the northeast, O best of men.

3.18.s:
ucchritā jagatī kāryā bhadrapīṭhākṛtiṃ vinā ..
prāgbhāgavalabhīhīnaṃ turagaṃ tatra kārayet .. 57 ..
3.18.d:
उच्छ्रिता जगती कार्या भद्रपीठाकृतिं विना ॥
प्राग्भागवलभीहीनं तुरगं तत्र कारयेत् ॥ 57 ॥
3.18.m: A raised plinth should be made, without the form of a bhadrapīṭha; / there one should make the Turaga [temple], lacking a barrel-roof on its eastern side.

3.18.s:
praśastaḥ sarvadevānāṃ prāsādastvaruṇodayaḥ ..
pūrvāparāśābhimukhaḥ kāryoyaṃ nānyadiṅmukhaḥ .. 58 ..
3.18.d:
प्रशस्तः सर्वदेवानां प्रासादस्त्वरुणोदयः ॥
पूर्वापराशाभिमुखः कार्योयं नान्यदिङ्मुखः ॥ 58 ॥
3.18.m: The Aruṇodaya temple is praised for all deities; / this should be made facing east or west, not facing any other direction.

3.18.s:
ayamevātidīrghastu prāsādo gṛhasaṃjñitaḥ ..
prāsāde tvaruṇe lagnā valyaprāsādakāvubhau .. 59 ..
3.18.d:
अयमेवातिदीर्घस्तु प्रासादो गृहसंज्ञितः ॥
प्रासादे त्वरुणे लग्ना वल्यप्रासादकावुभौ ॥ 59 ॥
3.18.m: This very same [temple], when very long, is called the Gṛha temple. / Attached to the Aruṇa temple are two small side-temples,

3.18.s:
yāmyottarāśābhimukhau tadvajjagati bandhanau ..
sammukhau tau tu jagati valabhīcchandakau bhavet..3.86.60..
3.18.d:
याम्योत्तराशाभिमुखौ तद्वज्जगति बन्धनौ ॥
सम्मुखौ तौ तु जगति वलभीच्छन्दकौ भवेत्॥3.86.60॥
3.18.m: facing the southern and northern directions, likewise bounded on the plinth; / facing each other on the plinth, they should have the design of a barrel-roof.

3.18.s:
śubhā jālapraticchannā saubhadvāramukhā tathā ..
tatra syādgaruḍo nāma prāsādaḥ sumanoharaḥ .. 61 ..
3.18.d:
शुभा जालप्रतिच्छन्ना सौभद्वारमुखा तथा ॥
तत्र स्याद्गरुडो नाम प्रासादः सुमनोहरः ॥ 61 ॥
3.18.m: It should be auspicious, covered with lattice-windows, with an entrance door at the front; / there should be the very charming temple named Garuḍa.

3.18.s:
ādityasya pratiṣṭhānaṃ prāsāde tatra śasyate ..
daṇḍapiṅgalakau kāryau tatra prāsādayordvayoḥ .. 62 ..
3.18.d:
आदित्यस्य प्रतिष्ठानं प्रासादे तत्र शस्यते ॥
दण्डपिङ्गलकौ कार्यौ तत्र प्रासादयोर्द्वयोः ॥ 62 ॥
3.18.m: The installation of Āditya is praised in that temple; / Daṇḍa and Piṅgalaka should be made in the two [subsidiary] temples there.

3.18.s:
tayorvā nṛpa kartavyau ratau mandayamāvubhau ..
kartavyau vā mahārāja tathā keśavaśaṅkarau .. 63 ..
3.18.d:
तयोर्वा नृप कर्तव्यौ रतौ मन्दयमावुभौ ॥
कर्तव्यौ वा महाराज तथा केशवशङ्करौ ॥ 63 ॥
3.18.m: Or in those two, O king, both Manda and Yama should be made on either side; / or, O great king, Keśava and Śaṅkara should likewise be made.

3.18.s:
prāsāde garuḍo vāpi kartavyaścandramā budhaiḥ ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya kartavyau śiśirāmbupau .. 64 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गरुडो वापि कर्तव्यश्चन्द्रमा बुधैः ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य कर्तव्यौ शिशिराम्बुपौ ॥ 64 ॥
3.18.m: Or, the moon should be made in the Garuḍa temple by the wise; / in its two side-temples, Śiśira and Ambupa should be made.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi kāmadevaṃ tu kārayet ..
pārśva prāsādayostasya kartavyau vanamālinau .. 65 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि कामदेवं तु कारयेत् ॥
पार्श्व प्रासादयोस्तस्य कर्तव्यौ वनमालिनौ ॥ 65 ॥
3.18.m: Or, one should place Kāmadeva in the Garuḍa temple; / in its two side-temples, two Vanamālins should be made.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi kartavyo devarāḍ budhaiḥ ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya kartavyau vanamālinau..66..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि कर्तव्यो देवराड् बुधैः ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य कर्तव्यौ वनमालिनौ॥66॥
3.18.m: Or, the king of the gods should be made in the Garuḍa temple by the wise; / in its two side-temples, two Vanamālins should be made.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi kartavyaśca tathā yamaḥ ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya mṛtyukālau niveśayet .. 67 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि कर्तव्यश्च तथा यमः ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य मृत्युकालौ निवेशयेत् ॥ 67 ॥
3.18.m: Or, Yama should likewise be made in the Garuḍa temple; / in its two side-temples, one should install Mṛtyu and Kāla.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi kartavyo varuṇo bhavet ..
pārśvaprāsādayoḥ kāryā gaṅgā kālindireva ca .. 68 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि कर्तव्यो वरुणो भवेत् ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोः कार्या गङ्गा कालिन्दिरेव च ॥ 68 ॥
3.18.m: Or, Varuṇa should be made in the Garuḍa temple; / Gaṅgā and Kālindī should be made in the two side-temples.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi dhanādhyakṣaṃ tu kārayet ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya śaṅkhapadmau niveśayet .. 69 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि धनाध्यक्षं तु कारयेत् ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य शङ्खपद्मौ निवेशयेत् ॥ 69 ॥
3.18.m: Or, one should place the lord of wealth in the Garuḍa temple; / in its two side-temples, one should install Śaṅkha and Padma.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi brahmāṇaṃ viniveśayet ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya kartavyau keśaveśvarau .. 3.86.70 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि ब्रह्माणं विनिवेशयेत् ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य कर्तव्यौ केशवेश्वरौ ॥ 3.86.70 ॥
3.18.m: Or, one should install Brahmā in the Garuḍa temple; / in its two side-temples, Keśava and Īśvara should be made.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi mahādevaṃ niveśayet ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya kāryau viṣṇupitāmahau .. 71 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि महादेवं निवेशयेत् ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य कार्यौ विष्णुपितामहौ ॥ 71 ॥
3.18.m: Or, one should install Mahādeva in the Garuḍa temple; / in its two side-temples, Viṣṇu and Pitāmaha should be made.

3.18.s:
vināyakaḥ kumāro vā kartavyo yadunandana ..
vīrabhadraśca nandī ca kartavyau vā manoharau .. 72 ..
3.18.d:
विनायकः कुमारो वा कर्तव्यो यदुनन्दन ॥
वीरभद्रश्च नन्दी च कर्तव्यौ वा मनोहरौ ॥ 72 ॥
3.18.m: Vināyaka or Kumāra should be made, O delight of the Yadus; / or charming Vīrabhadra and Nandī should be made.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi garuḍaṃ viniveśayet ..
pārśvaprāsādayoḥ kāryaḥ kaśyapo vinatā tathā ..73..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि गरुडं विनिवेशयेत् ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोः कार्यः कश्यपो विनता तथा ॥73॥
3.18.m: Or, one should install Garuḍa in the Garuḍa temple; / Kaśyapa and Vinatā should be made in the two side-temples.

3.18.s:
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi vāsudevaṃ niveśayet ..
pārśvaprāsādayostasya kāryau rudrapitāmahau..74..
3.18.d:
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि वासुदेवं निवेशयेत् ॥
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य कार्यौ रुद्रपितामहौ॥74॥
3.18.m: Or, one should install Vāsudeva in the Garuḍa temple; / Rudra and Pitāmaha should be made in its two side-temples.

3.18.s:
candrārkau vā mahārāja yadi vā varuṇānilau ..
lakṣmīṃ ca kālarātrīṃ ca yadi vāpyanalānilau .. 75 ..
3.18.d:
चन्द्रार्कौ वा महाराज यदि वा वरुणानिलौ ॥
लक्ष्मीं च कालरात्रीं च यदि वाप्यनलानिलौ ॥ 75 ॥
3.18.m: Or the moon and the sun, O great king, or Varuṇa and Anila, / or Lakṣmī and Kālarātrī, or even Anala and Anila,

3.18.s:
tārkṣyānantau mahārāja yadi vā garuḍāruṇau ..
prāsāde gāruḍe vāpi dharmaḥ kāryo mahīpate .. 76 ..
3.18.d:
तार्क्ष्यानन्तौ महाराज यदि वा गरुडारुणौ ॥
प्रासादे गारुडे वापि धर्मः कार्यो महीपते ॥ 76 ॥
3.18.m: or Tārkṣya and Ananta, O great king, or Garuḍa and Aruṇa. / Or Dharma should be made in the Garuḍa temple, O lord of the earth;

3.18.s:
pārśvaprāsādayostasya kāryo'rthaḥ kāma eva ca ..
liṅgākāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ devaveśma trimekhalam .. 77 ..
3.18.d:
पार्श्वप्रासादयोस्तस्य कार्योऽर्थः काम एव च ॥
लिङ्गाकारं तु कर्तव्यं देववेश्म त्रिमेखलम् ॥ 77 ॥
3.18.m: in its two side-temples, Artha and Kāma should be made. / A temple shaped like a liṅga should be made with three belts.

3.18.s:
tasya nāma bhavelloke śarveti narapuṅgava ..
dvimekhalasya tasyaiva trailokyamiti nirdiśet .. 78 ..
3.18.d:
तस्य नाम भवेल्लोके शर्वेति नरपुङ्गव ॥
द्विमेखलस्य तस्यैव त्रैलोक्यमिति निर्दिशेत् ॥ 78 ॥
3.18.m: Its name in the world is Śarva, O bull among men; / that very same [temple], when having two belts, one should designate as Trailokya.

3.18.s:
sa eva liṅganāmā syātprāsādastvekamekhalaḥ ..
kūṭavadvalabhīyuktaṃ sarvakīṭaṃ prakīrtitam .. 79 ..
3.18.d:
स एव लिङ्गनामा स्यात्प्रासादस्त्वेकमेखलः ॥
कूटवद्वलभीयुक्तं सर्वकीटं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 79 ॥
3.18.m: That very temple having one belt is named Liṅga. / Joined with a barrel-roof like a kūṭa, it is proclaimed as Sarvakīṭa.

3.18.s:
brahmāṇḍamiti vijñeyaṃ trailokyaṃ valabhīyutam ..
liṅgākhyaṃ valabhīyuktaṃ sāramityabhidhīyate .. 3.86.80 ..
3.18.d:
ब्रह्माण्डमिति विज्ञेयं त्रैलोक्यं वलभीयुतम् ॥
लिङ्गाख्यं वलभीयुक्तं सारमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 3.86.80 ॥
3.18.m: Trailokya joined with a barrel-roof is to be known as Brahmāṇḍa; / [the temple] named Liṅga, when joined with a barrel-roof, is called Sāra.

3.18.s:
śarvādyāḥ ṣaḍime kāryāḥ pūrvapaścimadiṅmukhāḥ ..
liṅgasaṃsthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ nityameteṣu paṇḍitaiḥ .. 81 ..
3.18.d:
शर्वाद्याः षडिमे कार्याः पूर्वपश्चिमदिङ्मुखाः ॥
लिङ्गसंस्थापनं कार्यं नित्यमेतेषु पण्डितैः ॥ 81 ॥
3.18.m: These six beginning with Śarva should be made facing east or west; / the installation of a liṅga must always be performed in these by the learned.

3.18.s:
prāsādaṃ valabhīsaṃjñaṃ caturasraṃ vimekhalam ..
caturasramiti khyātaṃ kāryaṃ tatsumanoharam .. 82 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादं वलभीसंज्ञं चतुरस्रं विमेखलम् ॥
चतुरस्रमिति ख्यातं कार्यं तत्सुमनोहरम् ॥ 82 ॥
3.18.m: A four-sided temple called Valabhī, devoid of belts, / is renowned as Caturasra; it should be made very charming,

3.18.s:
vidvāraṃ staṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ purastādbhittivarjitam ...
śākraṃ devagaṇairyuktaṃ yamaṃ vā pitṛsaṃyutam .. 83 ..
3.18.d:
विद्वारं स्तंभसंयुक्तं पुरस्ताद्भित्तिवर्जितम् ॥।
शाक्रं देवगणैर्युक्तं यमं वा पितृसंयुतम् ॥ 83 ॥
3.18.m: doorless, furnished with pillars, and without a wall in front; / [dedicated to] Śakra accompanied by the host of gods, or to Yama accompanied by the ancestors,

3.18.s:
mātṛyuktaṃ mahākālaṃ nṛsiṃhamatha vā punaḥ ..
durgāṃ devīṃ tathā rājannakṣatraṃ śaśinaṃ tathā .. 84 ...
3.18.d:
मातृयुक्तं महाकालं नृसिंहमथ वा पुनः ॥
दुर्गां देवीं तथा राजन्नक्षत्रं शशिनं तथा ॥ 84 ॥।
3.18.m: to Mahākāla accompanied by the Mothers, or again to Nṛsiṃha, / or likewise to the goddess Durgā, O king, or to the Moon with the lunar mansions,

3.18.s:
grahairdivākaraṃ yuktaṃ nāgairvā nṛpa vāsukima ..
sumekhalaṃ tannirdiṣṭaṃ tathā nṛpa samekhalam .. 85 ..
3.18.d:
ग्रहैर्दिवाकरं युक्तं नागैर्वा नृप वासुकिम ॥
सुमेखलं तन्निर्दिष्टं तथा नृप समेखलम् ॥ 85 ॥
3.18.m: to the Sun accompanied by the planets, or, O king, to Vāsuki with the serpents. / That [temple] is declared as Sumekhala when provided with a belt, O king;

3.18.s:
vimekhalaṃ tatkathitaṃ rājandvāraṃ dvimekhalam...
trimekhalaṃ tatkathitaṃ mekhalāḍhyaṃ mahīpate .. 86 ..
3.18.d:
विमेखलं तत्कथितं राजन्द्वारं द्विमेखलम्॥।
त्रिमेखलं तत्कथितं मेखलाढ्यं महीपते ॥ 86 ॥
3.18.m: it is described as devoid of belts, O king; with a doorway, it has two belts; / and it is described as having three belts, rich in belts, O lord of the earth.

3.18.s:
sarveṣveteṣu kartavyāḥ sabhāsthāḥ sarvakīrtitāḥ ..
anyepyanuktāḥ kartavyāḥ sabhāsthā narapuṅgava ... .. 87 ..
3.18.d:
सर्वेष्वेतेषु कर्तव्याः सभास्थाः सर्वकीर्तिताः ॥
अन्येप्यनुक्ताः कर्तव्याः सभास्था नरपुङ्गव ॥॥। 87 ॥
3.18.m: In all these, all those mentioned should be made seated in an assembly; / other [deities] also, though unmentioned, should be made seated in an assembly, O bull among men.

3.18.s:
caturasrādayastvete dvāravanto mahīpate ..
dhiṣṇyaśalyabudhendvākhyā nāmataḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 88 ..
3.18.d:
चतुरस्रादयस्त्वेते द्वारवन्तो महीपते ॥
धिष्ण्यशल्यबुधेन्द्वाख्या नामतः परिकीर्तिताः ॥ 88 ॥
3.18.m: These beginning with Caturasra, having doors, O lord of the earth, / are proclaimed by name as Dhiṣṇya, Śalya, Budha, and Indu.

3.18.s:
caturasro gṛhaḥ kāryaḥ prāsādastveka bhūmikaḥ..
gṛha ityeva vikhyāto lakṣmīṃ tatra niveśayeta..89..
3.18.d:
चतुरस्रो गृहः कार्यः प्रासादस्त्वेक भूमिकः॥
गृह इत्येव विख्यातो लक्ष्मीं तत्र निवेशयेत॥89॥
3.18.m: The Caturasra Gṛha temple should be made with a single storey; / renowned as Gṛha, one should install Lakṣmī in it.

3.18.s:
sa eva kāryo devānāṃ yathaṣṭo bahubhūmikaḥ ..
bahubhūmikasaṃjñastu yatheṣṭaṃ nṛpapuṅgava..3.86.90..
3.18.d:
स एव कार्यो देवानां यथष्टो बहुभूमिकः ॥
बहुभूमिकसंज्ञस्तु यथेष्टं नृपपुङ्गव॥3.86.90॥
3.18.m: That very same [temple] can be made for deities with many storeys, as desired; / it is designated as Bahubhūmika according to one's wish, O bull among kings.

3.18.s:
bhūmikādvādaśopetaḥ ṣaḍasro merurucyate ..
caturdvārastu kartavyaḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasāma .. 91 ..
3.18.d:
भूमिकाद्वादशोपेतः षडस्रो मेरुरुच्यते ॥
चतुर्द्वारस्तु कर्तव्यः सर्वेषां त्रिदिवौकसाम ॥ 91 ॥
3.18.m: Having twelve storeys and six angles, it is called Meru. / It should be made with four doors, for all the dwellers of heaven.

3.18.s:
śuktimānnāmataḥ sarvaḥ sa caikādaśabhūmikaḥ ..
mandaro nāmataḥ proktaḥ sa taddvādaśabhūmikaḥ .. 92 ..
3.18.d:
शुक्तिमान्नामतः सर्वः स चैकादशभूमिकः ॥
मन्दरो नामतः प्रोक्तः स तद्द्वादशभूमिकः ॥ 92 ॥
3.18.m: The entire one named Śuktimat has eleven storeys. / That which is proclaimed by the name Mandara has twelve storeys.

3.18.s:
navabhirbhūmikābhistu pāriyātraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
alako nāma vikhyātastathā caivāṣṭabhūmikaḥ .. .. 93 ..
3.18.d:
नवभिर्भूमिकाभिस्तु पारियात्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
अलको नाम विख्यातस्तथा चैवाष्टभूमिकः ॥ ॥ 93 ॥
3.18.m: Pāriyātra is celebrated as having nine storeys. / Likewise, that renowned by the name Alaka has eight storeys.

3.18.s:
vimānaḥ saptabhaumaḥ syātpalabhaumo nandanaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
pañcataḥ pañca maḥ syāccaturbhaumaścatuṣkakaḥ .. 94 ..
3.18.d:
विमानः सप्तभौमः स्यात्पलभौमो नन्दनः स्मृतः ॥
पञ्चतः पञ्च मः स्याच्चतुर्भौमश्चतुष्ककः ॥ 94 ॥
3.18.m: Vimāna should have seven storeys; Nandana is taught as having six storeys. / Pañcama should have five, and Catuṣkaka has four storeys.

3.18.s:
tribhūmistu tribhūmiḥ syāddvibhūmyākhyo dvibhūmikaḥ ..
ekabhaumastu nirdiṣṭastathā caivaikabhūmikaḥ ..95...
3.18.d:
त्रिभूमिस्तु त्रिभूमिः स्याद्द्विभूम्याख्यो द्विभूमिकः ॥
एकभौमस्तु निर्दिष्टस्तथा चैवैकभूमिकः ॥95॥।
3.18.m: Tribhūmi should have three storeys; Dvibhūmi by name has two storeys. / Likewise, that designated as Ekabhauma has one storey.

3.18.s:
proktaḥ samudrākhyastathā vṛttaikamekhalaḥ ..
mekhalā caturasrā tu bhadrapīṭhākṛtirbhavet ..96..
3.18.d:
प्रोक्तः समुद्राख्यस्तथा वृत्तैकमेखलः ॥
मेखला चतुरस्रा तु भद्रपीठाकृतिर्भवेत् ॥96॥
3.18.m: The one called Samudra is proclaimed as round and with a single girdle; / its girdle should be four-cornered, in the shape of an auspicious pedestal.

3.18.s:
kṛtastvaṣṭaparicchedaiḥ sarvasvāmalasārakaiḥ..
vṛtta eva tathā nandī prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ..97..
3.18.d:
कृतस्त्वष्टपरिच्छेदैः सर्वस्वामलसारकैः॥
वृत्त एव तथा नन्दी प्रासादः परिकीर्तितः॥97॥
3.18.m: Made with eight sections, entirely with āmalasārakas, / round indeed, the temple is celebrated as Nandī.

3.18.s:
dīrgharājaguhākāro guhārājaḥ prakīrtitaḥ..
bhadrakālyāstathā kāryā viṣṇorbhāgaśayasya vā .. 98 ..
3.18.d:
दीर्घराजगुहाकारो गुहाराजः प्रकीर्तितः॥
भद्रकाल्यास्तथा कार्या विष्णोर्भागशयस्य वा ॥ 98 ॥
3.18.m: Having the form of a long king-cave, it is celebrated as Guhārāja; / it should be made for Bhadrakālī, or for Viṣṇu lying on Śeṣa.

3.18.s:
ekaśṛṅgastathā vṛtto vṛṣākhyaḥ syāddvimekhalaḥ ..
haṃsākārastathā haṃso ghaṭākāgstathā ghaṭaḥ ..99..
3.18.d:
एकशृङ्गस्तथा वृत्तो वृषाख्यः स्याद्द्विमेखलः ॥
हंसाकारस्तथा हंसो घटाकाग्स्तथा घटः ॥99॥
3.18.m: Having a single spire, round, and with two girdles is the one called Vṛṣa. / Shaped like a swan is Haṃsa, and shaped like a pot is Ghaṭa.

3.18.s:
siṃhākāraḥ smṛtaḥ siṃho maṇḍapo maṇḍapākṛtiḥ ..
dvādaśāsriḥ ṣaḍasristu tathāṣṭāsrirmahīpate .. 3.86.100 ..
3.18.d:
सिंहाकारः स्मृतः सिंहो मण्डपो मण्डपाकृतिः ॥
द्वादशास्रिः षडस्रिस्तु तथाष्टास्रिर्महीपते ॥ 3.86.100 ॥
3.18.m: Siṃha is taught as shaped like a lion; Maṇḍapa has the shape of a pavilion. / It may have twelve angles, six angles, or eight angles, O protector of the earth.

3.18.s:
prāsādāstu mayā proktāstathā proktāśrayasthitiḥ ..
pañcabhiḥ śikharairjuṣṭaścaturbhirapi maṇḍapaiḥ ..101..
3.18.d:
प्रासादास्तु मया प्रोक्तास्तथा प्रोक्ताश्रयस्थितिः ॥
पञ्चभिः शिखरैर्जुष्टश्चतुर्भिरपि मण्डपैः ॥101॥
3.18.m: The temples have been declared by me, as well as the placement of their foundations. / Endowed with five spires and four pavilions,

3.18.s:
dvāraiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kailāśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
trimekhalastriśṛṅgaśca trikūṭo nāma viśrutaḥ ..102..
3.18.d:
द्वारैश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तः कैलाशः परिकीर्तितः ॥
त्रिमेखलस्त्रिशृङ्गश्च त्रिकूटो नाम विश्रुतः ॥102॥
3.18.m: and furnished with four doors, it is celebrated as Kailāsa. / Renowned by the name Trikūṭa is that with three girdles and three spires.

3.18.s:
śṛṅgeṇaikena saṃyuktaścaturbhirapi maṇḍapaiḥ..
caturdvāraḥ smṛtaḥ saumyaḥ prāsādaḥ sumanoharaḥ..103..
3.18.d:
शृङ्गेणैकेन संयुक्तश्चतुर्भिरपि मण्डपैः॥
चतुर्द्वारः स्मृतः सौम्यः प्रासादः सुमनोहरः॥103॥
3.18.m: Furnished with one spire and with four pavilions, / having four doors, the very charming temple is taught as Saumya.

3.18.s:
prākāraṃ jānudaghnā syādyasyaikā jagatī bhavet..
prāsādatulyā tryaṃśā tu tryaṃśatulyā tathā kaṭiḥ..104..
3.18.d:
प्राकारं जानुदघ्ना स्याद्यस्यैका जगती भवेत्॥
प्रासादतुल्या त्र्यंशा तु त्र्यंशतुल्या तथा कटिः॥104॥
3.18.m: Its enclosure wall should be knee-high, and it should have one plinth / equal to [a third of] the temple; the waist is equal to a third.

3.18.s:
śikharaḥ kuharopeto nānārūpakabhūṣitaḥ..
ekamaṇḍapasaṃyuktastādṛśaiḥ suramandiraiḥ ..105..
3.18.d:
शिखरः कुहरोपेतो नानारूपकभूषितः॥
एकमण्डपसंयुक्तस्तादृशैः सुरमन्दिरैः ॥105॥
3.18.m: The spire is endowed with niches and adorned with various sculptural figures. / Furnished with one pavilion, and with such shrines of the gods,

3.18.s:
svalpairvidikṣu saṃyuktaścaturbhirbhuvi maṇḍapaiḥ..
sopānamūle saṃyukto dvābhyāmeva narādhipa..106..
3.18.d:
स्वल्पैर्विदिक्षु संयुक्तश्चतुर्भिर्भुवि मण्डपैः॥
सोपानमूले संयुक्तो द्वाभ्यामेव नराधिप॥106॥
3.18.m: and connected in the intermediate directions on the ground with four small pavilions, / and at the base of the stairway connected with just two, O ruler of men,

3.18.s:
prāsādo rājarājākhyo mukhyo'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ..
prāsāde rājarājākhye catvāro yadi maṇḍapāḥ..107..
3.18.d:
प्रासादो राजराजाख्यो मुख्योऽयं परिकीर्तितः॥
प्रासादे राजराजाख्ये चत्वारो यदि मण्डपाः॥107॥
3.18.m: this temple is celebrated as the foremost, named Rājarāja. / In the temple named Rājarāja, if the four pavilions,

3.18.s:
sarve śikharahīnāḥ syustathā sopānamūlagāḥ..
aṣṭau devagṛhāṇi syuḥ sa bhaveddharaṇīdharaḥ..108..
3.18.d:
सर्वे शिखरहीनाः स्युस्तथा सोपानमूलगाः॥
अष्टौ देवगृहाणि स्युः स भवेद्धरणीधरः॥108॥
3.18.m: as well as those at the base of the stairway, should all be devoid of spires, / and there are eight shrines of the gods, it would be Dharaṇīdhara.

3.18.s:
maṇḍapaiḥ śikharopetaivimānākhyaḥ sa vai bhaveta ..
vidikṣu yatra prāsādāścatvāro maṇḍapāntare .. 109 ..
3.18.d:
मण्डपैः शिखरोपेतैविमानाख्यः स वै भवेत ॥
विदिक्षु यत्र प्रासादाश्चत्वारो मण्डपान्तरे ॥ 109 ॥
3.18.m: With pavilions endowed with spires, it indeed becomes the one named Vimāna. / Where there are four temples in the intermediate directions within the pavilions,

3.18.s:
maṇḍapāḥ śikharopetā madhyamaṃjārisaṃyutāḥ ..
navabhiḥ śikharaireṣa prāsādaḥ surarāḍ bhavet .. 3.86.110 ..
3.18.d:
मण्डपाः शिखरोपेता मध्यमंजारिसंयुताः ॥
नवभिः शिखरैरेष प्रासादः सुरराड् भवेत् ॥ 3.86.110 ॥
3.18.m: and the pavilions are endowed with spires along with a central tower, / this temple, with nine spires, would be Surarāj.

3.18.s:
bahuvātāyanopeto bahujālagavākṣakaḥ ..
caturasro'tha vā vṛttastathaivocchritamekhalaḥ .. 111..
3.18.d:
बहुवातायनोपेतो बहुजालगवाक्षकः ॥
चतुरस्रोऽथ वा वृत्तस्तथैवोच्छ्रितमेखलः ॥ 111॥
3.18.m: Endowed with many windows and with many latticed openings, / four-cornered or round, and likewise with a raised girdle,

3.18.s:
ānandanāmā bhavati prāsādaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ..
mekhalāpṛṣṭhabhūbhāgātkrameṇāmalasārakaiḥ .. 112 ..
3.18.d:
आनन्दनामा भवति प्रासादः सर्वतोमुखः ॥
मेखलापृष्ठभूभागात्क्रमेणामलसारकैः ॥ 112 ॥
3.18.m: the temple facing all directions is named Ānanda. / Progressively from the upper level of the girdle with āmalasārakas,

3.18.s:
avicchinnaiḥ kramāddvārairbahubhiryo vinirmitaḥ ..
na muṇḍo na ca śūlāgraḥ prāsādaḥ susamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 113 ..
3.18.d:
अविच्छिन्नैः क्रमाद्द्वारैर्बहुभिर्यो विनिर्मितः ॥
न मुण्डो न च शूलाग्रः प्रासादः सुसमः स्मृतः ॥ 113 ॥
3.18.m: and constructed with many doors in uninterrupted sequence, / neither flat-topped nor with a trident tip, the temple is taught as Susama.

3.18.s:
muṇḍamaṇḍalasaṃyuktaḥ sa evoktaḥ prabhañjanaḥ ..
caturbhirmaṇḍapairyukto viśvakarmeti kīrtyate .. .. 114 ..
3.18.d:
मुण्डमण्डलसंयुक्तः स एवोक्तः प्रभञ्जनः ॥
चतुर्भिर्मण्डपैर्युक्तो विश्वकर्मेति कीर्त्यते ॥ ॥ 114 ॥
3.18.m: Endowed with a bald dome, that very one is declared as Prabhañjana. / When furnished with four pavilions, it is celebrated as Viśvakarman.

3.18.s:
maṇḍapaiḥ susamākāraiścaturbhirapi saṃyutaḥ ..
mahāsumana ityeṣa prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 115 ..
3.18.d:
मण्डपैः सुसमाकारैश्चतुर्भिरपि संयुतः ॥
महासुमन इत्येष प्रासादः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 115 ॥
3.18.m: Furnished with four pavilions of well-proportioned form, / this temple is celebrated as Mahāsumanas.

3.18.s:
bhadrākāraḥ smṛtaśchatro mṛdaṅgaḥ syāttadā kṛtiḥ .
viparīto mṛdaṅgastu vajra ityabhidhīyate ..116 ..
3.18.d:
भद्राकारः स्मृतश्छत्रो मृदङ्गः स्यात्तदा कृतिः ।
विपरीतो मृदङ्गस्तु वज्र इत्यभिधीयते ॥116 ॥
3.18.m: Chatra is taught as having the shape of a bhadra; Mṛdaṅga has that shape [of a drum]. / A reversed mṛdaṅga is designated as Vajra.

3.18.s:
ekā kaṭirbhavedyasya tathaikā jagatī nṛpa ..
śikharā śreṇigāḥ pañca dvārāḥ pañca tathā nṛpa .. 117 ..
3.18.d:
एका कटिर्भवेद्यस्य तथैका जगती नृप ॥
शिखरा श्रेणिगाः पञ्च द्वाराः पञ्च तथा नृप ॥ 117 ॥
3.18.m: The one that has a single waist and a single plinth, O king, / with five spires standing in a row and five doors, O king,

3.18.s:
prāsādo lokapālākhyo lokapāleṣu śasyate ..
śaṃsantyathānyaṃ prāsādaṃ mahābhūtagaṇasya ca .. 118 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादो लोकपालाख्यो लोकपालेषु शस्यते ॥
शंसन्त्यथान्यं प्रासादं महाभूतगणस्य च ॥ 118 ॥
3.18.m: the temple named Lokapāla is commended for the guardians of the world. / Now they praise another temple for the host of great spirits:

3.18.s:
prāsādo vartulakaṭistathā vartulamekhalaḥ ..
aṣṭāsriḥ śikharopeto dvārāṣṭakabhūṣitaḥ .. 119 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादो वर्तुलकटिस्तथा वर्तुलमेखलः ॥
अष्टास्रिः शिखरोपेतो द्वाराष्टकभूषितः ॥ 119 ॥
3.18.m: a temple with a circular waist and likewise a circular girdle, / having eight angles, endowed with a spire, and adorned with eight doors,

3.18.s:
digbandha iti vikhyātaḥ prāsādaḥ sarvadaivataḥ ..
paścādgaviṭakopeto jagatī mānamaṇḍalaḥ .. 3.86.120 ..
3.18.d:
दिग्बन्ध इति विख्यातः प्रासादः सर्वदैवतः ॥
पश्चाद्गविटकोपेतो जगती मानमण्डलः ॥ 3.86.120 ॥
3.18.m: is celebrated as Digbandha, belonging to all deities. / Endowed with a small chamber behind, with a plinth of measured circumference,

3.18.s:
prāsādastvekaśikharaḥ sāmānyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
maṇḍape jālakopete paścādbhāge guhā bhaveta .. 121 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादस्त्वेकशिखरः सामान्यः परिकीर्तितः ॥
मण्डपे जालकोपेते पश्चाद्भागे गुहा भवेत ॥ 121 ॥
3.18.m: the temple with a single spire is celebrated as Sāmānya. / When the pavilion is endowed with latticed windows, there should be a cave in the rear portion.

3.18.s:
vimekhalo'yaṃ prāsādaḥ suguhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
sa eva triguṇopetastriguṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 122 ..
3.18.d:
विमेखलोऽयं प्रासादः सुगुहः परिकीर्तितः ॥
स एव त्रिगुणोपेतस्त्रिगुणः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 122 ॥
3.18.m: This temple without a girdle is celebrated as Suguha. / When endowed with threefold [measure], that very one is celebrated as Triguṇa.

3.18.s:
himavānbahubhistambhairyuto bhavati nandakaḥ ..
stambhavānvalabhīyuktaḥ prāsādo bhittivarjitaḥ .. 123 ..
3.18.d:
हिमवान्बहुभिस्तम्भैर्युतो भवति नन्दकः ॥
स्तम्भवान्वलभीयुक्तः प्रासादो भित्तिवर्जितः ॥ 123 ॥
3.18.m: Himavat, furnished with many pillars, becomes Nandaka. / Having pillars and endowed with a barrel-roof, a temple devoid of walls

3.18.s:
ākāśanī sā bhavati tatrākāśaṃ prakalpayeta ..
ṣoḍaśasristu kathitaḥ prāsādastāvadasrikaḥ .. .. 124 ..
3.18.d:
आकाशनी सा भवति तत्राकाशं प्रकल्पयेत ॥
षोडशस्रिस्तु कथितः प्रासादस्तावदस्रिकः ॥ ॥ 124 ॥
3.18.m: becomes Ākāśanī; there one should fashion open space. / A temple of sixteen angles is declared with that many angles.

3.18.s:
prāsādaḥ śaṅkhasaṃjñaḥ syācchaṅkhākāraḥ suśobhanaḥ ..
padmābhaśikharopeto vaijayanto mahīpate .. 125 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादः शङ्खसंज्ञः स्याच्छङ्खाकारः सुशोभनः ॥
पद्माभशिखरोपेतो वैजयन्तो महीपते ॥ 125 ॥
3.18.m: The temple named Śaṅkha should be conch-shaped and very splendid. / Endowed with a spire resembling a lotus is Vaijayanta, O protector of the earth.

3.18.s:
anāsriḥ śikharopeto bhavedambudasaṃjñitaḥ ..
śikharaiḥ kuharopetairbhavenmaṅgalasaṃjñitaḥ .. 126 ..
3.18.d:
अनास्रिः शिखरोपेतो भवेदम्बुदसंज्ञितः ॥
शिखरैः कुहरोपेतैर्भवेन्मङ्गलसंज्ञितः ॥ 126 ॥
3.18.m: Without angles and endowed with a spire, it would be named Ambuda. / With spires endowed with niches, it would be named Maṅgala.

3.18.s:
prāsādānāṃ śataṃ caitatsamāsātkathitaṃ mayā ..
yathecchāśāmukhāḥ kāryā yeṣāṃ diṅ na prayojitāḥ .. 127 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादानां शतं चैतत्समासात्कथितं मया ॥
यथेच्छाशामुखाः कार्या येषां दिङ् न प्रयोजिताः ॥ 127 ॥
3.18.m: Thus this hundred of temples has been declared by me in brief. / Those for which a direction has not been prescribed should be made facing whichever direction is desired.

3.18.s:
sarve devagaṇāḥ kāryā yeṣāṃ devo na kīrtitaḥ..
viṣṇordevasya kartavyaḥ sarva eva viśeṣataḥ .. 128 ..
3.18.d:
सर्वे देवगणाः कार्या येषां देवो न कीर्तितः॥
विष्णोर्देवस्य कर्तव्यः सर्व एव विशेषतः ॥ 128 ॥
3.18.m: All hosts of gods may be made [in them] for which a deity has not been specified; / for the god Viṣṇu, all may especially be made.

3.18.s:
anyamiśrau na kartavyau candrārkāvekaveśmagau ..
sūryeṇa saṃyutaścandraḥ kṣīṇaḥ ketuḥ kṣayāvahaḥ .. 129 ..
3.18.d:
अन्यमिश्रौ न कर्तव्यौ चन्द्रार्कावेकवेश्मगौ ॥
सूर्येण संयुतश्चन्द्रः क्षीणः केतुः क्षयावहः ॥ 129 ॥
3.18.m: The moon and sun should not be placed in a single shrine, mixed with one another: / the moon united with the sun is wan, [like] Ketu bringing ruin.

3.18.s:
parasparāśābhimukhau kartavyau sūryarātripau ..
pūrvāparāśābhimukhau na tu yāmyottarāmukhau .. 3.86.130 ..
3.18.d:
परस्पराशाभिमुखौ कर्तव्यौ सूर्यरात्रिपौ ॥
पूर्वापराशाभिमुखौ न तु याम्योत्तरामुखौ ॥ 3.86.130 ॥
3.18.m: The sun and the lord of the night should be made facing each other's direction, / facing east and west, but not facing south and north.

3.18.s:
pūrvāparāśābhimukhau yadvā syātāṃ tadā śaśī ..
pūjyo bhavati dharmajña kartuḥ kalyāṇakārakaḥ .. 131 ..
3.18.d:
पूर्वापराशाभिमुखौ यद्वा स्यातां तदा शशी ॥
पूज्यो भवति धर्मज्ञ कर्तुः कल्याणकारकः ॥ 131 ॥
3.18.m: Or if they should face east and west, then the moon / becomes worthy of worship, O knower of dharma, bringing welfare to the builder.

3.18.s:
naikaveśmagatau kāryau grahau skandavināyakau ..
na nāgagaruḍau kāryau na cāntakamaheśvarau .. 132 ..
3.18.d:
नैकवेश्मगतौ कार्यौ ग्रहौ स्कन्दविनायकौ ॥
न नागगरुडौ कार्यौ न चान्तकमहेश्वरौ ॥ 132 ॥
3.18.m: The two planets Skanda and Vināyaka should not be placed in a single shrine; / the serpent and Garuḍa should not be placed [together], nor Antaka and Maheśvara;

3.18.s:
mahākālanṛsiṃhau ca raktāṃ śuṣkāṃ tathaiva ca ..
brahmarudrakṛtāntaistu bhadrakālyātha vā saha .. 133 ..
3.18.d:
महाकालनृसिंहौ च रक्तां शुष्कां तथैव च ॥
ब्रह्मरुद्रकृतान्तैस्तु भद्रकाल्याथ वा सह ॥ 133 ॥
3.18.m: nor Mahākāla and Nṛsiṃha; likewise Raktā and Śuṣkā; / nor [should these be placed] with Brahmā, Rudra, and Kṛtānta, or with Bhadrakālī;

3.18.s:
kāmadevo na kartavyastathaiva varuṇānalau ..
devasyaikasya no kārye dve tathā ca tathā nṛpa .. 124 ..
3.18.d:
कामदेवो न कर्तव्यस्तथैव वरुणानलौ ॥
देवस्यैकस्य नो कार्ये द्वे तथा च तथा नृप ॥ 124 ॥
3.18.m: Kāmadeva should not be placed [together with them], nor likewise Varuṇa and Agni. / And two [images] of a single god should not be made [in one shrine], O king.

3.18.s:
prādurbhāvagate kārye te ca vipṇormahātmanaḥ ..
yeṣāmapi ca devānāṃ dvandvayogo vigarhitaḥ .. 135 ..
3.18.d:
प्रादुर्भावगते कार्ये ते च विप्णोर्महात्मनः ॥
येषामपि च देवानां द्वन्द्वयोगो विगर्हितः ॥ 135 ॥
3.18.m: In the case of manifestations, however, these two of the great-souled Viṣṇu should be made. / Even of those deities whose pairing is censured,

3.18.s:
teṣāmapyanyasahitaḥ praśasto nṛpasattama ..
grahasaṃkhyāsusahitau kartavyau sūryarātripau .. 136 ..
3.18.d:
तेषामप्यन्यसहितः प्रशस्तो नृपसत्तम ॥
ग्रहसंख्यासुसहितौ कर्तव्यौ सूर्यरात्रिपौ ॥ 136 ॥
3.18.m: their combination with another is praised, O best of kings. / The Sun and the Moon should be made accompanied by the count of the planets;

3.18.s:
mahādevasamīpasthau tathā skandavināyakau ..
vāsudevasamīpasthau śeṣatārkṣyau tathaiva ca .. 137 ..
3.18.d:
महादेवसमीपस्थौ तथा स्कन्दविनायकौ ॥
वासुदेवसमीपस्थौ शेषतार्क्ष्यौ तथैव च ॥ 137 ॥
3.18.m: and Skanda and Vināyaka standing near Mahādeva, / and likewise Śeṣa and Tārkṣya standing near Vāsudeva.

3.18.s:
evamanyasametānāṃ yathāyogaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
kartavyastu viruddhānāṃ devānāṃ cāpi saṅgamaḥ .. 138 ..
3.18.d:
एवमन्यसमेतानां यथायोगैः पृथग्विधैः ॥
कर्तव्यस्तु विरुद्धानां देवानां चापि सङ्गमः ॥ 138 ॥
3.18.m: Thus, of those combined with others through various suitable associations, / even the assembly of deities [usually] conflicting is to be made.

3.18.s:
prāsādalakṣaṇamidaṃ kathitaṃ samāsādālokya pūrvacaritaṃ hi pitāmahoktama ..
śāstraṃ hitāya narasattama mānuṣāṇāṃ dhāryaṃ tvayā tadatiyatnapareṇa nityam .. 139 ..
3.87
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
prāsādamatha vakṣyāmi sarvatobhadrasaṃjñitama ..
caturātmā hariryatra kartavyo jagatīpate .. 1 ..
ekatra jagatī kāryā caturasrā manoramā ..
tasyāṃ garbhagṛhāḥ kāryā viṃśatiścaturuttarāḥ .. 2 ..
yeṣāṃ pṛṣṭhe jagatyūrddhavaṃ prākāraṃ viniveśayet ..
sarvatra mekhalākāraṃ tatrāpi viniveśayeta .. 3 ..
prāsādakā mahārāja caturviṃśatireva ca ..
caturṣu dikṣu sopānaṃ mekhalāyāṃ niveśayet .. 4 ..
sopānastryaṃśavistāro mekhalāyā prakīrtitaḥ ..
sopānobhayato rājanprāsādāste trayastrayaḥ .. 5 ..
bhavanti mekhalāpṛṣṭhe tadādau garbhamandiram ..
vimekhalaṃ tu sāmānyaṃ madhye teṣāṃ vimaṇḍapama .. 6 ..
3.18.d:
प्रासादलक्षणमिदं कथितं समासादालोक्य पूर्वचरितं हि पितामहोक्तम ॥
शास्त्रं हिताय नरसत्तम मानुषाणां धार्यं त्वया तदतियत्नपरेण नित्यम् ॥ 139 ॥
3.87
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रासादमथ वक्ष्यामि सर्वतोभद्रसंज्ञितम ॥
चतुरात्मा हरिर्यत्र कर्तव्यो जगतीपते ॥ 1 ॥
एकत्र जगती कार्या चतुरस्रा मनोरमा ॥
तस्यां गर्भगृहाः कार्या विंशतिश्चतुरुत्तराः ॥ 2 ॥
येषां पृष्ठे जगत्यूर्द्धवं प्राकारं विनिवेशयेत् ॥
सर्वत्र मेखलाकारं तत्रापि विनिवेशयेत ॥ 3 ॥
प्रासादका महाराज चतुर्विंशतिरेव च ॥
चतुर्षु दिक्षु सोपानं मेखलायां निवेशयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
सोपानस्त्र्यंशविस्तारो मेखलाया प्रकीर्तितः ॥
सोपानोभयतो राजन्प्रासादास्ते त्रयस्त्रयः ॥ 5 ॥
भवन्ति मेखलापृष्ठे तदादौ गर्भमन्दिरम् ॥
विमेखलं तु सामान्यं मध्ये तेषां विमण्डपम ॥ 6 ॥
3.18.m:
This characteristic of temples has been told in brief, having considered the ancient usage spoken by Brahmā. / This treatise, for the benefit of humankind, O best of men, must be observed by you with the greatest effort at all times.
3.87
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Now I shall explain the temple named Sarvatobhadra, / wherein Hari as fourfold self is to be installed, O lord of the earth.
A single plinth is to be made, square [and] delightful; / upon it twenty-four inner chambers should be constructed.
At the rear of these, above the plinth, one should erect an enclosure wall; / there too, all around, one should place the form of a terrace.
There are exactly twenty-four subsidiary shrines, O great king. / On the four directions one should place a stairway upon the terrace.
The stairway is declared to have a width of one-third of the terrace. / On both sides of the stairway, O king, are three shrines each;
they stand upon the terrace, and at their beginning is the sanctum. / Without a terrace is the common [shrine], [and] in their middle is one without a pavilion.

3.18.s:
himavansaṃjñitau kāryau tasya pārśve vimekhalau ..
sopānamūle prāsāde dvedve kārye manorame .. 7 ..
daṃṣṭre devakulākhye te sāmānyākhye vimaṇḍape ..
tathaiva jagatīpṛṣṭhe koṇe devakulaṃ nyaset .. 8 ..
prāsādo madhyamaścātra kartavyo maṇḍapānvitaḥ ..
catvāro maṇḍapāścātra kāryāḥ śikharasaṃjñitāḥ .. 9 ..
madhyaprāsādakoṇeṣu tathā maṇḍapasandhiṣu ..
dvidvigarbhaguhānramyānprāsādānviniveśayet .. 3.87.10 ..
ekaikaṃ maṇḍapaṃ cātra dvāratritayabhūṣitam ..
caturthe ca tathā dvāre devagarbhagṛhaṃ bhavet .. 11 ..
maṇḍapasya ca ye dvārā kāryāste stambhabhūṣitāḥ ..
prāsādasyāsya śikharā bhavantyeva navaiva tu .. 12 ..
ucchritaṃ navamaṃ śṛṅgaṃ tulyaṃ syācchikharāṣṭakam ..
madhyamaṃ śikharaṃ tatra kāryaṃ śikharavarjitam .. 13 ..
3.18.d:
हिमवन्संज्ञितौ कार्यौ तस्य पार्श्वे विमेखलौ ॥
सोपानमूले प्रासादे द्वेद्वे कार्ये मनोरमे ॥ 7 ॥
दंष्ट्रे देवकुलाख्ये ते सामान्याख्ये विमण्डपे ॥
तथैव जगतीपृष्ठे कोणे देवकुलं न्यसेत् ॥ 8 ॥
प्रासादो मध्यमश्चात्र कर्तव्यो मण्डपान्वितः ॥
चत्वारो मण्डपाश्चात्र कार्याः शिखरसंज्ञिताः ॥ 9 ॥
मध्यप्रासादकोणेषु तथा मण्डपसन्धिषु ॥
द्विद्विगर्भगुहान्रम्यान्प्रासादान्विनिवेशयेत् ॥ 3.87.10 ॥
एकैकं मण्डपं चात्र द्वारत्रितयभूषितम् ॥
चतुर्थे च तथा द्वारे देवगर्भगृहं भवेत् ॥ 11 ॥
मण्डपस्य च ये द्वारा कार्यास्ते स्तम्भभूषिताः ॥
प्रासादस्यास्य शिखरा भवन्त्येव नवैव तु ॥ 12 ॥
उच्छ्रितं नवमं शृङ्गं तुल्यं स्याच्छिखराष्टकम् ॥
मध्यमं शिखरं तत्र कार्यं शिखरवर्जितम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.18.m:
Two [shrines] named Himavat should be made at its sides, devoid of terraces; / at the foot of the stairway two delightful shrines each are to be made.
Those two subsidiary shrines are named Daṃṣṭra, designated as common, devoid of pavilions; / likewise on the terrace-platform, at the corner, one should place a subsidiary shrine.
And the central temple here should be made provided with a pavilion; / four pavilions are also to be made here, named Śikhara.
At the corners of the central temple and at the junctions of the pavilions, / one should place delightful shrines, each having two sanctum-chambers.
And each single pavilion here is adorned with three doorways; / and at the fourth doorway should be the sanctum of the deity.
And the doorways of the pavilion should be made adorned with pillars. / Of this temple there are indeed nine spires;
the ninth peak should be raised high, [while] the eight spires should be equal. / The middle spire there should be made devoid of a crest-spire;

3.18.s:
rūpakairvividhairyuktaṃ na maṇḍaṃ na ca śūlavat ..
aṣṭau tu śikharāstatra kartavyāḥ kuharānvitāḥ .. 14 ..
jālāgavākṣakopetaiḥ kuharairnṛpa bhūṣitāḥ ..
sarvatra śikharāḥ kāryāḥ śubhāmalakasārakāḥ .. 15 ..
sacakrāḥ sapatākāśca sadhvajāśca narādhipa ..
khe'bhiṣakta ivābhāti prāsādo'yaṃ samucchritaḥ .. 16 ..
kramato devatānyāsa prāsāde'sminnibodha me ..
vāsudevo'tra kartavyaḥ pūrvāśābhimukho nṛpa .. 17 ..
paścimāśāmukho vāpi na kāryaścānyadiṅmukhaḥ ..
vāsudevadiśaṃ cātra pūrvāṃ rājanprakalpayet .. 18 ..
tasyāścaivānusāreṇa diśaḥ syātparikalpanā ..
dakṣiṇāśāmukhaḥ kāryo devaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ .. 19 ..
paścimāśāmukhaḥ kāryaḥ pradyumnaścāpyanantaram ..
uttaraśāmukho rājannaniruddho vidhīyate .. 3.87.20 ..
3.18.d:
रूपकैर्विविधैर्युक्तं न मण्डं न च शूलवत् ॥
अष्टौ तु शिखरास्तत्र कर्तव्याः कुहरान्विताः ॥ 14 ॥
जालागवाक्षकोपेतैः कुहरैर्नृप भूषिताः ॥
सर्वत्र शिखराः कार्याः शुभामलकसारकाः ॥ 15 ॥
सचक्राः सपताकाश्च सध्वजाश्च नराधिप ॥
खेऽभिषक्त इवाभाति प्रासादोऽयं समुच्छ्रितः ॥ 16 ॥
क्रमतो देवतान्यास प्रासादेऽस्मिन्निबोध मे ॥
वासुदेवोऽत्र कर्तव्यः पूर्वाशाभिमुखो नृप ॥ 17 ॥
पश्चिमाशामुखो वापि न कार्यश्चान्यदिङ्मुखः ॥
वासुदेवदिशं चात्र पूर्वां राजन्प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
तस्याश्चैवानुसारेण दिशः स्यात्परिकल्पना ॥
दक्षिणाशामुखः कार्यो देवः सङ्कर्षणः प्रभुः ॥ 19 ॥
पश्चिमाशामुखः कार्यः प्रद्युम्नश्चाप्यनन्तरम् ॥
उत्तरशामुखो राजन्ननिरुद्धो विधीयते ॥ 3.87.20 ॥

3.18.s:
diggarbhā ye mayā proktā gṛhā maṇḍalasandhigāḥ ..
prāṅmaṇḍapāddakṣiṇato lakṣmīṃ tatra tu kārayeta .. 21 ..
dakṣiṇādvāmato nidrāṃ kālarātrīṃ tu dakṣiṇe ..
paścimādvāmataḥ siddhiṃ ratiṃ tasyaiva dakṣiṇe .. 52 ..
uttarādvāmataḥ kīrtiṃ dakṣiṇena sarasvatīm ..
pūrvasyāṃ vāmabhāge tu tathā puṣṭiṃ niveśayet .. 23 ..
aiśānyādikramāḥ kāryāḥ koṇaprāsādagāstvime ..
aśvaśīrṣaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam .. 24 ..
prāsādakeṣu kartavyā mekhalā bandhakeṣu ca ..
caturviṃśatirityete vibudhā vibudhottama .. 25 ..
tārkṣyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ tathā padmaṃ cakraṃ lāṅgalameva ca ..
musalaṃ cāpyanantaṃ ca gadāṃ tālaṃ tathaiva ca .. 26 ..
triśūlaṃ ca tathā śārṅgaṃ śaraṃ makarameva ca ..
paraśuṃ mudgaraṃ caiva carma pāśaṃ ca pārthiva .. 27 ..
3.18.d:
दिग्गर्भा ये मया प्रोक्ता गृहा मण्डलसन्धिगाः ॥
प्राङ्मण्डपाद्दक्षिणतो लक्ष्मीं तत्र तु कारयेत ॥ 21 ॥
दक्षिणाद्वामतो निद्रां कालरात्रीं तु दक्षिणे ॥
पश्चिमाद्वामतः सिद्धिं रतिं तस्यैव दक्षिणे ॥ 52 ॥
उत्तराद्वामतः कीर्तिं दक्षिणेन सरस्वतीम् ॥
पूर्वस्यां वामभागे तु तथा पुष्टिं निवेशयेत् ॥ 23 ॥
ऐशान्यादिक्रमाः कार्याः कोणप्रासादगास्त्विमे ॥
अश्वशीर्षं वराहं च नरसिंहं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥ 24 ॥
प्रासादकेषु कर्तव्या मेखला बन्धकेषु च ॥
चतुर्विंशतिरित्येते विबुधा विबुधोत्तम ॥ 25 ॥
तार्क्ष्यं शङ्खं तथा पद्मं चक्रं लाङ्गलमेव च ॥
मुसलं चाप्यनन्तं च गदां तालं तथैव च ॥ 26 ॥
त्रिशूलं च तथा शार्ङ्गं शरं मकरमेव च ॥
परशुं मुद्गरं चैव चर्म पाशं च पार्थिव ॥ 27 ॥
3.18.m:
Those chambers situated at the junctions of the diagram which were spoken of by me as directional sanctums: / there to the south of the eastern pavilion, one should make Lakṣmī;
to the left of the southern [pavilion], Nidrā, and Kālarātrī to the right; / to the left of the western, Siddhi, and Rati to its right;
to the left of the northern, Kīrti, and to the right, Sarasvatī; / and on the eastern side, in the left part, one should place Puṣṭi.
Occupying the corner shrines, these are to be made in sequence beginning with the northeast: / Aśvaśīrṣa, Varāha, Narasiṃha, and Trivikrama.
These twenty-four deities are to be made in the subsidiary shrines / and on the platform-bands, O best of the learned.
Tārkṣya, the conch, and the lotus, the discus, and the plow, / the pestle, and Ananta, the mace, and the palm tree,

Listen from me to this arrangement of the daṃṣṭrā shrines: / Indra and Agni are to be made on the east, and likewise on the south, O king,
Yama and Nirṛti; on the west, Varuṇa and Vāyu; / and on the north, Dhaneśvara and Maheśvara should be made.
Or the eight planets should be made in the daṃṣṭrā shrines: / the Sun and Venus on the east, and Mars and Rāhu on the south;
Saturn and the Moon on the west, O king; / and Mercury and Jupiter should be made on the north.
Whichever two daṃṣṭrā shrines belong to Vāsudeva here, / in those two one may make the two door-guardians of Vāsudeva, O king,
named Subhadra and Vasubhadra, both lords of the three worlds; / those named Āṣāḍha and Yajñatāta should be made for Saṃkarṣaṇa;

and one should make Jaya and Vijaya for Pradyumna; / and Āmoda and Pramoda for Aniruddha, O ruler of earth.
Rather than the placement of deities in the daṃṣṭrā shrines spoken of before, / the installation of door-guardians is commended for its many merits.
They indeed are to be known as the guardians of the directions, and likewise they are the planets. / Now listen to the deities on the plinth-molding in proper sequence.
Gāyatrī, the four Vedas, the Vaiṣṇava Aparājitā, / Death, Time, Yama, the staff, the armor, and the arrow;
Sāṃkhya, Yoga, Pañcarātra, and likewise the Pāśupata knowledge, / Vyāsa, Vālmīki, Mārkaṇḍa, and immediately following, the great elements.
In a temple of this kind, there should be an expansive courtyard, / adorned with artificial, divine waters that are joined together.
Then four door-guardians must be made by one who knows: / a temple called the gatehouse, uniform in shape and delightful.

3.18.m:
And auspicious inner chambers [and] enclosure walls arranged in rows should be made; / upon them one should place the manifestation of Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendor,
or, O best of earthly rulers, all the hosts of deities in succession. / O king, he who constructs this temple according to rule,
for all deities the prescribed worship [being performed] daily, / is declared to be a universal monarch at the beginning of the Tretā age for an aeon.
An enclosure should likewise be made; he dwells in heaven as he desires, / and then attains union with the discus-bearing God of gods.
A man surely obtains the fruit of gifting the three worlds / by performing even once the worship of all [deities] in this temple.
Through an abundance of perfumes, garlands, reverences, incense, lamps, and food, / he obtains whatever desire he wishes; no doubt should be held in this matter.
Possessing a discus and adorned with flags, this temple is exceedingly delightful; / as far as it comes into sight, so far are calamities destroyed.
Disease, premature death, and plagues, O king, / without doubt go to destruction for one who has entered it, O Yādava.

प्रेता विनायका वापि प्रभवन्त्यपि कस्यचित् ॥3.87.50 ॥

तस्मिन्पताकां यो दद्यात्तया पापं विधूयते ॥ 53 ॥
ईतयश्च शमं यान्ति पुण्यमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥

तत्र यत्सलिलं तिष्ठेत्तत्तीर्थं सततं भवेत् ॥

ऋषयश्च महाभागास्त्रैकाल्यामलदर्शिनः ॥
राजर्षयः पुराणाश्च सर्वे समुदिता गणैः ॥57॥
3.18.m:
Neither untimely deaths, O king, nor yoginīs, yakṣas, and rākṣasas, / nor pretas or vināyakas can have power over anyone [there].
Those foremost Sātvatas who are here surely attain union [with the Lord]; / and those who enter the house of the deity, and the multitudes of female and male servants,
all of them go to heaven for as long as fourteen Indras [rule]. / Furthermore, in the realm of whatever king this temple exists,
that earthly ruler also rejoices for a long time residing in the world of Śakra. / He who offers a banner on it has his sin shaken off by it;
plagues subside, and he attains unsurpassed merit. / Having made that temple white, he is declared to become a universal monarch.
When it is built according to such procedure, the deities as spoken by me / all become present there, O lord of the earth.
Whatever water stays there constantly becomes a sacred ford; / furthermore, at the performance of a festival procession there, all the gods along with Indra,
the fortunate sages who see the stainless reality of the three times, / and the ancient royal sages, all assembled with their hosts,
